quiz.explanation: 放松，稍微放松。He needed to unbend a little and enjoy life. 他需要稍微放松享受生活。 | un->否定，bend->绷紧，unbend->解除绷紧=放松（cf. bend绷紧，unbending不屈的，relax放松，loosen放松） || 文化联想：一向严肃的长辈春节时难得放下架子、和晚辈说笑，可以用 unbend 来形容，可以说 **unbend a little — “During the New Year gathering, the stern grandfather finally unbent a little and joked with the children.”**

quiz.question: descend ___ ______
quiz.explanation: 下降，下楼梯。Carefully descend the stairs in the dark. 在黑暗中小心下楼梯。 | de->向下，scend->攀爬（拉丁scandere），descend->向下爬（cf. ascend上升，condescend屈尊，transcend超越，scandal丑闻=踩脚的石头） || 文化联想：从泰山南天门一路拾级而下回到山脚，正好体现 descend，可以说 **descend the mountain — “After reaching the summit of Mount Tai, the hikers slowly descended the mountain along the stone steps.”**

quiz.question: condescend __ ____
quiz.explanation: 屈尊，屈尊帮忙。He wouldn't condescend to help with menial tasks. 他不会屈尊帮忙做琐碎的工作。 | con->共同，descend->下降，condescend->一起向下=屈尊（cf. descend下降，condescending居高临下，patronizing施恩似的） || 文化联想：“纡尊降贵”就是身份高的人刻意放低姿态，很适合联想到 condescend，可以说 **condescend to mingle — “The nobleman would occasionally condescend to mingle with ordinary townspeople while still treating them as inferiors.”**

quiz.question: transcend ______
quiz.explanation: 超越，超越极限。Great art can transcend limits of time and culture. 伟大的艺术可以超越时间和文化的极限。 | trans->跨越，scend->攀爬，transcend->跨越而超越（cf. transcendental超验的，transcendence超越性，exceed超出） || 文化联想：庄子《逍遥游》追求超脱功名利禄、突破世俗束缚的境界，很适合联想到 transcend，可以说 **transcend worldly concerns — “The spirit of Zhuangzi’s Free and Easy Wandering seeks to transcend worldly concerns and ordinary limitations.”**

quiz.question: reprehend __________
quiz.explanation: 谴责，谴责不当行为。The committee voted to reprehend misconduct by the official. 委员会投票谴责官员的不当行为。 | re->回，hend->抓（拉丁prehendere），reprehend->向后抓=谴责（cf. reprehensible应受谴责，comprehend理解，apprehend逮捕） || 文化联想：古代御史当廷弹劾官员、公开指出其失职，是 reprehend 很贴切的中国历史联想，可以说 **reprehend official misconduct — “An imperial censor could reprehend official misconduct before the court and demand accountability.”**

quiz.question: _____ comprehend
quiz.explanation: 理解，完全理解。It took time to fully comprehend the complexity of the issue. 需要时间才能完全理解这个问题的复杂性。 | com->完全，hend->抓（拉丁prehendere），comprehend->完全抓住=理解（cf. comprehensive全面，apprehend逮捕/理解，prehensile可抓握的） || 文化联想：中文“融会贯通”表示真正把一门学问吃透，很适合联想到 comprehend，可以说 **fully comprehend a subject — “After years of studying the classics, the scholar finally began to fully comprehend the ideas behind the texts.”**

quiz.question: apprehend _ _______
quiz.explanation: 逮捕，逮捕嫌疑人。Police worked to apprehend a suspect in the robbery. 警方努力逮捕抢劫案的嫌疑人。 | ap->朝向，hend->抓，apprehend->向前抓=逮捕/理解（cf. comprehend理解，reprehend谴责，apprehensive忧虑=心里抓住了恐惧） || 文化联想：古代衙役追捕逃犯、最终将其捉拿归案，可以用 apprehend 来描述，可以说 **apprehend a fugitive — “The yamen runners tracked the fugitive for days before they finally apprehended him.”**

quiz.question: fiendish ____
quiz.explanation: 恶魔般的，恶魔般的阴谋。The villain devised a fiendish plot. 恶棍设计了恶魔般的阴谋。 | fiend->恶魔（古英语feond->敌人），fiendish->像恶魔一样的（cf. friend朋友=feond的反义，fiend恶魔，fiendishly难以置信地） || 文化联想：《聊斋志异》中某些妖鬼设下阴毒陷阱害人的桥段很适合联想到 fiendish，可以说 **a fiendish scheme — “The villain in the tale devised a fiendish scheme to lure the traveler into danger.”**

quiz.question: mend _ _____
quiz.explanation: 修补，修补篱笆。He spent the afternoon trying to mend a fence. 他花了一下午试图修补篱笆。 | amend->修改（拉丁emendare->改正），mend->修补（cf. amend修改，emend校订，amends补偿，mend fences修复关系） || 文化联想：老一辈常说“新三年，旧三年，缝缝补补又三年”，最适合帮助记忆 mend，可以说 **mend old clothes — “Instead of throwing worn garments away, families would mend old clothes and keep using them for years.”**

quiz.question: amend ___ ____
quiz.explanation: 修改，修改法案。Congress voted to amend the bill before passage. 国会投票在通过前修改法案。 | a->到，mend->改正（拉丁emendare），amend->改正到更好（cf. amendment修正案，emend校订，mend修补，unamended未修改） || 文化联想：历代王朝常在原有律令基础上增删修订条文，这种做法可以用 amend 来表达，可以说 **amend the law — “A later dynasty might amend the law by revising penalties and adding new provisions.”**

quiz.question: emend _ ____
quiz.explanation: 校订，校订文本。The scholar worked to emend a text from ancient manuscripts. 学者努力从古代手稿中校订文本。 | e->去除，mend->错误（拉丁mendum），emend->去除错误=校订（cf. amend修改，emendation校订，corrigendum勘误，erratum错误） || 文化联想：古籍校勘家拿不同版本逐字比对、订正讹误，非常适合联想到 emend，可以说 **emend an ancient text — “A textual scholar may emend an ancient text after comparing several surviving editions.”**

quiz.question: ______ impends
quiz.explanation: 即将发生，危险即将发生。Everyone sensed that danger impends. 每个人都感觉到危险即将发生。 | im->在上，pend->悬挂（拉丁pendere），impends->悬挂在上方即将落下=即将发生（cf. impending迫近，pending悬而未决，suspend悬挂） || 文化联想：“山雨欲来风满楼”最适合帮助记忆 impend，可以说 **a storm impends — “When dark clouds gather and the wind suddenly rises, everyone senses that a storm impends.”**

quiz.question: expend _________
quiz.explanation: 花费，花费资源。The project would expend resources over several years. 该项目将在几年内花费资源。 | ex->向外，pend->称重/付款（拉丁pendere），expend->向外称重付出（cf. spend花费，expenditure支出，expense费用，pendant悬挂物） || 文化联想：古代大户人家办婚礼讲究排场，往往要耗费大量财物，可以说 **expend large sums — “A wealthy household might expend large sums on a lavish traditional wedding.”**

quiz.question: rend _______
quiz.explanation: 撕裂，撕裂成碎片。The conflict threatened to rend asunder the community. 冲突威胁要撕裂成碎片社区。 | rend->撕裂（古英语rendan），rend->猛烈撕扯（cf. rend撕，render给予/翻译，rending heart-rending令人心碎） || 文化联想：“撕心裂肺”里的“撕裂”意象很适合联想到 rend，可以说 **rend something apart — “The violent force seemed strong enough to rend the wooden gate apart.”**

quiz.question: tend _ ______
quiz.explanation: 照料，照料花园。She would tend a garden every morning. 她每天早上都会照料花园。 | tend->伸向/照料（拉丁tendere->伸展），tend->朝向/照顾（cf. attention注意，tendency倾向，tender温柔，extend延伸） || 文化联想：农民每天浇水、除草、扶苗，正是 tend 的典型画面，可以说 **tend the crops — “Every morning the farmer went to the field to tend the crops, pulling weeds and checking the seedlings.”**

quiz.question: pretend _________
quiz.explanation: 假装，假装无知。He would pretend ignorance when questioned. 被质问时他会假装无知。 | pre->提前，tend->伸出，pretend->提前伸出=声称/假装（cf. pretense借口，pretentious自负，contend争论，portend预示） || 文化联想：《三十六计》中的“假痴不癫”就是故意装傻以迷惑别人，很适合联想到 pretend，可以说 **pretend to be foolish — “In the stratagem ‘feign madness but keep your balance,’ one pretends to be foolish while secretly remaining alert.”**

quiz.question: superintend _____
quiz.explanation: 监督，监督工程。The engineer was hired to superintend works at the site. 工程师被雇来监督现场的工程。 | super->在上，intend->注意（拉丁intendere），superintend->在上方注意=监督（cf. superintendent监督人，intend打算，intention意图） || 文化联想：古代工部官员监督宫殿、河堤等大型工程的修建，可以用 superintend 来表达，可以说 **superintend construction — “An official from the Ministry of Works might superintend construction of a major palace or flood-control project.”**

quiz.question: distend _______
quiz.explanation: 膨胀，膨胀胃部。Eating too much can distend stomach uncomfortably. 吃得太多会让胃部不舒服地膨胀。 | dis->向外，tend->伸展，distend->向外伸展=膨胀（cf. distension膨胀，extend延伸，tension紧张，distended abdomen腹胀） || 文化联想：春节吃得太多后肚子鼓胀难受的状态很适合联想到 distend，可以说 **distend the stomach — “A huge New Year feast can distend the stomach and leave a diner uncomfortably full.”**

quiz.question: extend _ ________
quiz.explanation: 延长，延长截止日期。The professor agreed to extend a deadline for the paper. 教授同意延长论文的截止日期。 | ex->向外，tend->伸展，extend->向外伸展=延长（cf. extension延伸，extensive广泛，extendable可延长，extent程度） || 文化联想：旧时熟客欠账时，店家有时会通融延长还款期限，可以说 **extend the deadline — “For a trusted customer, the shopkeeper might extend the deadline for repayment by another month.”**

quiz.question: rescind __ _____
quiz.explanation: 撤销，撤销提议。The company decided to rescind an offer of employment. 公司决定撤销工作提议。 | re->回，scind->切（拉丁scindere），rescind->切回=撤销（cf. scissors剪刀，abscond潜逃=切断离开，rescission撤销） || 文化联想：新皇帝废除前朝某项苛政，就是 rescind 很直观的历史联想，可以说 **rescind an old decree — “The new emperor chose to rescind an old decree that had imposed an unpopular burden on the people.”**

quiz.question: purblind ________
quiz.explanation: 愚钝的，愚钝的判断。His purblind judgment led to poor decisions. 他愚钝的判断导致了糟糕的决定。 | pur->完全（来自purely），blind->盲，purblind->近乎盲=愚钝的（cf. blind盲，blindside盲区，blindspot盲点，nearsighted近视） || 文化联想：“一叶障目，不见泰山”最适合联想到 purblind，可以说 **purblind judgment — “The saying ‘a single leaf can block the view of Mount Tai’ warns against purblind judgment that cannot see the larger picture.”**

quiz.question: grind ______
quiz.explanation: 研磨，研磨咖啡。She would grind coffee beans fresh each morning. 她每天早上都会研磨新鲜的咖啡豆。 | grind->磨碎（古英语grindan），grind->研磨/苦干（cf. grindstone磨刀石，daily grind日复一日的苦工，grinder磨碎机） || 文化联想：传统石磨把小麦一圈圈碾成面粉，正是 grind 的典型动作，可以说 **grind grain — “In a village mill, a heavy stone wheel was used to grind grain into flour.”**

quiz.question: _________ vagabond
quiz.explanation: 流浪者，流浪的流浪者。The wandering vagabond had no fixed home. 流浪的流浪者没有固定的家。 | vagari->漫游（拉丁），vagabond->漫游的人=流浪者（cf. vague模糊，vagrant流浪，vagary奇想，extravagant奢侈=漫游太远） || 文化联想：中国古代常有“浪迹江湖、四海为家”的漂泊者，可以说 **a wandering vagabond — “With no fixed home, the wandering vagabond moved from town to town and lived by odd jobs.”**

quiz.question: abscond ____ _____
quiz.explanation: 潜逃，携款潜逃。The accountant would abscond with funds from the company. 会计会携款潜逃。 | abs->离开，cond->隐藏（拉丁condere），abscond->躲藏逃走=潜逃（cf. sconce蜡烛台=隐蔽处，recondite深奥=再次隐藏，abscond携款潜逃） || 文化联想：民间故事里贪官卷走银两连夜逃跑的情节很适合联想到 abscond，可以说 **abscond with the money — “The corrupt official tried to abscond with the money before investigators reached the city.”**

quiz.question: almond ____
quiz.explanation: 杏仁，杏仁树。The almond tree blossomed in spring. 杏仁树在春天开花。 | amygdala->杏仁（希腊），almond->来自希腊 amygdala 经阿拉伯语转变（cf. amygdala杏仁核=脑中杏仁形结构，almond eye杏仁眼） || 文化联想：中医食疗里常见杏仁润肺止咳的说法，可以说 **bitter almond — “Traditional Chinese remedies sometimes use bitter almond in preparations associated with relieving coughs.”**

quiz.question: ____ frond
quiz.explanation: 叶子，棕榈叶子。The palm frond swayed in the breeze. 棕榈叶子在微风中摇曳。 | frons->叶子（拉丁），frond->蕨类或棕榈的叶片（cf. front额头/正面=朝前的叶子，affront冒犯，confront对抗） || 文化联想：南方山林里蕨类植物展开的大片羽状叶子最适合帮助记忆 frond，可以说 **a fern frond — “After the spring rain, each fern frond unfurled along the shaded mountain path.”**

quiz.question: moribund _______
quiz.explanation: 垂死的，垂死的公司。The moribund company was on the verge of bankruptcy. 垂死的公司濒临破产。 | mori->死（拉丁mori），bund->状态，moribund->处于死亡状态的=垂死的（cf. mortal死亡，immortal不死，mortuary太平间，moribund industry夕阳产业） || 文化联想：中文“夕阳产业”常指已经衰退、接近消亡的行业，很适合联想到 moribund，可以说 **a moribund industry — “An old industry that has lost workers, customers, and investment may become a moribund industry.”**

quiz.question: fecund ___________
quiz.explanation: 富饶的，富饶的想象力。The writer had a fecund imagination that produced countless stories. 作家有富饶的想象力创作了无数故事。 | fecundus->肥沃（拉丁），fecund->多产肥沃的（cf. fecundity多产，fertile肥沃，infecund不育，prolific多产） || 文化联想：江南“鱼米之乡”土地肥沃、物产丰盛，很适合联想到 fecund，可以说 **fecund farmland — “The river plains of the lower Yangtze have long supported fecund farmland rich in rice and other crops.”**

quiz.question: rubicund ____
quiz.explanation: 红润的，红润的脸。The jolly man had a rubicund face. 快活的男人有红润的脸。 | rubic->红色（拉丁ruber），rubicund->红润的（cf. ruby红宝石，rubric红色标题，rouge胭脂，rubella风疹=小红点） || 文化联想：年画里的弥勒佛常被画得脸色红润、笑容满面，可以说 **a rubicund face — “The jovial figure in the New Year painting had a round, rubicund face glowing with good health.”**

quiz.question: jocund ____
quiz.explanation: 欢乐的，欢乐的心情。He was in a jocund mood at the party. 他在派对上心情欢乐的心情。 | jocus->笑话（拉丁），jocund->充满笑话的=欢乐的（cf. joke笑话，jocular开玩笑的，jocose诙谐，juggler杂耍=玩笑者） || 文化联想：庙会上锣鼓喧天、人人喜笑颜开的欢乐气氛很适合联想到 jocund，可以说 **a jocund mood — “Drums, lanterns, and laughter put the whole temple fair in a jocund mood.”**

quiz.question: hidebound _______
quiz.explanation: 顽固的，顽固的思维。His hidebound mindset prevented innovation. 他顽固的思维阻止了创新。 | hide->兽皮，bound->绑，hidebound->皮肤紧绷无法生长=顽固保守的（cf. hide皮肤，bind绑，tightly bound紧绷，narrow-minded心胸狭窄） || 文化联想：“老古板”死守旧规矩、对新事物一概排斥，很适合联想到 hidebound，可以说 **a hidebound mindset — “A hidebound mindset rejects new ideas simply because they differ from long-established custom.”**

quiz.question: confound ____________
quiz.explanation: 使困惑，使预期困惑。The results would confound expectations of the experts. 结果会使专家的预期困惑。 | con->共同，found->底部（拉丁fundere->倒），confound->把底部倒混=使困惑（cf. profound深刻，fund基金，foundation基础，confuse混淆） || 文化联想：中国灯谜里有些谜面会把猜谜的人绕得晕头转向，可以用 confound 来形容，可以说 **confound the guessers — “The clever lantern riddle managed to confound the guessers until a child suddenly saw the answer.”**

quiz.question: profound _______
quiz.explanation: 深刻的，深刻的见解。The philosopher offered profound insight into human nature. 哲学家对人性提供了深刻的见解。 | pro->向前/向深，found->底部（拉丁fundus），profound->深入到底部的=深刻的（cf. fund基金，foundation基础，confound混淆） || 文化联想：《道德经》短短数千字却包含许多意味深远的哲理，很适合联想到 profound，可以说 **a profound insight — “The Dao De Jing often expresses a profound insight in only a few compact lines.”**

quiz.question: ________ compound
quiz.explanation: 化合物，化学化合物。The laboratory analyzed the chemical compound. 实验室分析了化学化合物。 | com->共同，pound->放置（拉丁ponere），compound->放在一起=混合物（cf. compose作曲，deposit存款，expose暴露，compound fracture复杂骨折） || 文化联想：中药“复方”由多味药材组合而成，很适合帮助记忆 compound，可以说 **a herbal compound — “The physician prepared a herbal compound by combining several ingredients according to a traditional formula.”**

quiz.question: unsound _________
quiz.explanation: 不健全的，不健全的推理。His argument was based on unsound reasoning. 他的论点基于不健全的推理。 | un->否定，sound->健全（古法语sain->健康），unsound->不健全的（cf. sound声音/健全，soundness健全，unsound mind精神不健全） || 文化联想：“地基不牢，地动山摇”可以帮助记忆 unsound 的“不稳固”，可以说 **an unsound foundation — “A house built on an unsound foundation may crack or collapse even if its walls look strong.”**

quiz.question: rotund ______
quiz.explanation: 圆胖的，圆胖的身材。The rotund figure of the chef was recognizable. 厨师圆胖的身材很容易辨认。 | rotund->圆形（拉丁rotundus），rotund->圆滚滚的（cf. round圆，rotate旋转，rotunda圆形大厅，orotund洪亮） || 文化联想：年画里的弥勒佛常有圆滚滚、福态十足的身材，很适合联想到 rotund，可以说 **a rotund figure — “The smiling Maitreya in folk art is often portrayed as a cheerful, rotund figure.”**

quiz.question: orotund _____
quiz.explanation: 洪亮的，洪亮的声音。The speaker had an orotund voice that filled the hall. 演讲者有洪亮的声音充满了大厅。 | oro->嘴（拉丁os/oris），rotund->圆润，orotund->声音圆润充满口腔的=洪亮的（cf. oral口语，orator演说家，oratory演讲术） || 文化联想：京剧老生“声若洪钟、字正腔圆”的唱腔很适合联想到 orotund，可以说 **an orotund voice — “The veteran Peking-opera singer filled the theater with an orotund voice that was rich, rounded, and powerful.”**

quiz.question: slipshod ____
quiz.explanation: 马虎的，马虎的工作。The contractor's slipshod work needed redoing. 承包商马虎的工作需要重做。 | slip->滑，shod->穿鞋，slipshod->穿着拖鞋走路=马虎的（cf. slip滑，shoe鞋，shoddy劣质，slovenly邋遢） || 文化联想：中文“敷衍了事”形容做事粗糙马虎，很适合联想到 slipshod，可以说 **slipshod work — “The hastily repaired wall was a piece of slipshod work that had to be rebuilt.”**

quiz.question: plod _____
quiz.explanation: 沉重地走，沉重地走。The tired workers would plod along the muddy road. 疲惫的工人会在泥泞的路上沉重地走。 | plod->沉重行走（来源不明，可能象声），plod->沉重缓慢地走（cf. trudge费力行走，slog艰苦跋涉，plod vs stroll散步） || 文化联想：旧时挑夫肩扛重担、一步一步艰难赶路的样子很适合联想到 plod，可以说 **plod along — “Bent under a heavy load, the porter plodded along the mountain road one slow step at a time.”**

quiz.question: ______ falsehood
quiz.explanation: 谎言，传播谎言。The malicious person would spread falsehood about others. 恶意的人会传播关于他人的谎言。 | false->假，hood->状态/性质，falsehood->虚假的状态=谎言（cf. false假，fallacy谬误，falsify伪造，manhood男子气概） || 文化联想：“指鹿为马”最适合联想到故意颠倒事实的 falsehood，可以说 **a deliberate falsehood — “Calling a deer a horse is a classic image of a deliberate falsehood imposed on others.”**

quiz.question: ____ hardihood
quiz.explanation: 大胆，显示大胆。The explorers would show hardihood in facing dangers. 探险者会在面对危险时显示大胆。 | hardy->强壮（古法语hardi->大胆），hood->性质，hardihood->大胆的性质（cf. hardy耐寒，hardship艰难，likelihood可能性） || 文化联想：“明知山有虎，偏向虎山行”最适合联想到 hardihood，可以说 **remarkable hardihood — “The saying ‘knowing there is a tiger on the mountain, yet going there anyway’ expresses remarkable hardihood in the face of danger.”**

quiz.question: ___ pod
quiz.explanation: 豆荚，豌豆豆荚。The pea pod contained several seeds. 豌豆豆荚里有几颗种子。 | pod->豆荚（来源不明），pod->长形容器（cf. podium讲台=脚站的地方，pod播客节目，pea pod豌豆荚，escape pod逃生舱） || 文化联想：农家晒豆时能看到一串串鼓起的豆荚，很适合联想到 pod，可以说 **a bean pod — “The farmer split open a dry bean pod and shook the seeds into a basket.”**

quiz.question: prod ____ ______
quiz.explanation: 刺激，刺激采取行动。The crisis would prod into action the government. 危机会刺激政府采取行动。 | prod->刺（来源不明），prod->用尖物刺激=激励（cf. prick刺，goad驱使，spur激励，prod sb into doing sth刺激某人做某事） || 文化联想：农夫用竹竿轻轻戳牛、催它往前走的动作很适合联想到 prod，可以说 **prod the ox forward — “When the ox stopped in the field, the farmer used a stick to prod it forward.”**

quiz.question: sod ____
quiz.explanation: 草皮，草皮农场。The sod farm supplied turf for lawns. 草皮农场为草坪供应草皮。 | sod->草皮（中古荷兰语sode），sod->连根的草地（cf. sod lawn草坪，turf草皮，sodden湿透的=像浸透的草皮） || 文化联想：传统院落里整块连根带土铺下的草皮可以用 sod 来描述，可以说 **lay fresh sod — “To restore the courtyard lawn, workers laid fresh sod over the bare earth.”**

quiz.question: _________ bard
quiz.explanation: 吟游诗人，流浪的吟游诗人。The wandering bard sang tales of heroes. 流浪的吟游诗人唱英雄的故事。 | bard->诗人（凯尔特语bardos->歌颂者），bard->吟游诗人（cf. the Bard=Shakespeare，bardic诗人的，minstrel游吟诗人） || 文化联想：中国古代说书人和弹唱艺人四处讲唱英雄传奇，很适合联想到 bard，可以说 **a wandering bard — “A wandering bard in a Chinese market town might sing old tales of heroes while accompanying himself on a stringed instrument.”**

quiz.question: discard _____
quiz.explanation: 丢弃，丢弃垃圾。Please discard trash in the proper bin. 请在适当的垃圾箱中丢弃垃圾。 | dis->否定，card->牌（拉丁charta），discard->把牌丢掉=丢弃（cf. card纸牌，discard丢掉，carton纸箱，chart图表） || 文化联想：打麻将时把不需要的牌打出去，就是 discard 最直观的联想，可以说 **discard a tile — “After drawing a new tile, the player discarded one that no longer fit the hand.”**

quiz.question: ______ disregard
quiz.explanation: 漠视，漫不经心的漠视。His blithe disregard for rules caused problems. 他对规则漫不经心的漠视造成了问题。 | dis->否定，regard->注意（re+gard->再看），disregard->不再注意=漠视（cf. regard注意，regardless不管，regardless of不顾） || 文化联想：中文“当耳旁风”就是明明听见却完全不理会，很适合联想到 disregard，可以说 **disregard a warning — “He treated the elder’s warning like wind passing his ear and simply disregarded it.”**

quiz.question: haggard ____
quiz.explanation: 憔悴的，憔悴的脸。After days without sleep, she had a haggard face. 几天没睡后，她有憔悴的脸。 | haggard->未驯化的鹰（法语，野生的），haggard->像野鹰一样憔悴的（cf. haggard鹰的训练术语，gaunt消瘦，drawn憔悴，worn磨损） || 文化联想：连续熬夜赶工后面色憔悴、眼窝深陷，可以说 **a haggard face — “After several sleepless nights preparing for the examination, the student had a haggard face and dark circles under his eyes.”**

quiz.question: laggard _______
quiz.explanation: 落后的，落后的经济。The laggard economy needed stimulus measures. 落后的经济需要刺激措施。 | lag->落后（来源不明），laggard->落在后面的人/经济（cf. lag落后，straggle散落，trailing落后，lagging behind落后） || 文化联想：中文“拖后腿”形容总是落在别人后面，很适合联想到 laggard，可以说 **a laggard in the group — “While the others moved quickly, he remained the laggard in the group and arrived last every time.”**

quiz.question: ______ niggard
quiz.explanation: 吝啬鬼，吝啬的吝啬鬼。The stingy niggard refused to donate anything. 吝啬的吝啬鬼拒绝捐赠任何东西。 | niggard->吝啬（古挪威hnøggr->吝啬），niggard->极度吝啬的人（cf. niggardly吝啬，stingy吝啬，miser守财奴，pennypincher吝啬鬼） || 文化联想：“铁公鸡——一毛不拔”也可以形容极端吝啬的 niggard，可以说 **a miserly niggard — “The old joke about an ‘iron rooster that will not lose a feather’ describes a miserly niggard who hates spending even a coin.”**

quiz.question: ____ sluggard
quiz.explanation: 懒汉，懒惰的懒汉。The lazy sluggard avoided all work. 懒惰的懒汉逃避所有工作。 | slug->蛞蝓（古挪威sluggr->懒），sluggard->像蛞蝓一样慢的人=懒汉（cf. slug蛞蝓/打击，sluggish迟缓，slothful懒惰，indolent懒散） || 文化联想：民间说“好吃懒做”，最容易联想到 sluggard，可以说 **a lazy sluggard — “The lazy sluggard spent the day lying around while everyone else worked in the fields.”**

quiz.question: diehard ___
quiz.explanation: 死忠，死忠粉丝。He was a diehard fan who never missed a game. 他是从不错过比赛的死忠粉丝。 | die->死，hard->难，diehard->难以死去的=死忠的（cf. die-hard顽固不化，hardcore死忠，diehard conservative铁杆保守派） || 文化联想：跟随一支球队几十年、无论输赢都不离不弃的球迷可以用 diehard 来形容，可以说 **a diehard fan — “He remained a diehard fan of the team through years of defeats as well as victories.”**

quiz.question: ________ blowhard
quiz.explanation: 吹牛者，自夸的吹牛者。The boastful blowhard exaggerated his achievements. 自夸的吹牛者夸大了他的成就。 | blow->吹，hard->用力，blowhard->用力吹的人=吹牛者（cf. braggart自夸者，boaster吹嘘者，windbag废话连篇者） || 文化联想：酒桌上有人把自己的本事吹得天花乱坠，就是典型 blowhard，可以说 **a boastful blowhard — “At the banquet, the boastful blowhard claimed he knew every important person in the city.”**

quiz.question: _____ dullard
quiz.explanation: 笨蛋，完全的笨蛋。He was considered an utter dullard by his classmates. 他被同学认为是完全的笨蛋。 | dull->迟钝，ard->人（贬义后缀），dullard->迟钝的人（cf. dull迟钝，drunkard酒鬼，dotard老糊涂，braggart自夸者） || 文化联想：旧式私塾里被先生骂作“榆木脑袋”的迟钝学生可以用 dullard 来形容，可以说 **an utter dullard — “The impatient teacher dismissed the slow student as an utter dullard who never seemed to understand the lesson.”**

quiz.question: ______ _ canard
quiz.explanation: 谣言，传播谣言。The tabloid would spread a canard about the celebrity. 小报会传播关于名人的谣言。 | canard->鸭子（法语），canard->谣言（来自法语谚语"卖半只鸭子"=行骗）（cf. duck回避，canard法语鸭=谣言，hoax骗局） || 文化联想：“三人成虎”讲的就是谣言反复传播后竟让人信以为真，很适合联想到 canard，可以说 **a persistent canard — “The story of ‘three men make a tiger’ shows how a persistent canard can come to seem true through repetition.”**

quiz.question: aboveboard ____
quiz.explanation: 光明正大的，光明正大的交易。The business conducted an aboveboard deal. 企业进行了光明正大的交易。 | above->在...上，board->桌面，aboveboard->在桌面上=公开的（原指赌博时把手放在桌上=没有作弊，cf. under the table桌下=非法） || 文化联想：传统商号讲究“明码标价、童叟无欺”，最适合联想到 aboveboard，可以说 **an aboveboard deal — “A merchant who posts a clear price and treats every customer fairly is conducting an aboveboard deal.”**

quiz.question: hoard ____
quiz.explanation: 囤积，囤积现金。Some people hoard cash during economic uncertainty. 有些人在经济不确定时期囤积现金。 | hoard->贮藏（古英语hord->宝库），hoard->秘密囤积（cf. hoard囤积，treasure宝藏，stockpile储备，hoarding广告牌=在墙上藏的东西） || 文化联想：经历过物资短缺的一些老人会把粮食和现金攒着舍不得用，这种行为可以说 **hoard supplies — “After years of hardship, some families became accustomed to hoarding supplies for fear of future shortages.”**

quiz.question: retard ______
quiz.explanation: 阻碍，阻碍增长。Poor soil conditions can retard growth of plants. 土壤条件差会阻碍植物的增长。 | re->向后，tard->慢（拉丁tardus），retard->使变慢=阻碍（cf. tardy迟到，dilatory拖延，retardant阻燃剂，retardation减速） || 文化联想：“拔苗助长”反而让庄稼受损，最适合联想到 retard，可以说 **retard growth — “Pulling seedlings upward to make them grow faster only damages them and retards their growth.”**

quiz.question: ________ dastard
quiz.explanation: 懦夫，懦弱的懦夫。The cowardly dastard fled from battle. 懦弱的懦夫从战场逃跑了。 | dastard->懦弱（古挪威dæstr->疲惫），dastard->懦弱卑鄙的人（cf. dastardly卑鄙，coward懦夫，poltroon胆小鬼，craven懦弱） || 文化联想：古代战场上临阵脱逃、丢下同袍独自逃命的人可以用 dastard 来形容，可以说 **a cowardly dastard — “The soldier who abandoned his comrades and fled at the first sign of danger was condemned as a cowardly dastard.”**

quiz.question: safeguard _______
quiz.explanation: 保护，保护隐私。New laws aim to safeguard privacy online. 新法律旨在保护网上隐私。 | safe->安全，guard->守卫，safeguard->安全守卫=保护（cf. guard守卫，guardian守护者，bodyguard保镖，lifeguard救生员） || 文化联想：古代城墙、城门和护城河共同构成保卫城市的体系，可以说 **safeguard the city — “Walls, gates, and a moat were built to safeguard the city against attack.”**

quiz.question: leeward ____
quiz.explanation: 背风的，背风的一侧。The sailors anchored on the leeward side of the island. 水手们在岛屿的背风的一侧下锚。 | lee->背风（古英语hleo->庇护），ward->方向，leeward->背风方向（cf. windward迎风，leeway余地，ward病房，towards朝向） || 文化联想：古代帆船常选择岛屿背风面停泊以避开强风，可以说 **the leeward side — “The sailors anchored on the leeward side of the island, where the hills sheltered them from the wind.”**

quiz.question: untoward ________
quiz.explanation: 不幸的，不幸的事件。An untoward incident marred the celebration. 不幸的事件破坏了庆祝活动。 | un->否定，toward->朝向，untoward->不顺的=不幸的（cf. toward朝向，towards朝向，awkward笨拙，froward任性反抗的） || 文化联想：中文“横生枝节”常形容突然冒出的麻烦和不顺，可以说 **an untoward incident — “The celebration was interrupted by an untoward incident that no one had expected.”**

quiz.question: straightforward ______
quiz.explanation: 直截了当的，直截了当的回答。She gave a straightforward answer to the question. 她对问题给出了直截了当的回答。 | straight->直，forward->向前，straightforward->笔直向前=直截了当的（cf. forward向前，straighten弄直，blunt直率） || 文化联想：北方人常被形容为“有一说一、不绕弯子”，很适合联想到 straightforward，可以说 **a straightforward manner — “He answered in a straightforward manner, saying exactly what he thought without beating around the bush.”**

quiz.question: _________ hazard
quiz.explanation: 危险，工作场所危险。Unsafe equipment is a workplace hazard. 不安全的设备是工作场所危险。 | az-zahr->骰子（阿拉伯语），hazard->掷骰子的机会=危险（cf. haphazard随意=随机掷骰，hazardous危险的，risk风险） || 文化联想：旧时矿井里瓦斯、塌方等都是矿工必须警惕的危险，可以说 **a serious hazard — “Gas buildup in an underground mine can become a serious hazard for workers.”**

quiz.question: haphazard ________
quiz.explanation: 随意的，随意的方法。His haphazard approach led to poor results. 他随意的方法导致了糟糕的结果。 | hap->运气（古挪威happ），hazard->骰子，haphazard->完全靠运气掷骰子=随意的（cf. happen发生，perhaps也许，mishap不幸） || 文化联想：老集市摊位东一处西一处、全无规划的布局很适合联想到 haphazard，可以说 **a haphazard arrangement — “The stalls had grown into a haphazard arrangement with narrow paths twisting in every direction.”**

quiz.question: _ herd __ ______
quiz.explanation: 群，一群牛。A herd of cattle grazed in the pasture. 一群牛在牧场上吃草。 | herd->兽群（古英语heord），herd->牧养的动物群（cf. herd mentality从众心理，shepherd牧羊人，cowherd牧牛人） || 文化联想：内蒙古草原上成群牛羊一起移动的景象最适合联想到 herd，可以说 **a herd of cattle — “The herder guided a large herd of cattle across the grassland at sunset.”**

quiz.question: undergird _________
quiz.explanation: 支撑，支撑论点。Strong evidence should undergird arguments. 强有力的证据应该支撑论点。 | under->在下，gird->围绕（古英语gyrdan），undergird->在下面围绕支撑=支撑（cf. gird围绕，girder大梁，girth腰围，girdle腰带） || 文化联想：传统木建筑中隐藏的承重构件从下方托住整体，很适合联想到 undergird，可以说 **undergird the structure — “Heavy wooden supports undergird the structure and help carry the weight of the roof.”**

quiz.question: _____ cord
quiz.explanation: 电线，电源线。The power cord was too short to reach the outlet. 电源线太短无法够到插座。 | cord->绳（拉丁chorda->肠弦），cord->线/绳（cf. chord和弦，cordon封锁线，corduroy灯芯绒，vocal cords声带） || 文化联想：古人把麻纤维搓成结实绳索用于捆扎和吊运，可以说 **a hemp cord — “The porter tied the bundle with a strong hemp cord before lifting it onto the cart.”**

quiz.question: _____ accord
quiz.explanation: 协议，达成协议。The negotiators worked to reach accord. 谈判者努力达成协议。 | ac->朝向，cord->心（拉丁cor），accord->心与心对齐=协议（cf. concord和谐，discord不和，record记录，cordial热情=发自内心） || 文化联想：两方多年冲突后终于握手言和、达成协议，很适合联想到 accord，可以说 **reach an accord — “After months of negotiation, the two clans finally reached an accord and ended their dispute.”**

quiz.question: ________ concord
quiz.explanation: 和谐，国家和谐。The treaty promoted national concord. 该条约促进了国家和谐。 | con->共同，cord->心，concord->心与心相合=和谐（cf. accord协议，discord不和，record记录=re+cord=再次用心，concordance一致） || 文化联想：“和为贵”最适合帮助记忆 concord，可以说 **live in concord — “The old saying that harmony is precious encourages neighbors to live in concord rather than quarrel.”**

quiz.question: ford ___ _____
quiz.explanation: 涉水而过，涉水过河。The travelers had to ford the river on horseback. 旅行者不得不骑马涉水过河。 | ford->浅滩（古英语ford->可涉水处），ford->涉水过浅滩（cf. Oxford牛津=牛的浅滩，afford负担得起=提供通道，ford渡过） || 文化联想：古代没有桥时，人们会从浅水处直接涉水过河，可以说 **ford a river — “The caravan waited for the water to fall before attempting to ford the river.”**

quiz.question: ______ chord
quiz.explanation: 和弦，吉他和弦。The musician strummed a guitar chord. 音乐家弹奏了吉他和弦。 | chorda->肠弦（希腊），chord->几个音符同时发出（cf. cord绳，chord和弦，vocal cords声带，accord协议） || 文化联想：古筝或琵琶演奏中几个音同时和谐响起，可以帮助记忆 chord，可以说 **a resonant chord — “The musician struck a resonant chord that lingered in the hall after her fingers left the strings.”**

quiz.question: ____ harpsichord
quiz.explanation: 大键琴，演奏大键琴。The baroque musician would play harpsichord. 巴洛克音乐家会演奏大键琴。 | harpe->钩/竖琴（古法语），chord->弦，harpsichord->用钩拨弦的乐器=大键琴（cf. harp竖琴，chord和弦，harpy有翼怪兽=用钩抓） || 文化联想：中国早期西洋音乐教育中出现的大键琴属于外来古典乐器，可以说 **play the harpsichord — “At a concert of early European music in Shanghai, the musician played the harpsichord with its bright, plucked tone.”**

quiz.question: ____ foreword
quiz.explanation: 前言，书的前言。A famous author wrote the book foreword. 一位著名作家写了书的前言。 | fore->之前，word->话语，foreword->在前面的话语=前言（cf. forward向前，preface前言，introduction介绍，prologue序言） || 文化联想：古籍正文前常有作者、编者或名家所作序言，很适合联想到 foreword，可以说 **write a foreword — “A respected scholar was invited to write a foreword explaining the purpose and background of the new edition.”**

quiz.question: curd ______
quiz.explanation: 凝乳，凝乳奶酪。Curd cheese is used in many recipes. 凝乳奶酪用于许多食谱。 | curd->凝固（古英语crud->凝固物），curd->牛奶凝固的固体（cf. curdle凝结，cottage cheese农家奶酪，Little Miss Muffet吃凝乳的人） || 文化联想：云南乳饼等食品由乳汁凝固形成，很适合联想到 curd，可以说 **fresh milk curd — “The cheesemaker pressed fresh milk curd into firm cakes similar to Yunnan rushan or rubing.”**

quiz.question: defraud _________
quiz.explanation: 欺诈，欺诈投资者。The scheme aimed to defraud investors of millions. 该计划旨在欺诈投资者数百万。 | de->否，fraud->欺骗（拉丁fraus），defraud->欺骗剥夺（cf. fraud欺诈，fraudulent欺诈性的，deceptive欺骗性的） || 文化联想：“骗取钱财”就是 defraud 最直接的意思，可以说 **defraud an elderly victim — “The scammers pretended to be officials in order to defraud an elderly victim of her savings.”**

quiz.question: ______ feud
quiz.explanation: 世仇，家族世仇。The family feud lasted for generations. 家族世仇持续了几代人。 | feud->世仇（古高德语fehida->敌意），feud->世代仇恨（cf. vendetta血仇，feud long-running dispute，feudal封建=以领地换效忠） || 文化联想：古代宗族之间因土地、婚姻或旧怨结成数代世仇，很适合联想到 feud，可以说 **a long-running family feud — “A quarrel over ancestral land grew into a long-running family feud that lasted for generations.”**

quiz.question: _______ astrolabe
quiz.explanation: 星盘，古代星盘。Sailors used an ancient astrolabe for navigation. 水手们使用古代星盘进行导航。 | astro->星（希腊），lab->拿取（希腊lambanein），astrolabe->拿取星星=星盘（cf. astronomy天文，astrology占星，asterisk星号） || 文化联想：中国古代也曾吸收和使用外来天文仪器与观测方法，星盘可以放在这种中西交流语境中记忆，可以说 **an astronomical astrolabe — “Astronomers working in imperial China encountered instruments such as the astronomical astrolabe through exchanges with Islamic astronomy.”**

quiz.question: imbibe _______
quiz.explanation: 吸收，吸收文化。Living abroad allowed her to imbibe culture deeply. 在国外生活让她深入吸收文化。 | im->进入，bibe->喝（拉丁bibere），imbibe->喝进去=吸收（cf. imbibe饮/吸收，beverage饮料，beer啤酒，bibulous爱饮酒的） || 文化联想：中国文人品茶讲究慢饮细品，也可以帮助记忆 imbibe，可以说 **imbibe tea slowly — “The guests sat in the teahouse and imbibed the tea slowly while discussing poetry and calligraphy.”**

quiz.question: _____ gibe
quiz.explanation: 嘲讽，互相嘲讽。The rivals would trade gibe during debates. 对手会在辩论中互相嘲讽。 | gibe->嘲弄（可能来自法语giber->玩耍），gibe->嘲弄（cf. jibe一致/嘲弄，taunt嘲弄，jeer嘲笑，gibe at讥笑） || 文化联想：相声里一方故意挖苦搭档、抖一句带刺的包袱，很适合联想到 gibe，可以说 **a playful gibe — “The comic answered his partner with a playful gibe that made the audience laugh.”**

quiz.question: jibe ____ _____
quiz.explanation: 一致，与事实一致。His story didn't jibe with facts. 他的故事与事实不一致。 | jibe->一致（来源不明，可能来自gybe帆船转向），jibe->与...一致（cf. tally相符，accord一致，square with与...相符） || 文化联想：中文说“两边口径对得上”，就是两种说法彼此吻合，可以用 jibe 表达，可以说 **the accounts jibe — “After the witnesses were questioned separately, their accounts jibed on the main details.”**

quiz.question: _____ _ bribe
quiz.explanation: 贿赂，提供贿赂。It is illegal to offer a bribe to officials. 向官员提供贿赂是非法的。 | bribe->面包碎屑（古法语bribe->乞讨的面包），bribe->用好处收买人（cf. bribery贿赂，corruption腐败，kickback回扣） || 文化联想：古代“打点衙门”指送钱求方便，最适合联想到 bribe，可以说 **offer a bribe — “The merchant tried to offer a bribe to the clerk in hopes of speeding up the permit.”**

quiz.question: ascribe __
quiz.explanation: 归因于，归因于。We can ascribe to his success to hard work. 我们可以将他的成功归因于努力工作。 | a->朝向，scribe->写（拉丁scribere），ascribe->写在某人名下=归因于（cf. describe描述，prescribe开处方，subscribe订阅，inscribe刻写） || 文化联想：古人常把丰收归功于“风调雨顺”或上天庇佑，可以说 **ascribe the harvest to Heaven — “Villagers might ascribe a good harvest to favorable weather and the blessing of Heaven.”**

quiz.question: circumscribe ______
quiz.explanation: 限制，限制权力。The constitution seeks to circumscribe powers of government. 宪法试图限制政府的权力。 | circum->周围，scribe->写，circumscribe->在周围画线=限制（cf. circumference周长，circumnavigate环绕航行，circumspect谨慎） || 文化联想：“画地为牢”就是用边界把人的活动范围限制起来，很适合联想到 circumscribe，可以说 **circumscribe someone’s freedom — “To ‘draw a circle as a prison’ is a vivid image of how rules can circumscribe someone’s freedom.”**

quiz.question: transcribe _____
quiz.explanation: 抄写，抄写笔记。The assistant would transcribe notes from the meeting. 助理会抄写会议的笔记。 | trans->跨越，scribe->写，transcribe->把声音跨越写下=抄写/转录（cf. transcript转录本，translation翻译，transcription转录） || 文化联想：古代史官把口述、奏报或旧稿重新誊写成正式文字，可以说 **transcribe an account — “The court scribe carefully transcribed the witness’s account into the official record.”**

quiz.question: inscribe _ ____
quiz.explanation: 刻写，刻写名字。They would inscribe a name on the memorial. 他们会在纪念碑上刻写名字。 | in->在...上，scribe->写，inscribe->在上面写=刻写（cf. inscription铭文，manuscript手稿，inscription纪念铭文） || 文化联想：青铜器和石碑上的铭文都是把文字永久刻上去的结果，可以说 **inscribe a text — “The craftsman inscribed the commemorative text onto the bronze vessel so that it would endure for generations.”**

quiz.question: proscribe _ ________
quiz.explanation: 禁止，禁止做法。The law would proscribe a practice deemed harmful. 法律会禁止被认为有害的做法。 | pro->向前/公开，scribe->写，proscribe->公开写出放逐名单=禁止/放逐（cf. prescribe开处方，subscribe订阅，proscription放逐令） || 文化联想：古代朝廷明令禁书、禁教或禁止某种行为，可以用 proscribe 来表达，可以说 **proscribe a practice — “The authorities issued an order to proscribe the practice and punish anyone who continued it.”**

quiz.question: adobe _____
quiz.explanation: 土坯，土坯房子。The adobe house kept cool in the desert heat. 土坯房子在沙漠炎热中保持凉爽。 | adobe->土砖（西班牙语，来自阿拉伯语at-tub->土砖），adobe->晒干的泥砖（cf. Adobe软件公司=以土坯命名，mud brick土砖） || 文化联想：中国西北一些传统民居使用晒干的泥土或土坯筑墙，很适合联想到 adobe，可以说 **an adobe house — “In an arid northwestern village, families built an adobe house from sun-dried earth blocks.”**

quiz.question: ________ lobe
quiz.explanation: 叶，颞叶。The temporal lobe processes auditory information. 颞叶处理听觉信息。 | lobos->荚/圆形（希腊），lobe->圆形突出物（cf. earlobe耳垂，lobule小叶，lobotomy脑叶切除术，lobe of lung肺叶） || 文化联想：中医耳穴疗法常会刺激耳垂等部位，很适合帮助记忆 lobe，可以说 **the earlobe — “In auricular therapy, a practitioner may press points on the earlobe and other parts of the outer ear.”**

quiz.question: _______ microbe
quiz.explanation: 微生物，有害的微生物。Harmful microbe can cause disease. 有害的微生物会导致疾病。 | micro->微小（希腊），bio->生命，microbe->微小的生命体=微生物（cf. microbiology微生物学，bacteria细菌，germ病菌） || 文化联想：中国传统发酵食品制作中，人们虽然看不见微生物，却一直依赖它们发挥作用，可以说 **a useful microbe — “A useful microbe can help transform soybeans, milk, or vegetables during fermentation even though it is invisible to the naked eye.”**

quiz.question: _____-__ wardrobe
quiz.explanation: 衣柜，嵌入式衣柜。The bedroom featured a built-in wardrobe. 卧室有嵌入式衣柜。 | ward->保管（古法语warder->守护），robe->长袍，wardrobe->保管长袍的地方=衣柜（cf. ward病房，warden管理者，guardian守护者） || 文化联想：古代大户人家会用大型衣柜存放四季衣物和绸缎，可以说 **a wooden wardrobe — “The family stored winter robes and silk garments in a large wooden wardrobe.”**

quiz.question: _____ probe
quiz.explanation: 探测器，太空探测器。The space probe sent back images from Mars. 太空探测器从火星发回图像。 | prob->证明/测试（拉丁probare），probe->检验探测的仪器（cf. prove证明，probe探查，approve批准，reprove责备，proof证明） || 文化联想：中医“切脉”体现的是深入检查和探查身体状况的思路，很适合联想到 probe，可以说 **probe for clues — “By carefully examining the pulse, the physician tried to probe for clues about the patient’s condition.”**

quiz.question: deface ________
quiz.explanation: 损坏，损坏财产。It is a crime to deface property with graffiti. 用涂鸦损坏财产是犯罪。 | de->去除，face->面貌，deface->损毁表面=毁容/破坏（cf. face面，efface抹去，surface表面，facade外观） || 文化联想：名胜古迹上乱刻“到此一游”就是典型的 deface，可以说 **deface a monument — “Carving one’s name into an ancient wall can permanently deface a historic monument.”**

quiz.question: ____ preface
quiz.explanation: 序言，书的序言。The author wrote a thoughtful book preface explaining his motivations. 作者写了一篇深思熟虑的书的序言解释他的动机。 | pre->之前，fac->说（拉丁fari），preface->在正文之前说的话=序言（cf. fable寓言，fabulous神话般，infant婴儿=不会说话） || 文化联想：古典章回小说常在正文前由作者交代写作缘起，这种开篇文字可以说 **a preface to the novel — “The author used the preface to explain why he had written the story and what readers should expect.”**

quiz.question: efface _ ______
quiz.explanation: 抹去，抹去记忆。Time cannot efface a memory of such profound loss. 时间无法抹去如此深刻损失的记忆。 | ef->向外，face->面（拉丁facies），efface->抹去面貌=消除（cf. face面，deface损坏，surface表面，facade正面，effacement抹去） || 文化联想：古碑上的字迹经过千百年风化会逐渐磨灭，可以说 **efface the inscription — “Centuries of wind and rain had almost effaced the inscription on the ancient stone stele.”**

quiz.question: commonplace _____
quiz.explanation: 平凡的，平凡的真理。It is a commonplace truth that practice makes perfect. 熟能生巧是平凡的真理。 | common->共同，place->地方，commonplace->大家共同的地方=平凡的（cf. common普通，commonwealth共同财富，commonplace陈词滥调） || 文化联想：“熟能生巧”是中国人耳熟能详、并不新鲜的常识，可以说 **a commonplace truth — “In Chinese culture, ‘practice makes perfect’ is a commonplace truth repeated by teachers and parents alike.”**

quiz.question: displace _________
quiz.explanation: 取代，取代居民。The dam construction would displace residents from their homes. 大坝建设会将居民从家园中取代。 | dis->否定，place->位置，displace->离开位置=取代/迁移（cf. replace替换，misplace放错，displace取代，displacement位移） || 文化联想：三峡工程蓄水后部分库区居民需要迁离故土，这种被迫迁移可以说 **displace local residents — “The reservoir project displaced many local residents who had to move away from their old villages.”**

quiz.question: _______ interlace
quiz.explanation: 交织，线交织。The colorful threads interlace to form a beautiful pattern. 彩色的线交织形成美丽的图案。 | inter->互相，lace->细绳/编织（拉丁laqueus->绳套），interlace->互相编织（cf. lace花边，shoelace鞋带，enlace缠绕，interlace交织） || 文化联想：苏绣中不同颜色的丝线彼此穿插形成精细图案，可以说 **interlaced silk threads — “In Suzhou embroidery, interlaced silk threads create delicate flowers, birds, and landscapes.”**

quiz.question: _____ populace
quiz.explanation: 民众，城市民众。The urban populace demanded better public services. 城市民众要求更好的公共服务。 | popul->人民（拉丁populus），populace->普通大众（cf. popular受欢迎，population人口，populist民粹主义，populous人口密集） || 文化联想：古代京城庙会时普通百姓挤满街巷，可以说 **the urban populace — “During a major temple fair, the urban populace poured into the streets to watch performances and buy festival goods.”**

quiz.question: _______ menace
quiz.explanation: 威胁，迫在眉睫的威胁。A looming menace threatened the peace of the region. 迫在眉睫的威胁威胁着该地区的和平。 | minae->威胁（拉丁minari->恐吓），menace->悬在头上的威胁（cf. minatory威胁的，imminence迫近，imminent即将来临，threaten威胁） || 文化联想：边关烽火一旦燃起，意味着外敌威胁正在逼近，可以说 **a looming menace — “Smoke rising from the frontier beacon towers warned the capital of a looming menace.”**

quiz.question: _____ furnace
quiz.explanation: 熔炉，高炉。The blast furnace produced molten iron. 高炉生产熔铁。 | fornus->烤炉（拉丁），furnace->大型加热炉（cf. fornication通奸=原指炉膛旁聚会，fornicator=在炉旁者，oven烤箱） || 文化联想：古代冶铁作坊里熊熊燃烧的大炉子最适合联想到 furnace，可以说 **an iron-smelting furnace — “The craftsmen fed charcoal into the iron-smelting furnace until the metal glowed red.”**

quiz.question: ________ carapace
quiz.explanation: 甲壳，乌龟甲壳。The tortoise carapace provided protection. 乌龟甲壳提供保护。 | carapace->甲壳（西班牙语carapacho，来源不明），carapace->背部的甲壳（cf. shell壳，exoskeleton外骨骼，armor盔甲，shield盾） || 文化联想：乌龟背上的硬壳在中国文化里很常见，也最适合帮助记忆 carapace，可以说 **a tortoise carapace — “The diviner examined the tortoise carapace before it was heated and cracked for oracle-bone divination.”**

quiz.question: brace _______
quiz.explanation: 支撑，支撑自己。You must brace oneself for bad news. 你必须支撑自己准备接受坏消息。 | bracchium->手臂（拉丁），brace->手臂支撑=支架（cf. embrace拥抱=把手臂围绕，bracket括弧=支撑物，brassiere胸罩） || 文化联想：中文“咬紧牙关挺过去”就是提前绷紧自己承受冲击，可以说 **brace oneself for hardship — “He braced himself for hardship, determined to endure the difficult years ahead.”**

quiz.question: ____ embrace
quiz.explanation: 拥抱，温暖的拥抱。She greeted him with a warm embrace. 她用温暖的拥抱迎接他。 | em->使，brace->手臂，embrace->用手臂围绕=拥抱（cf. brace支撑，bracket括弧，embraceable可拥抱，all-embracing包罗万象） || 文化联想：游子多年后归乡，家人张开双臂迎接的场景可以说 **a warm embrace — “After years away from home, the returning son was welcomed with a warm embrace from his parents.”**

quiz.question: terrace ______
quiz.explanation: 梯田，梯田花园。The terrace garden overlooked the valley. 梯田花园俯瞰山谷。 | terra->土地（拉丁），terrace->土地的台阶=梯田/露台（cf. terrain地形，terrestrial陆地，territory领土，Mediterranean地中海） || 文化联想：云南哈尼梯田一层层沿山坡展开，是 terrace 最典型的中国地理联想，可以说 **terraced fields — “The Hani people carved terraced fields into the mountainsides of Yunnan over many generations.”**

quiz.question: _____ ___ fleece
quiz.explanation: 羊毛，剪羊毛。The farmers would shear the fleece in spring. 农民们会在春天剪羊毛。 | fleece->羊毛（古英语fleos），fleece->羊毛/欺骗（cf. Golden Fleece金羊毛，fleece sb坑人如剪羊毛，woolly多毛的） || 文化联想：北方牧区春季剪羊毛时，从羊身上整片剪下来的羊毛可以说 **a thick fleece — “The herder sheared a thick fleece from the sheep before the summer heat arrived.”**

quiz.question: ______ jaundice
quiz.explanation: 黄疸，婴儿黄疸。The doctor treated the infant jaundice with phototherapy. 医生用光疗治疗婴儿黄疸。 | jaune->黄色（法语，拉丁galbinus），jaundice->使皮肤变黄的病=黄疸（cf. yellow黄色，jealous嫉妒=黄色的感觉，jaundiced有偏见的） || 文化联想：中医旧称新生儿黄疸为“胎黄”，可以说 **infant jaundice — “In traditional Chinese medicine, infant jaundice was historically described as ‘胎黄,’ or yellowing in a newborn.”**

quiz.question: ______ prejudice
quiz.explanation: 偏见，种族偏见。The civil rights movement fought against racial prejudice. 民权运动反对种族偏见。 | pre->之前，judice->判断（拉丁judicare），prejudice->在了解之前就判断=偏见（cf. judge法官，judicial司法，adjudicate裁决） || 文化联想：“以貌取人”强调还没真正了解一个人就先作判断，很适合联想到 prejudice，可以说 **prejudice based on appearance — “Judging a person by looks alone is a form of prejudice based on appearance.”**

quiz.question: _____ edifice
quiz.explanation: 大厦，石头大厦。The ancient stone edifice stood for centuries. 古老的石头大厦屹立了几个世纪。 | aedis->神庙（拉丁），fic->做，edifice->建造的神庙=大厦（cf. edify启发=建造精神，edit编辑=建造文字，edifice宏伟建筑） || 文化联想：故宫太和殿这类宏伟庄严的大型建筑可以说 **a monumental edifice — “The Hall of Supreme Harmony stands as a monumental edifice at the heart of the Forbidden City.”**

quiz.question: ____ orifice
quiz.explanation: 孔，口腔孔。The oral orifice is the entrance to the digestive system. 口腔孔是消化系统的入口。 | ori->口（拉丁os/oris），fice->做/制造，orifice->口部开口（cf. oral口语，orator演说家，orifice任何开口，office官职=做事的地方） || 文化联想：中医常说人体有“九窍”，这些身体开口可以帮助记忆 orifice，可以说 **a bodily orifice — “Traditional Chinese texts often referred to the body’s openings, each of which is a bodily orifice.”**

quiz.question: ______ artifice
quiz.explanation: 技巧，巧妙的技巧。He used clever artifice to solve the problem. 他用巧妙的技巧解决了问题。 | arti->技艺（拉丁ars），fice->做，artifice->用技艺做成=技巧/诡计（cf. art艺术，artificial人工，artifact人工制品，artisan工匠） || 文化联想：《三十六计》中的瞒天过海、声东击西都属于精心设计的计谋，可以说 **a clever artifice — “The strategist relied on a clever artifice to make the enemy look in the wrong direction.”**

quiz.question: ______ chalice
quiz.explanation: 圣杯，银圣杯。The priest raised the silver chalice. 牧师举起银圣杯。 | calix->杯（拉丁），chalice->圣餐杯（cf. calyx花萼=杯形，calcium钙=石灰=白色，chalice圣杯，grail圣杯的另一说法） || 文化联想：中国传统祭器里虽然没有基督教 chalice 的对应物，但可以借青铜酒器作对比记忆，可以说 **a ritual chalice — “Unlike an ancient Chinese bronze wine vessel, a chalice is a stemmed cup used in Christian ritual.”**

quiz.question: accomplice __ _____
quiz.explanation: 共犯，犯罪共犯。He was charged as an accomplice to crime. 他被指控为犯罪共犯。 | ac->朝向，complic->折叠（拉丁complicare），accomplice->与罪犯折叠在一起的=共犯（cf. complicate使复杂，implicit隐含，explicit明确，complicity共谋） || 文化联想：古代盗贼作案时负责望风的人也是同伙，可以说 **an accomplice to the theft — “The man who stood watch outside the shop was treated as an accomplice to the theft.”**

quiz.question: splice _____
quiz.explanation: 拼接，拼接电线。The electrician would splice wires together. 电工会把电线拼接在一起。 | splissen->拼接（荷兰语），splice->把两端编织在一起连接（cf. split分裂，splice胶片剪接，genetic splice基因拼接，RNA splicing剪接） || 文化联想：渔民修补断裂渔绳时会把两端重新编接，可以说 **splice the rope — “The old fisherman spliced the rope carefully so the repaired net would hold together.”**

quiz.question: _____ slice
quiz.explanation: 片，披萨片。He ate a large pizza slice. 他吃了一大片披萨片。 | slice->薄片（古法语esclice->裂片），slice->切成薄片（cf. slit切缝，sliver细片，slash猛砍，slice of life生活片段） || 文化联想：中餐刀工讲究把肉、姜、笋切成均匀薄片，可以说 **a thin slice — “The chef cut the pork into a thin slice so it would cook quickly in the wok.”**

quiz.question: _____ cornice
quiz.explanation: 檐口，石头檐口。The stone cornice decorated the building's edge. 石头檐口装饰着建筑的边缘。 | coronis->弯曲（希腊），cornice->建筑顶部的弯曲装饰（cf. corona冠，coronet小冠，crown王冠，cornea角膜=像小角一样弯曲） || 文化联想：中国传统木构建筑的屋檐本身不等同于西式 cornice，但可用建筑顶部装饰作对比记忆，可以说 **a decorative cornice — “The Western-style mansion in old Shanghai had a decorative cornice above its facade.”**

quiz.question: _______ choice
quiz.explanation: 选择，有限的选择。They had limited choice of restaurants. 他们有有限的选择餐厅。 | choice->选择（古法语choisir->选择），choice->最佳选择（cf. choose选择，chosen被选的，choicest最好的） || 文化联想：古代士人常面对“出仕还是归隐”的人生抉择，可以说 **a difficult choice — “For a scholar-official, choosing between serving at court and retiring to the countryside could be a difficult choice.”**

quiz.question: rejoice __ ____
quiz.explanation: 欢喜，对消息欢喜。The family would rejoice at news of the baby's birth. 家人会对婴儿出生的消息欢喜。 | re->再次，joy->喜悦（法语joie），rejoice->再次充满喜悦=欢喜（cf. joy喜悦，joyful快乐，enjoy享受，overjoyed欣喜若狂） || 文化联想：金榜题名的消息传回家乡时，全家会欢天喜地，可以说 **rejoice at the good news — “The whole family rejoiced at the good news that their son had passed the imperial examination.”**

quiz.question: _____ precipice
quiz.explanation: 悬崖，陡峭的悬崖。They stood at the edge of a sheer precipice. 他们站在陡峭的悬崖边上。 | praeceps->头朝下（拉丁praecipitare->头先坠落），precipice->陡峭的悬崖（cf. precipitate沉淀/仓促，precipitation降雨，precipitous陡峭） || 文化联想：黄山悬崖峭壁一步之外便是深谷，很适合联想到 precipice，可以说 **a sheer precipice — “The path clung to the mountain beside a sheer precipice that dropped into the valley below.”**

quiz.question: _____ ___ auspice(s)
quiz.explanation: 赞助，在赞助下。The event was held under the auspice(s) of the university. 活动在大学的赞助下举行。 | avis->鸟（拉丁），spic->看，auspice->观鸟预兆=赞助（cf. auspicious吉祥，inspect检查，prospect前景，suspicious可疑） || 文化联想：中国古代也会观天象、占吉凶，可借此理解 auspice，可以说 **an auspicious sign — “The court astrologers interpreted the unusual celestial event as an auspicious sign for the coming year.”**

quiz.question: ____ avarice
quiz.explanation: 贪婪，极度的贪婪。His rank avarice led to his downfall. 他极度的贪婪导致了他的垮台。 | avar->渴望（拉丁avere->渴望），avarice->强烈的金钱渴望=贪婪（cf. avid渴望的，avidity贪婪，avaricious贪婪的，rapacious掠夺性的） || 文化联想：严监生临死还惦记着多点了一根灯芯，是中国文学里极端贪财的经典形象，可以说 **rank avarice — “Yan Jiansheng’s obsession with saving even a tiny amount of lamp oil is a famous literary image of rank avarice.”**

quiz.question: ______ caprice
quiz.explanation: 任性，突然的任性。She acted on a sudden caprice. 她突发奇想突然的任性行事。 | capro->山羊（意大利语），caprice->像山羊一样跳跃=任性（cf. capricorn摩羯座=山羊角，capricious任性，caper跳跃，cf. Capri岛=山羊岛） || 文化联想：古代帝王因一时兴起突然改主意，可以说 **a sudden caprice — “The emperor changed the plan on a sudden caprice, forcing the entire court to adjust overnight.”**

quiz.question: _______ malpractice
quiz.explanation: 渎职，医疗渎职。The doctor was sued for medical malpractice. 医生因医疗渎职被起诉。 | mal->坏（拉丁malus），practice->实践，malpractice->坏的实践=渎职（cf. malice恶意，malign恶毒，malady疾病，malfunction故障） || 文化联想：古代庸医误诊害人，可用来理解 malpractice，可以说 **medical malpractice — “A healer who ignored basic medical practice and caused serious harm could be accused of medical malpractice.”**

quiz.question: _____ apprentice
quiz.explanation: 学徒，年轻的学徒。The young apprentice learned from the master craftsman. 年轻的学徒向工匠大师学习。 | apprender->学习（古法语，拉丁apprehendere->抓住），apprentice->抓住学习机会的人=学徒（cf. apprehend抓住，comprehend理解） || 文化联想：传统手艺常靠“拜师学艺”，刚入门的人就是 apprentice，可以说 **a young apprentice — “The young apprentice spent years learning carpentry under an experienced master.”**

quiz.question: ____ __ armistice
quiz.explanation: 停战协定，签署停战协定。The warring nations agreed to sign an armistice. 交战国同意签署停战协定。 | arma->武器（拉丁），stit->停止（拉丁sistere），armistice->武器停止=停战协定（cf. arms武器，cease-fire停火，armament武装） || 文化联想：古代两军暂时停战、约定不再交战，可以说 **sign an armistice — “After years of fighting, the two sides agreed to sign an armistice and withdraw their troops.”**

quiz.question: ______ interstice
quiz.explanation: 缝隙，狭窄的缝隙。Light filtered through the narrow interstice. 光线透过狭窄的缝隙。 | inter->之间，stit->站立，interstice->站在之间的空间=缝隙（cf. interstitial间质的，crevice岩缝，chink裂缝，interstice空隙） || 文化联想：老砖墙两块砖之间透进一线光的狭窄空隙可以说 **a narrow interstice — “A beam of sunlight entered through a narrow interstice between two old bricks.”**

quiz.question: ______ lattice
quiz.explanation: 格子，木格子。The wooden lattice provided shade. 木格子提供阴凉。 | lattice->板条（古法语lattis->板条格），lattice->交叉格条（cf. slat板条，trellis格架，lattice work格状工作，crystal lattice晶格） || 文化联想：苏州园林花窗常由木条交叉组成精美格纹，可以说 **a wooden lattice — “The garden pavilion used a wooden lattice to create patterned shadows on the floor.”**

quiz.question: _____ sluice
quiz.explanation: 水闸，水闸。The water sluice controlled the flow. 水闸控制流量。 | escluse->水闸（古法语，拉丁exclusa->被排除的水），sluice->控制水流的闸门（cf. exclude排除，exclusive独家，sluice water用水冲洗） || 文化联想：都江堰等传统水利工程依靠闸门调节水流，可以说 **a water sluice — “Workers opened the water sluice to divert part of the river into the irrigation channel.”**

quiz.question: ____ crevice
quiz.explanation: 裂缝，岩石裂缝。The lizard hid in a rock crevice. 蜥蜴躲在岩石裂缝里。 | crever->破裂（古法语，拉丁crepare），crevice->破裂处=裂缝（cf. crevasse冰川裂缝，cranny缝隙，fissure裂缝，crack裂开） || 文化联想：黄山岩壁的小草常从石头裂缝中顽强长出，可以说 **a rock crevice — “A small pine had taken root in a narrow rock crevice high on the mountain.”**

quiz.question: novice ______
quiz.explanation: 新手，新手司机。The novice driver was nervous on the highway. 新手司机在高速公路上很紧张。 | novus->新（拉丁），novice->刚开始的人=新手（cf. novel新颖，innovate创新，novice新手，renovate翻新，nova新星） || 文化联想：刚拜师、还没独立做活的年轻人可以说 **a novice craftsman — “As a novice craftsman, he was still learning how to use the tools correctly.”**

quiz.question: _____ abundance
quiz.explanation: 丰富，大量丰富。The harvest brought great abundance. 收获带来了大量丰富。 | ab->充分，unda->波浪（拉丁），abundance->波浪充满=丰富（cf. inundate淹没，redundant多余，undulate波动，abound充满） || 文化联想：江南素有“鱼米之乡”之称，物产丰饶可以说 **an abundance of food — “The fertile delta produced an abundance of rice, fish, and vegetables.”**

quiz.question: ____ vengeance
quiz.explanation: 复仇，寻求复仇。He swore to seek vengeance for his brother's death. 他发誓要为兄弟的死寻求复仇。 | vindicare->主张权利（拉丁），vengeance->为权利而战的行动=复仇（cf. avenge复仇，vindicate证明无罪，vindictive报复性，avenger复仇者） || 文化联想：“君子报仇，十年不晚”体现的是长期记恨并寻求报复，可以说 **seek vengeance — “The old saying ‘a gentleman can wait ten years for revenge’ reflects the determination to seek vengeance.”**

quiz.question: ____ extravagance
quiz.explanation: 奢侈，疯狂的奢侈。His wild extravagance led to bankruptcy. 他疯狂的奢侈导致破产。 | extra->超出，vagari->漫游，extravagance->漫游超出应有范围=奢侈（cf. vagrant流浪，vague模糊，extravagant奢侈，vagabond流浪者） || 文化联想：古代帝王大兴土木、修建豪华行宫属于典型铺张浪费，可以说 **royal extravagance — “Building enormous pleasure palaces while the treasury was empty became a symbol of royal extravagance.”**

quiz.question: _____ arrogance
quiz.explanation: 傲慢，纯粹的傲慢。His sheer arrogance offended everyone. 他纯粹的傲慢冒犯了每个人。 | ar->朝向，rog->要求（拉丁rogare），arrogance->要求超出应得的=傲慢（cf. arrogate僭取，abrogate废除，interrogate审讯，prerogative特权） || 文化联想：权贵目中无人、自认为高人一等，可以说 **sheer arrogance — “His refusal even to acknowledge ordinary people was taken as sheer arrogance.”**

quiz.question: ______ insouciance
quiz.explanation: 漫不经心，随意的漫不经心。She displayed casual insouciance about the problem. 她对问题表现出随意的漫不经心。 | in->否定，souci->担心（法语，拉丁sollicitus），insouciance->不担心的=漫不经心（cf. solicit请求，solicitude关心，concern关心） || 文化联想：面对危机仍若无其事、毫不担心的态度可以说 **casual insouciance — “He discussed the looming crisis with such casual insouciance that everyone else found it unsettling.”**

quiz.question: ______ allegiance
quiz.explanation: 忠诚，宣誓忠诚。Citizens pledge allegiance to the flag. 公民向国旗宣誓忠诚。 | alleg->绑定（法语lier），allegiance->绑定效忠的关系（cf. liege封建主，ally盟友，ligament韧带，liaison联络=绑定关系） || 文化联想：古代臣子发誓效忠君主，可以说 **pledge allegiance — “The minister knelt before the throne to pledge allegiance to the new emperor.”**

quiz.question: ____ dalliance
quiz.explanation: 调情，闲散的调情。Their idle dalliance meant nothing serious. 他们闲散的调情并不认真。 | dally->消磨时间（古法语dalier->聊天），dalliance->轻浮的调情或拖延（cf. dally拖延，dawdle磨蹭，dillydally拖拉，flirtation调情） || 文化联想：才子佳人在花园中眉来眼去、并不认真谈婚论嫁，可以说 **a romantic dalliance — “Their meetings in the garden began as a romantic dalliance rather than a serious engagement.”**

quiz.question: __ compliance ____
quiz.explanation: 遵守，遵守。The company acted in compliance with regulations. 公司按照法规遵守行事。 | com->共同，ply->弯曲，compliance->弯曲配合=遵守（cf. comply遵守，compliant顺从，noncompliant不遵守，pliable柔韧） || 文化联想：“俯首听命”体现按权威要求行事的顺从，可以说 **compliance with orders — “The officials demanded strict compliance with orders from everyone in the district.”**

quiz.question: ___________ variance
quiz.explanation: 方差，统计方差。The researcher calculated the statistical variance. 研究人员计算了统计方差。 | vari->变化（拉丁varius），variance->变化的程度=方差（cf. vary变化，variable变量，variety多样，invariant不变量） || 文化联想：同一件事经不同人口述后说法彼此不一，可以说 **variance in accounts — “Historians noticed considerable variance in the accounts given by different witnesses.”**

quiz.question: lance _____
quiz.explanation: 长矛，长矛伤口。The knight suffered a lance wound in battle. 骑士在战斗中遭受了长矛伤口。 | lance->长矛（古法语lance，拉丁lancea），lance->刺穿（cf. lancer骑枪骑兵，lancet手术刀，launch发射=投出长矛） || 文化联想：古代骑兵冲锋时使用的细长刺击兵器可以说 **a cavalry lance — “The mounted soldier lowered his cavalry lance as he charged across the field.”**

quiz.question: counterbalance ____
quiz.explanation: 平衡，平衡风险。Diversification can counterbalance risk in investments. 多样化可以平衡投资风险。 | counter->对抗，balance->平衡（拉丁bilanx->两盘秤），counterbalance->用对立力量平衡（cf. balance平衡，scales天平，equilibrium平衡） || 文化联想：传统杆秤靠秤砣抵消货物重量达到平衡，可以说 **counterbalance the weight — “The sliding weight on a traditional steelyard counterbalanced the load hanging from the other end.”**

quiz.question: ____ nonchalance
quiz.explanation: 冷淡，冷静的冷淡。He faced danger with cool nonchalance. 他以冷静的冷淡面对危险。 | non->否定，chaland->温热（法语，拉丁calere->热），nonchalance->不热情的=冷淡（cf. calorie卡路里，scald烫伤，caldron大锅） || 文化联想：“泰山崩于前而色不变”那种表面毫不慌张的淡定可以说 **cool nonchalance — “He met the crisis with cool nonchalance, showing almost no outward anxiety.”**

quiz.question: _ ____ semblance
quiz.explanation: 外表，仅仅是外表。Their relationship was a mere semblance of friendship. 他们的关系仅仅是友谊的外表。 | sembl->相似（法语sembler->看起来像），semblance->表面的相似=外表（cf. assemble集合，resemble像，ensemble合奏，dissemble掩饰） || 文化联想：“貌合神离”形容表面像是一家人，实际上关系早已破裂，可以说 **a mere semblance of harmony — “The family maintained a mere semblance of harmony while serious conflict continued behind closed doors.”**

quiz.question: ______ parlance
quiz.explanation: 说法，普通说法。In common parlance, this is called a bug. 在普通说法中，这被称为漏洞。 | parler->说（法语），parlance->说话的方式=说法（cf. parliament议会=说话的地方，parlor客厅，parley会谈，parole假释=说出承诺） || 文化联想：官场中外人听不懂的固定说法和术语可以说 **official parlance — “In official parlance, a simple delay was described with a long and carefully worded phrase.”**

quiz.question: ________ petulance
quiz.explanation: 任性，幼稚的任性。His childish petulance irritated everyone. 他幼稚的任性激怒了每个人。 | petul->冲动（拉丁petulans->放肆），petulance->放肆任性（cf. petulant任性的，impetuous冲动，petition请求，compete竞争） || 文化联想：被宠坏的孩子一不如意就撒泼耍赖，可以说 **childish petulance — “The boy responded to the refusal with childish petulance, stamping his feet and shouting.”**

quiz.question: ________ ordnance
quiz.explanation: 军械，军事军械。The base stored military ordnance. 基地储存军事军械。 | ordin->命令（拉丁ordinare->排列），ordnance->由命令管理的武器=军械（注意与 ordinance 法令区分，cf. order命令，ordain任命） || 文化联想：古代军营中集中储存的刀枪弓弩、火炮弹药可以说 **military ordnance — “The fortress storehouse contained military ordnance ranging from bows and spears to cannon.”**

quiz.question: _______ penance
quiz.explanation: 忏悔，进行忏悔。The sinner had to perform penance. 罪人必须进行忏悔。 | poena->惩罚（拉丁），penance->自我惩罚=忏悔（cf. pain痛苦，penalty惩罚，penal刑事，punish惩罚，impunity免罚） || 文化联想：佛门弟子犯戒后抄经、跪香以求赎罪，可以说 **perform penance — “After breaking a monastic rule, the monk chose to perform penance by copying sutras and fasting.”**

quiz.question: ____ maintenance
quiz.explanation: 维护，家庭维护。Regular home maintenance prevents costly repairs. 定期家庭维护可以防止昂贵的维修。 | manu->手（拉丁manus），tain->持（tenere），maintenance->用手持续维持（cf. maintain维持，retain保留，contain包含，sustain支撑） || 文化联想：老宅每年修瓦、补墙、刷木料属于日常维护，可以说 **regular maintenance — “Regular maintenance kept the old courtyard house from falling into disrepair.”**

quiz.question: ____ countenance
quiz.explanation: 面容，平静的面容。She maintained a calm countenance despite the stress. 尽管有压力，她保持着平静的面容。 | continen->自制（拉丁continere），countenance->保持自制的面容（cf. contain包含，continent大陆=自制的，abstain禁止） || 文化联想：高僧宠辱不惊、面色始终平静，可以说 **a calm countenance — “The old monk kept a calm countenance even when the discussion became heated.”**

quiz.question: _____ sustenance
quiz.explanation: 食物，日常食物。Bread provides daily sustenance. 面包提供日常食物。 | sus->在下，ten->持，sustenance->从下面持续支撑的东西=食物（cf. sustain维持，tenant租户，tenacious顽强，tenure任期） || 文化联想：灾荒年代百姓靠粗粮和野菜维持生命，这些就是 sustenance，可以说 **basic sustenance — “During famine, coarse grain and wild vegetables sometimes provided the only basic sustenance available to poor families.”**

quiz.question: ___ provenance
quiz.explanation: 来源，艺术来源。The museum verified the art provenance. 博物馆核实了艺术来源。 | pro->向前，ven->来（拉丁venire），provenance->来到之前的地方=来源（cf. provenir来自，province省份，prevent阻止=提前来） || 文化联想：古玩鉴定最重视文物的来源和传承记录，可以说 **the provenance of an artifact — “The collector studied the provenance of the porcelain vase to determine where it had come from and who had owned it.”**

quiz.question: ______ repugnance
quiz.explanation: 厌恶，强烈的厌恶。She felt strong repugnance toward violence. 她对暴力感到强烈的厌恶。 | re->对抗，pugn->战斗（拉丁pugnare），repugnance->对抗战斗的感觉=厌恶（cf. pugnacious好斗，impugn质疑，repugnant令人厌恶） || 文化联想：对蛇虫产生本能的强烈厌恶，可以说 **strong repugnance — “She felt strong repugnance at the sight of the basket full of writhing snakes.”**

quiz.question: ____ ordinance
quiz.explanation: 法令，城市法令。The city ordinance banned smoking in parks. 城市法令禁止在公园吸烟。 | ordin->命令（拉丁ordinare），ordinance->已颁布的命令=法令（注意与 ordnance 军械区分，cf. order命令，coordinate协调，extraordinary非凡） || 文化联想：古代地方衙门张贴的禁令和规章可以说 **a local ordinance — “The magistrate issued a local ordinance restricting fires inside the crowded market district.”**

quiz.question: _____ consonance
quiz.explanation: 和谐，甜美的和谐。The choir sang in sweet consonance. 合唱团唱出甜美的和谐。 | con->共同，son->声音（拉丁sonus），consonance->共同发声=和谐（cf. resonant共鸣，dissonant不和谐，sonorous洪亮，sonata奏鸣曲） || 文化联想：古琴和箫合奏时音色彼此协调，可以说 **musical consonance — “The qin and xiao blended in musical consonance, producing a calm and balanced sound.”**

quiz.question: _________ governance
quiz.explanation: 治理，企业治理。Good corporate governance ensures accountability. 良好的企业治理确保问责制。 | govern->统治（拉丁gubernare->掌舵），governance->统治的方式（cf. government政府，governor总督，gubernatorial州长的，rudder船舵） || 文化联想：“治国理政”最直接对应 governance，可以说 **good governance — “Traditional Chinese political thought often linked good governance with capable officials and concern for the people.”**

quiz.question: ____ forbearance
quiz.explanation: 忍耐，显示忍耐。The teacher would show forbearance with difficult students. 老师会对困难学生显示忍耐。 | for->完全，bear->承受，forbearance->完全承受=忍耐（cf. bear忍受，bearable可忍受，overbearing专横，patience耐心） || 文化联想：“忍一时风平浪静”体现克制和容忍，可以说 **show forbearance — “Rather than answer the insult immediately, he chose to show forbearance and avoid a larger quarrel.”**

quiz.question: ________ exuberance
quiz.explanation: 热情，年轻的热情。The children's youthful exuberance was contagious. 孩子们年轻的热情具有感染力。 | ex->向外，uber->多产（拉丁），exuberance->向外多产溢出的=热情洋溢（cf. exuberant热情，uber超级=如优步，abundant丰富） || 文化联想：春节庙会上孩子们兴奋奔跑、欢笑不止，可以说 **youthful exuberance — “The temple fair was filled with youthful exuberance as children ran between lanterns, games, and food stalls.”**

quiz.question: _________ tolerance
quiz.explanation: 宽容，宗教宽容。The society valued religious tolerance. 社会重视宗教宽容。 | tolerare->忍受（拉丁），tolerance->承受不同的能力=宽容（cf. tolerate容忍，intolerable不可忍受，tolerant宽容，toll通行费=承受代价） || 文化联想：丝绸之路沿线多民族、多宗教长期共存，可用来理解 tolerance，可以说 **religious tolerance — “The cosmopolitan cities of the Silk Road depended on a degree of religious tolerance among different communities.”**

quiz.question: _____ fragrance
quiz.explanation: 芳香，甜美的芳香。The roses filled the air with sweet fragrance. 玫瑰让空气中充满甜美的芳香。 | fragr->香气（拉丁flagrare->散发香气），fragrance->香气（cf. fragrant芳香，flagrant明显=像香气般飘散，deflagrate燃烧） || 文化联想：江南茉莉花开时满院清香，可以说 **a sweet fragrance — “Fresh jasmine blossoms filled the courtyard with a sweet fragrance on the summer evening.”**

quiz.question: __ _ trance
quiz.explanation: 恍惚，处于恍惚中。The hypnotist put him in a trance. 催眠师让他处于恍惚中。 | trans->穿越，trance->穿越到另一意识状态=恍惚（cf. transit过渡，transfer转移，entrance入口=进入另一状态，entranced着迷） || 文化联想：民间法事中有人进入恍惚失神状态，可以说 **fall into a trance — “During the ritual, the medium appeared to fall into a trance and stopped responding to the people around him.”**

quiz.question: _____ entrance
quiz.explanation: 入口，宏伟的入口。The palace had a grand entrance. 宫殿有宏伟的入口。 | en->进入，trance->过渡状态，entrance->进入的地方/迷住（cf. entry入口，enter进入，entrant参赛者，trance恍惚） || 文化联想：古代府邸气派的大门是整座建筑最显眼的入口，可以说 **a grand entrance — “The mansion’s grand entrance was framed by stone lions and a richly painted gate.”**

quiz.question: ________ malfeasance
quiz.explanation: 渎职，官员渎职。The investigation uncovered official malfeasance. 调查揭露了官员渎职。 | mal->坏，feas->做（拉丁facere），malfeasance->做坏事=渎职（cf. feasible可行，malice恶意，malpractice医疗渎职，nonfeasance不作为） || 文化联想：贪官利用职权侵吞公款就是典型 malfeasance，可以说 **official malfeasance — “The investigation uncovered official malfeasance involving bribery and misuse of public funds.”**

quiz.question: _____ complaisance
quiz.explanation: 顺从，安静的顺从。She accepted the decision with quiet complaisance. 她以安静的顺从接受了决定。 | com->共同，plais->取悦（法语，拉丁placere），complaisance->取悦他人的倾向=顺从（cf. complaisant殷勤，please取悦，placid平静） || 文化联想：旧时宫廷里有些人专门揣摩主子心思、处处讨好，可以说 **courtly complaisance — “His constant smiling agreement was less loyalty than courtly complaisance designed to please the ruler.”**

quiz.question: ____ obeisance
quiz.explanation: 敬礼，深深的敬礼。The courtier made a deep obeisance to the king. 朝臣向国王行深深的敬礼。 | obeir->服从（法语，拉丁obedire），obeisance->表示服从的姿态=敬礼（cf. obey服从，obedient顺从，obedience服从，deference尊重） || 文化联想：臣子觐见皇帝时行跪拜大礼，是 obeisance 最容易记的中国场景，可以说 **make obeisance — “The envoy entered the hall and made obeisance before the emperor.”**

quiz.question: ______ reconnaissance
quiz.explanation: 侦察，空中侦察。The military conducted aerial reconnaissance. 军方进行了空中侦察。 | re->再次，conn->知道（法语connaître），reconnaissance->再次认知/检查=侦察（cf. recognize认出，cognizance认知，incognito不露身份） || 文化联想：古代作战前先派斥候侦察敌军部署，可以说 **military reconnaissance — “Scouts were sent ahead to conduct military reconnaissance before the army crossed the pass.”**

quiz.question: _________ puissance
quiz.explanation: 权力，政治权力。The senator wielded great political puissance. 参议员掌握着巨大的政治权力。 | pouvoir->能力（法语，拉丁posse->能），puissance->力量/权力（cf. power权力，posse民兵，possible可能，impotent无力） || 文化联想：帝王拥有可以号令天下的巨大权势，可以说 **imperial puissance — “At the height of the dynasty, the court displayed imperial puissance through its armies, wealth, and vast bureaucracy.”**

quiz.question: ________ __ impuissance
quiz.explanation: 无力，无力的感觉。He experienced feelings of impuissance. 他经历了无力的感觉。 | im->否定，puissance->权力，impuissance->无权无力（cf. impotent无力，powerless无权，puissance权力，omnipotent全能） || 文化联想：“回天乏术”形容明知局势危险却完全无力改变，可以说 **complete impuissance — “The officials watched the collapse with complete impuissance, unable to reverse what had already begun.”**

quiz.question: ____ _ stance
quiz.explanation: 立场，采取立场。The politician refused to take a stance on the issue. 政客拒绝在这个问题上采取立场。 | stance->站立（拉丁stare），stance->站立的位置=立场（cf. stand站立，circumstance情况，substance物质=在下方站立，instance实例） || 文化联想：辩论中必须明确站在哪一边，可以说 **take a clear stance — “On the reform question, the scholar took a clear stance and defended it openly.”**

quiz.question: ____ remittance
quiz.explanation: 汇款，银行汇款。The bank remittance arrived on time. 银行汇款按时到达。 | re->回，mit->送（拉丁mittere），remittance->送回的钱=汇款（cf. remit汇款，emit发射，submit提交，transmit传输，permit允许） || 文化联想：早期华侨把在海外赚到的钱寄回故乡养家，可以说 **an overseas remittance — “The family depended on an overseas remittance sent each month by a relative working abroad.”**

quiz.question: _____ pittance
quiz.explanation: 微薄的收入，微薄的收入。He earned a small pittance from the job. 他从这份工作中赚取微薄的收入。 | pietas->虔诚（拉丁，修道院给的少量食物），pittance->微薄的收入（cf. piety虔诚，pity怜悯，pitiable可怜，pittance小额施舍） || 文化联想：旧社会长工辛苦一年却只拿到一点微薄工钱，可以说 **a mere pittance — “After months of hard labor, the worker received only a mere pittance.”**

quiz.question: ______ nuance
quiz.explanation: 细微差别，微妙的细微差别。The translation captured every subtle nuance. 翻译捕捉到了每一个微妙的细微差别。 | nuer->呈现色调（法语，拉丁nubes->云），nuance->云朵般细微的变化=细微差别（cf. nuanced有细微差别的，shade细微差异，subtlety微妙） || 文化联想：中国画“墨分五色”强调浓淡之间极细微的变化，可以说 **a subtle nuance — “The painter used a subtle nuance of ink to distinguish distant mountains from the foreground.”**

quiz.question: ___ grievance
quiz.explanation: 不满，发泄不满。The workers needed to air grievance with management. 工人们需要向管理层发泄不满。 | grav->重（拉丁gravis），grievance->让人感到沉重的事=不满（cf. grieve悲伤，grief悲痛，grave严重，aggravate加重） || 文化联想：“拦轿喊冤”就是百姓因不公待遇向官府申诉冤情，可以说 **air a grievance — “The villager stopped the magistrate’s procession to air a grievance about land that had been taken from his family.”**

quiz.question: ______ relevance
quiz.explanation: 相关性，政策相关性。The research has policy relevance for healthcare. 这项研究与医疗保健有政策相关性。 | re->再次，lev->举起（拉丁levare），relevance->能再次举起=相关性（cf. relevant相关，lever杠杆，relieve减轻，elevate提升） || 文化联想：科举文章必须切题，离题万里就没有 relevance，可以说 **direct relevance to the topic — “The examiner rejected the passage because it had little direct relevance to the assigned topic.”**

quiz.question: _________ observance
quiz.explanation: 遵守，宗教遵守。Strict religious observance was required. 需要严格的宗教遵守。 | observ->注意（拉丁observare），observance->注意遵守（cf. observe观察，observation观察，observatory天文台，preserve保护） || 文化联想：春节祭祖、清明扫墓等固定习俗体现对传统仪式的遵守，可以说 **religious observance — “The family returned home for the annual religious observance honoring their ancestors.”**

quiz.question: _______ allowance
quiz.explanation: 津贴，住房津贴。Employees received a housing allowance. 员工获得住房津贴。 | allow->允许/分配（拉丁allocare），allowance->被允许的份额=津贴（cf. allow允许，allocate分配，allot分配，allowable允许的） || 文化联想：古代官员除了俸禄还可能按规定领取额外补贴，可以说 **an official allowance — “The court granted the envoy an official allowance for travel and lodging expenses.”**

quiz.question: ____ __ abeyance
quiz.explanation: 暂缓，暂缓。The decision was held in abeyance. 决定被暂缓。 | abeier->张望等待（古法语），abeyance->等待的状态=暂缓（cf. in abeyance暂停，pending悬而未决，suspension暂停，defer推迟） || 文化联想：朝廷遇到争议太大的政策，有时会先搁置不议，可以说 **hold the matter in abeyance — “The court decided to hold the disputed reform in abeyance until a later session.”**

quiz.question: ____ __ clairvoyance
quiz.explanation: 预知，预知的天赋。She claimed to have the gift of clairvoyance. 她声称拥有预知的天赋。 | clair->清楚（法语，拉丁clarus），voyance->视力（法语voir->看），clairvoyance->清楚看见=预知（cf. clear清楚，voyeur窥视者，voyage航行） || 文化联想：民间算命先生自称能“未卜先知”，可以说 **supposed clairvoyance — “The fortune-teller claimed supposed clairvoyance and said he could see events before they happened.”**

quiz.question: ____ cognizance __
quiz.explanation: 认知，认识到。The court must take cognizance of new evidence. 法院必须认识到新证据。 | cognos->知道（拉丁cognoscere），cognizance->认知（cf. cognition认知，recognize认出，reconnaissance侦察，incognito隐名） || 文化联想：审案必须“明察秋毫”，充分掌握事实，可以说 **take cognizance of the facts — “Before issuing a judgment, the magistrate took cognizance of the facts presented by both sides.”**

quiz.question: _____ munificence
quiz.explanation: 慷慨，皇家慷慨。The royal munificence supported the arts. 皇家慷慨支持艺术。 | muni->礼物（拉丁munus），fic->做，munificence->大量给予礼物=慷慨（cf. municipal市政=市民的礼物，immunity免疫=免除义务，munitions军火） || 文化联想：古代富户赈灾时开仓放粮、慷慨施舍，可以说 **great munificence — “The wealthy merchant showed great munificence by opening his granaries to famine victims.”**

quiz.question: _________ innocence
quiz.explanation: 天真，童年天真。Her childhood innocence was touching. 她的童年天真令人感动。 | in->否定，noc->伤害（拉丁nocere），innocence->不伤害他人的状态=天真无邪（cf. innocent无辜，nocive有害，noxious有毒，innocuous无害） || 文化联想：“赤子之心”强调未经世故污染的纯真，可以说 **childlike innocence — “The phrase ‘the heart of a newborn child’ evokes childlike innocence and sincerity.”**

quiz.question: _____ iridescence
quiz.explanation: 彩虹色，珍珠彩虹色。The pearl iridescence shimmered beautifully. 珍珠彩虹色美丽地闪烁。 | Iris->彩虹女神（希腊），iridescence->像彩虹一样的色彩（cf. iris鸢尾花/虹膜=彩虹色，iridescent闪彩虹色，rainbow彩虹） || 文化联想：螺钿、珍珠母在光线下会闪现彩虹般色泽，可以说 **shimmering iridescence — “The mother-of-pearl inlay on the lacquer box showed shimmering iridescence as it moved in the light.”**

quiz.question: incandescence ____
quiz.explanation: 白炽，白炽灯。The incandescence lamp glowed warmly. 白炽灯温暖地发光。 | in->使，cand->白色发光（拉丁candere），incandescence->加热到白炽（cf. candid坦率=白色，candle蜡烛，incandescent白炽，candidate候选人=穿白袍） || 文化联想：铁匠把铁烧到通红发亮时就能看到 incandescence，可以说 **the incandescence of heated iron — “The forge glowed with the incandescence of heated iron as the blacksmith prepared to hammer it.”**

quiz.question: opalescence ____
quiz.explanation: 乳白色光泽，乳白色光泽的光芒。The glass had a beautiful opalescence glow. 玻璃有美丽的乳白色光泽的光芒。 | opal->蛋白石（梵语upala->宝石），opalescence->像蛋白石一样变幻的乳白光（cf. opal蛋白石，opaline乳白色，iridescent彩虹色） || 文化联想：玉器或贝母表面有时会呈现柔和乳白、似蛋白石的光泽，可以说 **soft opalescence — “The polished ornament had a soft opalescence that shifted between milky white and faint color.”**

quiz.question: ______ intumescence
quiz.explanation: 肿胀，组织肿胀。The injury caused tissue intumescence. 受伤导致组织肿胀。 | in->使，tum->肿（拉丁tumere），intumescence->使肿胀（cf. tumor肿瘤，tumid肿胀，turgid浮夸，tumult骚乱，contumacy抗命） || 文化联想：蚊虫叮咬后皮肤鼓起红肿，可以说 **local intumescence — “The bite caused local intumescence, leaving a raised red swelling on the skin.”**

quiz.question: ______ florescence
quiz.explanation: 开花，花朵开花。The spring brought floral florescence. 春天带来了花朵开花。 | flor->花（拉丁flos），escence->正在变化，florescence->正在开花的过程（cf. flower花，flourish繁荣，Florida佛罗里达，flora植物群） || 文化联想：“烟花三月”时江南百花盛开，可以说 **spring florescence — “The gardens of Jiangnan entered full spring florescence as plum, peach, and magnolia blossoms opened together.”**

quiz.question: ______ cadence
quiz.explanation: 节奏，语言节奏。The speaker's speech cadence was captivating. 演讲者的语言节奏令人着迷。 | cad->落下（拉丁cadere），cadence->有规律的落下=节奏（cf. cascade瀑布，decadence堕落，accident意外=向落下，occident西方=日落处） || 文化联想：唐诗宋词朗诵讲究抑扬顿挫的节奏，可以说 **a measured cadence — “The poem was recited in a measured cadence that emphasized its tonal pattern and rhyme.”**

quiz.question: _____ decadence
quiz.explanation: 堕落，道德堕落。The empire fell into moral decadence. 帝国陷入道德堕落。 | de->向下，cad->落下，decadence->向下落=堕落（cf. cadence节奏，cascade瀑布，cadaver尸体=倒下的，accident意外，occasion场合） || 文化联想：王朝末期若奢靡享乐、政治腐败，常会被后世描述为 decadence，可以说 **late-dynastic decadence — “Historians sometimes portray the final years of a dynasty as a period of late-dynastic decadence.”**

quiz.question: ______ antecedence
quiz.explanation: 优先，严格的优先。The rule of strict antecedence was followed. 遵循严格的优先规则。 | ante->之前，ced->走（拉丁cedere），antecedence->在前面走=优先（cf. antecedent先例，precede先于，exceed超出，concede承认） || 文化联想：传统礼法讲究“长幼有序”，年长者在次序上居先，可以说 **antecedence in rank — “In the old ritual order, seniority often gave a person antecedence in rank and ceremony.”**

quiz.question: credence __ _____
quiz.explanation: 信任，相信谣言。Don't give credence to rumor without evidence. 没有证据不要相信谣言。 | credere->相信（拉丁），credence->相信的程度=信任（cf. credit信用，credible可信，creed信条，incredible难以置信，credulous轻信） || 文化联想：“三人成虎”说明谣言重复多次也可能获得人的信任，可以说 **lend credence to a rumor — “Hearing the same story again and again may cause people to lend credence to a rumor, just as in the tale of ‘three men make a tiger.’”**

quiz.question: _______ incidence
quiz.explanation: 发生率，疾病发生率。The disease incidence has increased. 疾病发生率增加了。 | in->在，cid->落下（拉丁cadere），incidence->落在上面=发生率（cf. incident事件，coincide同时发生，accident意外，occidental西方的） || 文化联想：史书记录某类水灾、旱灾在某时期反复出现，可以说 **the incidence of drought — “The local gazetteer recorded a high incidence of drought during several decades of the dynasty.”**

quiz.question: ____ prudence
quiz.explanation: 谨慎，显示谨慎。Investors should show prudence in volatile markets. 投资者在波动的市场中应显示谨慎。 | prudens->预见（拉丁，contraction of providens），prudence->预见而谨慎（cf. prudent谨慎，jurisprudence法理学，imprudent轻率） || 文化联想：“三思而后行”最适合联想到 prudence，可以说 **act with prudence — “The saying ‘think three times before acting’ encourages people to act with prudence rather than impulse.”**

quiz.question: ________ jurisprudence
quiz.explanation: 法理学，刑事法理学。He studied criminal jurisprudence at law school. 他在法学院学习刑事法理学。 | juris->法律（拉丁ius），prudence->知识，jurisprudence->法律知识=法理学（cf. jury陪审团，jurisdiction管辖，justice正义） || 文化联想：《唐律疏议》不仅列法条，也系统解释法律原则，很适合联想到 jurisprudence，可以说 **a tradition of jurisprudence — “The Tang Code and its commentaries represent an important early Chinese tradition of jurisprudence.”**

quiz.question: _____ indigence
quiz.explanation: 贫困，完全的贫困。The family lived in utter indigence. 这家人生活在完全的贫困中。 | indu->在内，eg->需要（拉丁egere->缺乏），indigence->内部缺乏的状态=贫困（cf. indigent贫困，needy贫困，destitute一无所有，penury赤贫） || 文化联想：灾荒年月百姓衣食无着、家徒四壁的赤贫状态可以说 **extreme indigence — “During a severe famine, many families fell into extreme indigence and struggled to obtain even basic food.”**

quiz.question: _____ negligence
quiz.explanation: 疏忽，严重的疏忽。The company was sued for gross negligence in safety procedures. 公司因安全程序中的严重的疏忽被起诉。 | neg->否定，lig->选择（拉丁legere），negligence->不去选择照顾的状态=疏忽（cf. neglect忽视，diligence勤奋，eligible有资格，select选择） || 文化联想：古代官员玩忽职守、误了军情大事的严重疏失很适合联想到 negligence，可以说 **gross negligence — “An official who ignored repeated warnings and let a military emergency worsen could be accused of gross negligence.”**

quiz.question: ________ diligence
quiz.explanation: 勤奋，习惯性的勤奋。Her habitual diligence earned her a promotion. 她习惯性的勤奋为她赢得了晋升。 | di->分开，lig->选择（拉丁diligere->选择热爱），diligence->认真选择做事=勤奋（cf. negligence疏忽，eligible有资格，intelligent聪明=在中间选择） || 文化联想：古人“头悬梁锥刺股”那种日日苦读、从不懈怠的勤勉很适合联想到 diligence，可以说 **remarkable diligence — “The stories of students hanging their hair from a beam and pricking their thighs with an awl became symbols of remarkable diligence.”**

quiz.question: ____ ambience
quiz.explanation: 氛围，舒适的氛围。The café had a cozy ambience with soft lighting. 咖啡馆有柔和灯光的舒适的氛围。 | ambi->周围（拉丁），ience->去，ambience->周围去的感觉=氛围（cf. ambient周围的，ambiguous模糊=两种走向，ambivalent矛盾的） || 文化联想：江南茶馆里茶香袅袅、丝竹相和营造出的那种闲适氛围很适合联想到 ambience，可以说 **a tranquil teahouse ambience — “The scent of tea and the sound of silk-and-bamboo music create a tranquil teahouse ambience in Jiangnan.”**

quiz.question: __________ prescience
quiz.explanation: 预知，非凡的预知。Her remarkable prescience about market trends was impressive. 她对市场趋势的非凡的预知令人印象深刻。 | pre->之前，sci->知道（拉丁scire），prescience->提前知道=预知（cf. science科学，conscience良心，omniscient全知，conscious有意识） || 文化联想：诸葛亮“未卜先知”般提前料到敌军动向的先见之明很适合联想到 prescience，可以说 **Zhuge Liang’s prescience — “Legends of Zhuge Liang often celebrate his prescience in anticipating an enemy’s next move.”**

quiz.question: _____ conscience
quiz.explanation: 良心，清白的良心。He had a clear conscience about his decision. 他对自己的决定有清白的良心。 | con->共同，sci->知道，conscience->与自己共同知道=良心（cf. science科学，conscious有意识，prescience预知，omniscience全知） || 文化联想：古人讲“举头三尺有神明”这种发自内心、约束自己不做亏心事的良知很适合联想到 conscience，可以说 **a clear conscience — “The saying ‘If you have done nothing against your conscience, you need not fear a knock at midnight’ celebrates the peace of a clear conscience.”**

quiz.question: _____ ebullience
quiz.explanation: 热情洋溢，巨大的热情洋溢。The crowd greeted the team with great ebullience. 人群以巨大的热情洋溢迎接球队。 | e->向外，bull->沸腾（拉丁bullire），ebullience->情绪沸腾向外=热情洋溢（cf. ebullient热情，ebullition沸腾，boil沸腾，bulla泡泡） || 文化联想：庙会上锣鼓喧天、人人喜气洋溢按捺不住的热闹劲头很适合联想到 ebullience，可以说 **festival ebullience — “Drums, gongs, lanterns, and laughing crowds fill a temple fair with festival ebullience.”**

quiz.question: _____ convenience
quiz.explanation: 便利，每一种便利。The apartment had every convenience. 公寓有每一种便利。 | con->共同，ven->来（拉丁venire），convenience->共同来到=便利（cf. convenient方便，convene召集，convention惯例，venue场所） || 文化联想：现代小区里楼下就有超市菜场、样样便利的生活配套很适合联想到 convenience，可以说 **everyday convenience — “Having a market, pharmacy, and bus stop just downstairs gives residents great everyday convenience.”**

quiz.question: _____ transience
quiz.explanation: 短暂，人类的短暂。The poet reflected on human transience. 诗人反思人类的短暂。 | trans->穿越，ience->去，transience->穿越而去=短暂（cf. transit过渡，transient短暂，transcend超越，transition过渡） || 文化联想：“浮生若梦”这句古语感叹的人生短暂、转瞬即逝很适合联想到 transience，可以说 **the transience of life — “The phrase ‘life is but a dream’ reflects a traditional awareness of the transience of life.”**

quiz.question: _________ ambivalence
quiz.explanation: 矛盾心理，情感上的矛盾心理。She felt emotional ambivalence about leaving. 她对离开感到情感上的矛盾心理。 | ambi->两个（拉丁），val->价值/力量（拉丁valere），ambivalence->两种价值并存=矛盾心理（cf. ambiguous模糊，valiant勇敢，valor英勇，valid有效） || 文化联想：游子既想留在大城市打拼、又思念家乡故土的两难心情很适合联想到 ambivalence，可以说 **emotional ambivalence — “A migrant may feel emotional ambivalence, wanting both the opportunities of the city and the comfort of home.”**

quiz.question: ________ insolence
quiz.explanation: 无礼，令人震惊的无礼。His shocking insolence to the teacher was punished. 他对老师令人震惊的无礼受到了惩罚。 | in->否定，sol->习惯（拉丁solere->习惯），insolence->不习惯于礼貌=无礼（cf. obsolete废弃=超出习惯，insolent无礼，absolute绝对的） || 文化联想：古代小厮对主人出言不逊、毫无规矩的放肆无礼很适合联想到 insolence，可以说 **shocking insolence — “A servant who openly insulted his master would have been condemned for shocking insolence.”**

quiz.question: ___ flatulence
quiz.explanation: 胀气，气体胀气。The medication helped reduce gas flatulence. 药物帮助减少气体胀气。 | flatul->吹/风（拉丁flare->吹），flatulence->体内积气=胀气（cf. flatus气体，inflate充气，deflate放气，flatulent胀气的） || 文化联想：吃了红薯豆子后肚子里咕咕作响、气体积聚的胀气感很适合联想到 flatulence，可以说 **dietary flatulence — “Eating too many beans or sweet potatoes can cause dietary flatulence and a bloated stomach.”**

quiz.question: commence __________
quiz.explanation: 开始，开始运营。The factory will commence operations next month. 工厂将于下月开始运营。 | com->完全，menc->开始（拉丁initiare），commence->完全开始（cf. commencement毕业典礼=开始，begin开始，initiate开始，start开始） || 文化联想：古代科举乡试开考时那声锣响宣告考试正式开始的仪式很适合联想到 commence，可以说 **commence the examination — “When the gong sounded at the provincial examination hall, the candidates knew the examination would commence.”**

quiz.question: ________ eminence
quiz.explanation: 高地，山地高地。They climbed to the mountain eminence for the view. 他们爬到山地高地观看风景。 | e->向外，min->突出（拉丁minere->突出），eminence->向外突出=高地/显赫（cf. eminent杰出，imminent即将来临=悬在上方，prominent著名） || 文化联想：古代泰山被尊为“五岳之首”、地位显赫的崇高地位很适合联想到 eminence，可以说 **Mount Tai’s eminence — “Mount Tai’s eminence as the foremost of the Five Sacred Mountains gave it both physical and symbolic stature.”**

quiz.question: impertinence __ ______
quiz.explanation: 无礼，对长辈的无礼。His impertinence to elders was unacceptable. 他对长辈的无礼是不可接受的。 | im->否定，pertinent->相关（拉丁），impertinence->不相关=无礼（cf. pertinent相关，impertinent无礼/不相关，relevant相关，apt恰当） || 文化联想：晚辈顶撞长辈、说话没大没小的无礼冒犯很适合联想到 impertinence，可以说 **impertinence toward elders — “Speaking rudely to one’s elders would traditionally be condemned as impertinence toward elders.”**

quiz.question: ____ deference
quiz.explanation: 尊重，表示尊重。The students would show deference to the professor. 学生们会对教授表示尊重。 | de->向下，fer->携带（拉丁），deference->把自己降低携带到对方面前=尊重（cf. defer推迟/尊重，conference会议，different不同，transfer转移） || 文化联想：古代弟子见到老师必先行礼、恭恭敬敬的尊重很适合联想到 deference，可以说 **show deference — “A disciple would bow before his teacher to show deference and respect.”**

quiz.question: ______ circumference
quiz.explanation: 周长，圆周长。Calculate the circle circumference using the formula. 使用公式计算圆周长。 | circum->周围，fer->携带，circumference->携带着绕周围走=周长（cf. circle圆，circular圆形，circumnavigate环绕，conference会议） || 文化联想：古人用绳子丈量圆形谷仓周长的测算方式很适合联想到 circumference，可以说 **the circumference of a circle — “Zu Chongzhi’s calculation of pi helped express the relationship between a circle’s circumference and its diameter with remarkable precision.”**

quiz.question: _____ conference
quiz.explanation: 会议，新闻发布会。The president held a press conference. 总统举行了新闻发布会。 | con->共同，fer->携带，conference->共同携带想法到一起=会议（cf. defer尊重，transfer转移，differ不同，infer推断） || 文化联想：古代诸侯会盟、共商大事的正式集会很适合联想到 conference，可以说 **a formal conference — “A meeting of feudal lords to discuss alliances and common threats resembled a formal conference.”**

quiz.question: _____ interference
quiz.explanation: 干扰，无线电干扰。Radio interference affected the broadcast. 无线电干扰影响了广播。 | inter->之间，fer->携带，interference->在之间携带=干扰（cf. interfere干扰，refer参考，prefer偏好，offer提供，suffer遭受） || 文化联想：老式收音机调台时那种杂音掺入、信号被扰乱的干扰很适合联想到 interference，可以说 **radio interference — “Crackling static from an old radio is a familiar example of radio interference.”**

quiz.question: ____ belligerence
quiz.explanation: 好战，公开的好战。His open belligerence alarmed the diplomats. 他公开的好战使外交官感到担忧。 | bell->战争（拉丁bellum），ger->携带，belligerence->携带战争=好战（cf. belligerent好战，bellicose好战，rebel反叛，antebellum战前的） || 文化联想：古代边境部落动辄挑衅、一言不合就要开战的好战姿态很适合联想到 belligerence，可以说 **open belligerence — “A border commander who constantly provoked neighboring forces displayed open belligerence.”**

quiz.question: quintessence __ ___
quiz.explanation: 精髓，艺术的精髓。This painting represents the quintessence of art from that period. 这幅画代表了那个时期艺术的精髓。 | quinta->第五（拉丁），essentia->本质，quintessence->第五精华（古代四元素之外的以太=精髓，cf. essence本质，essential基本，quintuple五倍） || 文化联想：《茶经》被视为集千百年制茶之道大成的精髓之作很适合联想到 quintessence，可以说 **the quintessence of tea culture — “Lu Yu’s The Classic of Tea is often regarded as the quintessence of traditional Chinese tea culture.”**

quiz.question: ___ competence
