quiz.explanation: 能力，工作能力。The interview tested her job competence. 面试测试了她的工作能力。 | com->共同，pet->寻求（拉丁petere），competence->共同寻求的能力（cf. compete竞争，petition请求，appetite食欲，repetition重复） || 文化联想：老中医几十年临床积累出的诊断本领很适合联想到 competence，可以说 **professional competence — “Decades of diagnosis and treatment can give an experienced physician strong professional competence.”**

quiz.question: ____ pretence
quiz.explanation: 假装，仅仅是假装。His kindness was mere pretence. 他的善良仅仅是假装。 | pre->之前，tend->伸展，pretence->提前伸出=假装（英式拼写，cf. pretend假装，pretense美式拼写，pretension虚伪的主张，pretentious自负） || 文化联想：古代“卧薪尝胆”式表面顺从、暗地图谋的伪装很适合联想到 pretence，可以说 **mere pretence — “Goujian’s outward submission to Wu can be remembered as mere pretence masking a longer-term plan.”**

quiz.question: _______ inadvertence
quiz.explanation: 疏忽，由于疏忽。The error occurred through inadvertence. 错误是由于疏忽发生的。 | in->否定，ad->朝向，vert->转（拉丁），inadvertence->没有转向注意=疏忽（cf. advertise广告=朝向转动，invert翻转，avert避开） || 文化联想：抄写古籍时一时看走了眼、漏抄一个字的无心之失很适合联想到 inadvertence，可以说 **through inadvertence — “A copyist might omit a character through inadvertence while transcribing an ancient manuscript.”**

quiz.question: subsistence _______
quiz.explanation: 生存，生存农业。Many villagers practiced subsistence farming. 许多村民从事生存农业。 | sub->在下，sist->站立，subsistence->在最基本层面站立=生存（cf. consist构成，persist坚持，resist抵制，insist坚持，exist存在） || 文化联想：古代山民靠着自家那一亩三分薄田勉强糊口的自给自足很适合联想到 subsistence，可以说 **subsistence farming — “A mountain family that grew only enough grain to feed itself lived by subsistence farming.”**

quiz.question: ______ persistence
quiz.explanation: 坚持，顽强的坚持。Her dogged persistence paid off in the end. 她顽强的坚持最终得到了回报。 | per->彻底，sist->站立，persistence->彻底站立不倒=坚持（cf. insist坚持，resist抵制，consist构成，subsist生存，assist协助） || 文化联想：愚公移山那种明知山高路远仍代代不辍、挖山不止的坚持很适合联想到 persistence，可以说 **dogged persistence — “The Foolish Old Man’s dogged persistence kept him digging at the mountains despite the enormous task.”**

quiz.question: ______ affluence
quiz.explanation: 富裕，突然的富裕。Sudden affluence changed their lifestyle. 突然的富裕改变了他们的生活方式。 | af->朝向，flu->流（拉丁fluere），affluence->财富流向=富裕（cf. affluent富裕，effluent污水=向外流，influence影响=流入，influx涌入） || 文化联想：江南盐商靠着盐业暴富、家财万贯的富裕景象很适合联想到 affluence，可以说 **merchant affluence — “The fortunes of wealthy salt merchants became a famous symbol of merchant affluence in late imperial China.”**

quiz.question: __ consequence
quiz.explanation: 结果，结果。In consequence of the storm, the event was cancelled. 由于暴风雨的结果，活动被取消了。 | con->共同，sequ->跟随（拉丁），consequence->跟随而来=结果（cf. sequence序列，sequel续集，subsequent随后的，inconsequential无关紧要） || 文化联想：古人讲“种瓜得瓜，种豆得豆”这种必然招致的后果很适合联想到 consequence，可以说 **a natural consequence — “The saying ‘You reap what you sow’ reminds people that every action has a natural consequence.”**

quiz.question: ____ __ eloquence
quiz.explanation: 雄辩，雄辩的天赋。The speaker had a gift of eloquence. 演讲者有雄辩的天赋。 | e->向外，loqu->说（拉丁loqui），eloquence->把话说出来的技艺=雄辩（cf. eloquent雄辩，colloquy对话，obloquy谩骂，soliloquy独白） || 文化联想：苏秦张仪凭三寸不烂之舌纵横捭阖的雄辩口才很适合联想到 eloquence，可以说 **a gift for eloquence — “Su Qin and Zhang Yi were famous for a gift for eloquence that allowed them to persuade rulers and reshape alliances.”**

quiz.question: evince ________
quiz.explanation: 表现出，表现出兴趣。She would evince interest in the project. 她会对这个项目表现出兴趣。 | e->向外，vinc->征服（拉丁vincere），evince->征服到使显现=表现出（cf. convince说服，invincible无敌，province省份，evict驱逐） || 文化联想：学生面对难题时眼中闪现出跃跃欲试的兴致很适合联想到 evince，可以说 **evince curiosity — “A student who leans forward and asks eager questions begins to evince curiosity.”**

quiz.question: ensconce _______
quiz.explanation: 安置，安置自己。He would ensconce oneself in the comfortable chair. 他会把自己安置在舒适的椅子上。 | en->使，sconce->蜡烛台/隐蔽处（古法语），ensconce->安置在隐蔽处=舒适安顿（cf. sconce灯台，abscond潜逃，recess隐蔽的角落） || 文化联想：老先生每晚都要把自己安顿在那把老藤椅里读书的习惯很适合联想到 ensconce，可以说 **ensconce oneself in a chair — “The old scholar would ensconce himself in a rattan chair each evening with a book and a pot of tea.”**

quiz.question: denounce __________
quiz.explanation: 谴责，谴责腐败。The activists would denounce corruption publicly. 活动人士会公开谴责腐败。 | de->向下，nounce->宣告（拉丁nuntiare），denounce->向下宣告=公开谴责（cf. announce宣布，renounce放弃，pronounce发音，enounce表明） || 文化联想：御史当廷公开痛斥奸臣误国的谴责很适合联想到 denounce，可以说 **denounce a corrupt minister — “A censor might denounce a corrupt minister openly before the emperor.”**

quiz.question: pierce ___ ____
quiz.explanation: 刺穿，刺穿面纱。The investigation would pierce the veil of secrecy. 调查会刺穿保密的面纱。 | pierce->刺穿（古法语percier，拉丁pertundere），pierce->穿透刺破（cf. piercing刺耳，penetrate穿透，perforate穿孔，impale穿刺） || 文化联想：神医扁鹊银针一刺、直入穴位的精准针法很适合联想到 pierce，可以说 **pierce the skin — “An acupuncture needle is designed to pierce the skin at a carefully chosen point.”**

quiz.question: coerce __________
quiz.explanation: 强迫，强迫供认。Police cannot coerce confession from suspects. 警方不能强迫嫌疑人供认。 | co->共同，erce->约束（拉丁arcere->围住），coerce->围住强迫=强制（cf. coercion强制，exercise练习=向外约束，exert施力） || 文化联想：古代官府逼良为娼、以势压人强迫就范的手段很适合联想到 coerce，可以说 **coerce compliance — “An abusive local official might use threats to coerce compliance from villagers.”**

quiz.question: acquiesce __
quiz.explanation: 默许，默许。She decided to acquiesce in their decision. 她决定默许他们的决定。 | ac->朝向，qui->安静（拉丁quiescere->安静），acquiesce->朝向安静地接受=默许（cf. quiet安静，quiescent静止，tranquil平静，acquiescent默许的） || 文化联想：古代小媳妇面对婆婆的安排即便不情愿也只能默默接受的顺从很适合联想到 acquiesce，可以说 **acquiesce in silence — “Someone who disagrees but says nothing may simply acquiesce in silence.”**

quiz.question: _____ coalesce
quiz.explanation: 合并，想法合并。Different ideas coalesce into a unified theory. 不同的想法合并成统一的理论。 | co->共同，al->滋养（拉丁alere），coalesce->共同成长融合=合并（cf. coalition联合，adolescent青少年=成长中，adult成人，nourish滋养） || 文化联想：各路诸侯联军最终拧成一股绳、合兵一处对抗强敌的过程很适合联想到 coalesce，可以说 **coalesce into one force — “Separate armies can coalesce into one force when they unite against a common enemy.”**

quiz.question: convalesce __ ____
quiz.explanation: 康复，在家康复。The patient would convalesce at home after surgery. 患者术后会在家康复。 | con->共同，val->力量（拉丁valere），convalesce->重新聚集力量=康复（cf. valor勇气，valiant勇敢，valid有效，convalescent康复中） || 文化联想：大病初愈后在家静养、慢慢恢复元气的调养过程很适合联想到 convalesce，可以说 **convalesce at home — “After a serious illness, a patient may convalesce at home while slowly regaining strength.”**

quiz.question: _________ effervesce
quiz.explanation: 冒泡，香槟冒泡。Champagne effervesce when opened. 香槟打开时会冒泡。 | ef->向外，ferv->沸腾（拉丁fervere），effervesce->向外沸腾=冒泡（cf. fervent热情，fervid热烈，feverish发烧，effervescent活泼冒泡） || 文化联想：打开汽水瓶盖时那一串串争先恐后往上冒的气泡很适合联想到 effervesce，可以说 **bubbles effervesce — “When a bottle of soda is opened, bubbles effervesce rapidly toward the surface.”**

quiz.question: traduce _ _____
quiz.explanation: 诽谤，诽谤对手。He would traduce a rival to gain advantage. 他会诽谤对手以获得优势。 | tra->穿越，duc->引导（拉丁ducere），traduce->把名誉拖过去=诽谤（cf. introduce介绍，deduce推断，conduct行为，reduce减少） || 文化联想：官场上使阴招、编造谣言败坏对手名声的诽谤手段很适合联想到 traduce，可以说 **traduce a rival — “A scheming official might traduce a rival by spreading false stories about his conduct.”**

quiz.question: adduce ________
quiz.explanation: 引证，引证证据。The lawyer would adduce evidence to support the claim. 律师会引证证据支持主张。 | ad->朝向，duc->引导，adduce->引导向前作证=引证（cf. deduce推断，introduce介绍，induce诱导，produce产生，seduce引诱） || 文化联想：讼师在公堂上一条条摆出人证物证来佐证自己说法的做法很适合联想到 adduce，可以说 **adduce evidence — “A legal advocate would adduce evidence before the magistrate to support his client’s claim.”**

quiz.question: produce _______
quiz.explanation: 产生，产生结果。Hard work will produce results. 努力工作会产生结果。 | pro->向前，duc->引导，produce->向前引导出来=产生（cf. reduce减少，deduce推断，induce诱导，reproduce复制，conductor指挥） || 文化联想：农田里辛勤耕耘换来的一茬茬粮食收成很适合联想到 produce，可以说 **produce a harvest — “Months of careful cultivation can produce a harvest of rice, wheat, or vegetables.”**

quiz.question: _______ _ truce
quiz.explanation: 休战，宣布休战。The warring sides agreed to declare a truce. 交战双方同意宣布休战。 | truce->休战（古英语treow->承诺），truce->暂时停火的承诺（cf. true真，truth真相，troth誓言，betroth订婚） || 文化联想：楚汉相争一度约定“鸿沟为界”、暂时罢兵的休战协议很适合联想到 truce，可以说 **declare a truce — “The agreement to divide territory along the Honggou Canal temporarily allowed the Chu and Han sides to declare a truce.”**

quiz.question: ________ facade
quiz.explanation: 外墙，建筑外墙。The building facade was beautifully restored. 建筑外墙被精美修复。 | face->面（法语，拉丁facies），facade->建筑的正面（cf. face面，efface抹去，surface表面，deface损坏，facing正面） || 文化联想：徽派建筑那道气派讲究、专供外人观瞻的白墙黛瓦门面很适合联想到 facade，可以说 **a Hui-style facade — “White walls and dark roof tiles give a Hui-style facade its distinctive appearance.”**

quiz.question: _____ cavalcade
quiz.explanation: 骑兵队，皇家骑兵队。The royal cavalcade passed through the streets. 皇家骑兵队穿过街道。 | caball->马（拉丁caballus），cade->一队，cavalcade->骑马游行队伍（cf. cavalry骑兵，cavalier骑士，chivalry骑士精神，chevalier骑士） || 文化联想：古代皇帝出巡时前呼后拥、浩浩荡荡的骑马仪仗队伍很适合联想到 cavalcade，可以说 **an imperial cavalcade — “An emperor’s procession through the capital could include an imperial cavalcade of mounted guards and attendants.”**

quiz.question: ____ brocade
quiz.explanation: 锦缎，丝绸锦缎。The dress was made of luxurious silk brocade. 这件连衣裙由豪华的丝绸锦缎制成。 | brocado->刺绣（西班牙语，来自broca->织针），brocade->有突出花纹的织物（cf. brocade锦缎，embroider刺绣，brooch胸针=钩针） || 文化联想：云锦这类织有繁复凸纹图案、专供宫廷御用的名贵丝织物很适合联想到 brocade，可以说 **imperial silk brocade — “Nanjing Yunjin is a famous form of imperial silk brocade woven with elaborate patterns and metallic threads.”**

quiz.question: _________ cascade
quiz.explanation: 瀑布，瀑布级联。The waterfall cascade tumbled down the rocks. 瀑布级联从岩石上倾泻而下。 | cascare->落下（意大利语，拉丁cadere），cascade->层层落下（cf. cadence节奏，decadence堕落，accident意外，occasion场合） || 文化联想：黄果树瀑布那种层层叠叠、一级接一级倾泻而下的壮观水势很适合联想到 cascade，可以说 **a spectacular cascade — “Huangguoshu Falls forms a spectacular cascade as water plunges over the cliff in successive sheets.”**

quiz.question: renegade _______
quiz.explanation: 叛徒，叛徒士兵。The renegade soldier defected to the enemy. 叛徒士兵叛逃到敌方。 | re->回，neg->否认（拉丁negare），renegade->否认回去=叛徒（cf. negate否认，renege食言，deny否认，apostate背教者） || 文化联想：古代战场上临阵倒戈、投靠敌营的叛将很适合联想到 renegade，可以说 **a renegade general — “A commander who changed sides in the middle of a war would be branded a renegade general.”**

quiz.question: _____ blockade
quiz.explanation: 封锁，海上封锁。The naval blockade prevented supplies from arriving. 海上封锁阻止了补给到达。 | block->阻塞，ade->行动，blockade->阻塞行动=封锁（cf. block阻塞，barricade路障，embargo禁运，siege围攻） || 文化联想：古代围城战里断绝城内粮草补给、四面合围的封锁很适合联想到 blockade，可以说 **a military blockade — “A besieging army could impose a military blockade to cut off food and reinforcements.”**

quiz.question: ______ stockade
quiz.explanation: 栅栏，监狱栅栏。The prisoners were held in the prison stockade. 囚犯被关押在监狱栅栏内。 | stock->木桩（古英语stocc），ade->构造，stockade->用木桩围成的防护栏（cf. stock库存/树干，palisade栅栏，barricade路障） || 文化联想：古代边塞用削尖的木桩层层围起来的简易防御栅栏很适合联想到 stockade，可以说 **a frontier stockade — “Soldiers on the frontier might build a stockade from sharpened wooden stakes for protection.”**

quiz.question: ________ glade
quiz.explanation: 林间空地，林地空地。They rested in a peaceful woodland glade. 他们在宁静的林地空地休息。 | glade->明亮的林间空地（来自glad->明亮），glade->树林中开阔明亮的地方（cf. glad高兴，gleam闪光，clearing空地，grove小树林） || 文化联想：深山老林里偶然遇见的一片阳光洒落、豁然开朗的林间空地很适合联想到 glade，可以说 **a forest glade — “A patch of sunlight suddenly opening among dense mountain woods forms a peaceful forest glade.”**

quiz.question: _____ fusillade
quiz.explanation: 连续射击，步枪连续射击。A rifle fusillade echoed through the valley. 步枪连续射击在山谷中回荡。 | fusil->火枪（法语），ade->行动，fusillade->用火枪连续射击（cf. fuse引信，refuse拒绝，diffuse扩散，fusilier燧发枪兵） || 文化联想：古代战场上万箭齐发、密集如雨的连续攻击很适合联想到 fusillade，可以说 **a fusillade of arrows — “Ancient battle scenes often describe a fusillade of arrows darkening the sky.”**

quiz.question: ___ accolades
quiz.explanation: 赞誉，赢得赞誉。The film would win accolades at the festival. 这部电影会在电影节上赢得赞誉。 | ac->朝向，col->颈（拉丁collum），accolade->拥抱颈部=骑士封爵礼/赞誉（cf. collar衣领，collar抓住，necklace项链，decollate斩首） || 文化联想：状元及第后朝廷赐予的种种荣誉封赏可以用 accolade 来形容，可以说 **win accolades — “A scholar who placed first in the imperial examination could win accolades from the court and his hometown.”**

quiz.question: _______ promenade
quiz.explanation: 散步，晚间散步。Couples enjoyed an evening promenade along the beach. 情侣们沿着海滩享受晚间散步。 | pro->向前，mener->驱使（法语，拉丁minare），promenade->向前驱使=散步（cf. meander漫游，prominent杰出，promote促进） || 文化联想：老上海外滩那条专供人们悠闲散步、看江景的滨江大道很适合联想到 promenade，可以说 **a riverside promenade — “The Bund became a famous riverside promenade where people could stroll and look across the Huangpu River.”**

quiz.question: ______ colonnade
quiz.explanation: 柱廊，大理石柱廊。The temple featured a magnificent marble colonnade. 寺庙有壮观的大理石柱廊。 | colonna->柱（意大利语，拉丁columna），colonnade->一排柱子（cf. column柱，colonel上校，colonize殖民，colossus巨像） || 文化联想：古希腊神庙前那一排排整齐挺立的石柱回廊很适合联想到 colonnade，可以说 **a long colonnade — “Some Western-style buildings in treaty-port cities featured a long colonnade of evenly spaced columns.”**

quiz.question: ____ charade
quiz.explanation: 字谜游戏，玩字谜游戏。The children would play charade at the party. 孩子们会在派对上玩字谜游戏。 | charrade->聊天（普罗旺斯语），charade->用表演猜字谜的游戏（cf. charades猜字谜，farce闹剧，pantomime哑剧） || 文化联想：老北京茶馆里大伙儿围坐一起靠动作比划猜字的游戏很适合联想到 charade，可以说 **play charades — “A group of friends can play charades by acting out words without speaking and letting others guess.”**

quiz.question: abrade ___ _______
quiz.explanation: 磨损，磨损表面。Rough handling would abrade the surface. 粗暴处理会磨损表面。 | ab->去除，rad->刮（拉丁radere），abrade->刮去表面=磨损（cf. erase擦除，abrasion磨损，razor剃刀，raze夷平） || 文化联想：长年累月被流水冲刷、逐渐磨圆磨光的鹅卵石很适合联想到 abrade，可以说 **abrade the stone — “Years of flowing water can abrade the stone until rough pebbles become smooth and rounded.”**

quiz.question: ______ masquerade
quiz.explanation: 化装舞会，化装舞会。The guests attended the masked masquerade. 客人们参加了化装舞会。 | masque->面具（法语，来自Arabic maskharah->小丑），masquerade->戴面具的游行（cf. mask面具，masquerade化装，unmask揭露） || 文化联想：古代元宵灯会上戴着各式面具、扮成神仙鬼怪游街的化装巡游很适合联想到 masquerade，可以说 **a masked masquerade — “A lantern-festival procession with masks and elaborate costumes can resemble a masked masquerade.”**

quiz.question: centigrade _____
quiz.explanation: 摄氏度，摄氏度刻度。Temperature is measured on the centigrade scale. 温度用摄氏度刻度测量。 | centi->百（拉丁centum），grade->步骤/刻度，centigrade->百格度=摄氏（cf. century世纪，percent百分，centigrade=Celsius摄氏，gradient坡度） || 文化联想：中国气象台惯用的以水结冰为零度、沸腾为百度划分的摄氏温标很适合联想到 centigrade，可以说 **the centigrade scale — “Chinese weather reports commonly give temperature on the centigrade scale, with water freezing at zero degrees Celsius.”**

quiz.question: _____ tirade
quiz.explanation: 长篇大论，愤怒的长篇大论。He launched into an angry tirade. 他开始了愤怒的长篇大论。 | tirare->拉/拉长（意大利语），tirade->拉长的演说=长篇抨击（cf. tire疲惫/轮胎，attire装束，tirade长篇演讲，diatribe长篇抨击） || 文化联想：长辈逮着晚辈的错处滔滔不绝、数落半天停不下来的训斥很适合联想到 tirade，可以说 **an angry tirade — “A furious elder who scolds someone for half an hour may launch into an angry tirade.”**

quiz.question: crusade _______
quiz.explanation: 十字军东征，反对的十字军东征。She led a crusade against poverty. 她领导了反对贫困的十字军东征。 | crux->十字架（拉丁），crusade->带着十字徽记的战争（cf. cross十字，crucial关键，cruise游弋，crusader十字军战士） || 文化联想：中世纪欧洲打着宗教旗号发动的十字军东征很适合联想到 crusade，可以说 **an anti-corruption crusade — “A government campaign presented as a moral battle against graft may be described as an anti-corruption crusade.”**

quiz.question: wade ______
quiz.explanation: 涉水，涉水穿过。They had to wade across the shallow stream. 他们不得不涉水穿过浅溪。 | wadan->前行（古英语），wade->在水中艰难行进（cf. ford涉水过浅滩，wade in介入，wader涉禽，wading pool浅水池） || 文化联想：古代农夫卷起裤脚、深一脚浅一脚蹚过溪流下田的动作很适合联想到 wade，可以说 **wade across a stream — “A farmer may roll up his trousers and wade across a shallow stream to reach the fields.”**

quiz.question: cede _________
quiz.explanation: 割让，割让领土。The defeated nation had to cede territory. 战败国不得不割让领土。 | cedere->走/让步（拉丁），cede->让步割让（cf. secede脱离，concede承认，accede同意，intercede调解，supersede取代） || 文化联想：战败一方被迫在条约上签字、割让土地的屈辱很适合联想到 cede，可以说 **cede territory — “A defeated dynasty might be forced by treaty to cede territory to another power.”**

quiz.question: accede __ _______
quiz.explanation: 同意，同意要求。The government would accede to demands. 政府会同意要求。 | ac->朝向，cede->走，accede->走向同意=同意（cf. cede割让，secede脱离，concede承认，recede退后，proceed前进） || 文化联想：藩镇几经周旋后终于答应朝廷提出条件的让步很适合联想到 accede，可以说 **accede to demands — “After prolonged bargaining, a regional commander might finally accede to the court’s demands.”**

quiz.question: secede ____ _____
quiz.explanation: 脱离，脱离联邦。The state threatened to secede from union. 该州威胁要脱离联邦。 | se->分开，cede->走，secede->走开分离=脱离（cf. separate分离，cede割让，secession脱离，secessionist分裂主义者） || 文化联想：古代诸侯国脱离中央、自立门户的分离举动很适合联想到 secede，可以说 **secede from the realm — “A rebellious region that formally broke away from central rule would in effect secede from the realm.”**

quiz.question: intercede ___
quiz.explanation: 调解，为...调解。He would intercede for the accused. 他会为被告调解。 | inter->之间，cede->走，intercede->走到之间=调解（cf. mediate调解，intervene干预，arbitrate仲裁，interpose介入） || 文化联想：古代官员在皇帝和被贬大臣之间从中周旋、说情调解的斡旋很适合联想到 intercede，可以说 **intercede for someone — “A trusted minister might intercede for a disgraced official and ask the emperor for mercy.”**

quiz.question: supersede _ ____
quiz.explanation: 取代，取代规则。The new policy would supersede a rule. 新政策会取代规则。 | super->在上，sed->坐（拉丁sedere），supersede->坐到上面=取代（cf. sediment沉积，preside主持，reside居住，assiduous勤勉=坐下来专心） || 文化联想：新式白话文逐渐取代文言文成为主流书写方式的历史进程很适合联想到 supersede，可以说 **supersede an older form — “In many settings, vernacular writing gradually came to supersede older forms of classical prose.”**

quiz.question: abide __ _____
quiz.explanation: 遵守，遵守规则。All students must abide by rules. 所有学生必须遵守规则。 | abide->等待/忍受（古英语abidan），abide by->遵守（cf. abide忍受，abiding持久，bide等待，bide one's time等待时机） || 文化联想：老规矩讲究“入乡随俗”、到哪里都要遵守当地习俗的老话很适合联想到 abide，可以说 **abide by local customs — “The saying ‘When in a village, follow its customs’ encourages travelers to abide by local customs.”**

quiz.question: _____ herbicide
quiz.explanation: 除草剂，使用除草剂。Farmers apply herbicide to control weeds. 农民使用除草剂控制杂草。 | herb->草本植物（拉丁herba），cide->杀（拉丁caedere），herbicide->杀草的物质（cf. herbalist草药师，herbivore食草动物，deciduous落叶） || 文化联想：农田里专门喷洒用来除去杂草的除草剂很适合联想到 herbicide，可以说 **a field herbicide — “Farmers may spray a field herbicide to kill weeds without removing them by hand.”**

quiz.question: _____ fungicide
quiz.explanation: 杀菌剂，喷洒杀菌剂。Gardeners spray fungicide on infected plants. 园丁在受感染的植物上喷洒杀菌剂。 | fungi->真菌（拉丁），cide->杀，fungicide->杀真菌的物质（cf. fungus真菌，fungi复数，fungal真菌的，cf. sponge海绵=fungus类似） || 文化联想：果园里为防治果树霉斑病而喷洒的杀菌农药很适合联想到 fungicide，可以说 **an orchard fungicide — “Fruit growers may use an orchard fungicide to prevent fungal disease during a wet season.”**

quiz.question: _________ germicide
quiz.explanation: 杀菌剂，家用杀菌剂。Household germicide kills bacteria effectively. 家用杀菌剂有效杀死细菌。 | germ->微生物/胚芽（拉丁germen），cide->杀，germicide->杀微生物的物质（cf. germ细菌，germinate发芽，Germany德国，germane相关） || 文化联想：医院里用来给器械消毒、杀灭病菌的消毒水很适合联想到 germicide，可以说 **a hospital germicide — “A hospital germicide is used to kill harmful microorganisms on instruments and surfaces.”**

quiz.question: _____ insecticide
quiz.explanation: 杀虫剂，喷洒杀虫剂。The farmer would spray insecticide on crops. 农民会在作物上喷洒杀虫剂。 | insect->昆虫（拉丁insectum->切成段的），cide->杀，insecticide->杀昆虫的（cf. insect昆虫，insectivore食虫动物，section切段） || 文化联想：夏夜家家户户点燃的用来驱灭蚊虫的蚊香很适合联想到 insecticide，可以说 **an insecticide against mosquitoes — “A mosquito coil releases an insecticide against mosquitoes as it slowly burns.”**

quiz.question: ___ pesticide
quiz.explanation: 杀虫剂，使用杀虫剂。Organic farms avoid using pesticide. 有机农场避免使用杀虫剂。 | pest->害虫（拉丁pestis->传染病），cide->杀，pesticide->杀害虫的（cf. pest害虫，pestilence瘟疫，pestilent有害，epidemic流行病） || 文化联想：农田里大面积喷洒用来防治虫害的农药很适合联想到 pesticide，可以说 **an agricultural pesticide — “Farmers may apply an agricultural pesticide to protect crops from destructive pests.”**

quiz.question: glide ______
quiz.explanation: 滑行，滑行穿过。The swan would glide across the pond. 天鹅会滑行穿过池塘。 | glide->滑行（古英语glidan），glide->平稳无声地移动（cf. slide滑动，glider滑翔机，gliding滑翔，smooth flow平稳流动） || 文化联想：白鹤展翅在天空中一动不动、随风平稳滑翔的姿态很适合联想到 glide，可以说 **glide through the air — “A white crane can glide through the air with its wings spread almost motionless.”**

quiz.question: backslide ____
quiz.explanation: 倒退，倒退到。He threatened to backslide into old habits. 他有倒退到旧习惯的危险。 | back->后退，slide->滑，backslide->向后滑退=倒退（cf. relapse复发，regress退步，revert恢复，regression倒退） || 文化联想：戒烟多年后经不住诱惑又重新抽起来的旧习复发很适合联想到 backslide，可以说 **backslide into old habits — “Someone who quits smoking but starts again years later has begun to backslide into old habits.”**

quiz.question: bromide ______
quiz.explanation: 溴化物，溴化物片。The doctor prescribed a bromide tablet for anxiety. 医生为焦虑开了溴化物片。 | bromos->臭气（希腊），bromide->溴的化合物/陈腐说法（cf. bromine溴元素，cliché陈词滥调，platitude陈词，hackneyed陈腐） || 文化联想：老中医开的用来镇静安神的溴剂药片很适合联想到 bromide，可以说 **a bromide sedative — “Bromide compounds were once used medically as a bromide sedative to calm nervous patients.”**

quiz.question: deride ________
quiz.explanation: 嘲笑，嘲笑对手。He would deride opponent in debates. 他会在辩论中嘲笑对手。 | de->向下，rid->笑（拉丁ridere），deride->向下嘲笑=讥讽（cf. ridicule嘲笑，ridiculous可笑，risible可笑，derisive嘲讽的） || 文化联想：相声里对某种荒唐行为极尽讥讽挖苦的调侃很适合联想到 deride，可以说 **deride empty pretension — “A sharp-tongued comic performer may deride empty pretension and make the audience laugh.”**

quiz.question: reside __
quiz.explanation: 居住，居住在。They reside in the city center. 他们居住在市中心。 | re->回，sid->坐（拉丁sedere），reside->坐在某处=居住（cf. preside主持，president总统=坐在前面，sediment沉积，supersede取代） || 文化联想：古代告老还乡的官员回到祖籍老宅安家落户的做法很适合联想到 reside，可以说 **reside in one’s ancestral home — “A retired official might return to his native village and reside in his ancestral home.”**

quiz.question: preside ____ _______
quiz.explanation: 主持，主持会议。The chairman would preside over meeting. 主席会主持会议。 | pre->之前，sid->坐，preside->坐在前面=主持（cf. reside居住，president总统，assiduous勤勉，sedentary久坐，obsidian黑曜石） || 文化联想：古代族长在祠堂主持宗族大事、坐镇裁决的角色很适合联想到 preside，可以说 **preside over the clan hall — “The senior clan leader might preside over the clan hall during an important family ceremony.”**

quiz.question: ode __ ___
quiz.explanation: 颂歌，欢乐颂。Beethoven composed the famous ode to joy. 贝多芬创作了著名的欢乐颂。 | ode->歌曲（希腊oide），ode->抒情颂歌（cf. melody旋律，episode插曲，rhapsody狂想曲，parody滑稽模仿，tragedy悲剧） || 文化联想：屈原《橘颂》这类专门赞颂某人某物的抒情颂歌很适合联想到 ode，可以说 **an ode to virtue — “Qu Yuan’s ‘Ode to the Orange’ can be read as an ode to virtue expressed through the image of the orange tree.”**

quiz.question: bode ___
quiz.explanation: 预示，预示不祥。The dark clouds bode ill for the picnic. 乌云预示不祥野餐。 | bode->预示（古英语bodian->宣告），bode->预示将发生的事（cf. forebode预感，bodement预兆，augur预兆，portend预示） || 文化联想：民间“喜鹊叫喜、乌鸦叫丧”这类靠飞禽鸣叫预示吉凶的说法很适合联想到 bode，可以说 **bode well — “In popular tradition, the call of a magpie may be taken to bode well for the arrival of good news.”**

quiz.question: forebode ____
quiz.explanation: 预示，预示邪恶。The ominous signs forebode evil. 不祥的征兆预示邪恶。 | fore->提前，bode->预示，forebode->提前预示=预感（cf. foreboding不祥预感，ominous不祥，portentous预兆性的，presage预兆） || 文化联想：古人夜观星象、见异常天象便隐隐感到大事将至的不祥预感很适合联想到 forebode，可以说 **forebode disaster — “An ominous celestial sign might be interpreted by court astrologers as something that could forebode disaster.”**

quiz.question: ____ ___ lode
quiz.explanation: 矿脉，富矿脉。Miners discovered a rich ore lode. 矿工发现了富矿脉。 | lode->矿脉（古英语lad->道路），lode->矿石的地下通道（cf. lodestone磁石，lodestar北极星=指路的星，load装载） || 文化联想：古代矿工顺着山体里那道富含金银的矿脉一路挖掘开采很适合联想到 lode，可以说 **a rich mineral lode — “Miners would follow a rich mineral lode through the mountain in search of valuable ore.”**

quiz.question: corrode ___ _____
quiz.explanation: 腐蚀，腐蚀金属。Salt water will corrode the metal. 盐水会腐蚀金属。 | cor->彻底，rod->啃咬（拉丁rodere），corrode->彻底啃咬=腐蚀（cf. erode侵蚀，rodent啮齿动物=啃东西的，corrosion腐蚀） || 文化联想：沿海地区铁器长年累月被盐分海风侵蚀出斑斑锈迹的过程很适合联想到 corrode，可以说 **corrode iron — “Salt-laden coastal air can slowly corrode iron and leave it covered in rust.”**

quiz.question: avant-garde ___
quiz.explanation: 前卫，前卫艺术。The museum displayed avant-garde art. 博物馆展出了前卫艺术。 | avant->之前（法语），garde->守卫（法语），avant-garde->在前面的守卫=前卫（cf. vanguard先锋=van前+guard守，advance前进，guard守卫） || 文化联想：上世纪初那批打破传统、大胆创新的先锋艺术流派很适合联想到 avant-garde，可以说 **avant-garde art — “Early twentieth-century artists who rejected convention and experimented boldly helped create avant-garde art.”**

quiz.question: occlude ___ ______
quiz.explanation: 堵塞，堵塞动脉。A blood clot can occlude the artery. 血栓会堵塞动脉。 | oc->对抗，clud->关闭（拉丁claudere），occlude->关闭堵塞（cf. include包含，exclude排除，preclude排除，conclude结论，recluse隐士） || 文化联想：老年人血管里脂肪斑块逐渐堆积、堵住血流通道的病理过程很适合联想到 occlude，可以说 **occlude a blood vessel — “A buildup of plaque can gradually occlude a blood vessel and restrict the flow of blood.”**

quiz.question: preclude ___________
quiz.explanation: 排除，排除可能性。The evidence would preclude possibility of innocence. 证据会排除清白的可能性。 | pre->之前，clud->关闭，preclude->提前关上门=排除（cf. exclude排除，include包含，occlude堵塞，conclude结论，seclude隔离） || 文化联想：古代科举制度里“糊名誊录”这类事先排除舞弊可能的防范设计很适合联想到 preclude，可以说 **preclude cheating — “Anonymous copying and sealed names in the imperial examination were designed to preclude cheating and favoritism.”**

quiz.question: exclude ______
quiz.explanation: 排除，排除选项。We cannot exclude option completely. 我们不能完全排除选项。 | ex->向外，clud->关闭，exclude->向外关上=排除（cf. include包含，preclude阻止，occlude堵塞，exclusive独家，exclusion排除） || 文化联想：古代科举考场里把携带夹带的考生直接清出考场的做法很适合联想到 exclude，可以说 **exclude a cheater — “An examinee caught carrying hidden notes could be excluded from the examination hall.”**

quiz.question: __________ prelude
quiz.explanation: 前奏曲，管弦乐前奏曲。The concert began with an orchestral prelude. 音乐会以管弦乐前奏曲开始。 | pre->之前，lud->玩（拉丁ludere），prelude->玩耍之前=前奏（cf. interlude插曲，allude暗指，illusion幻觉，elude逃避=玩开） || 文化联想：传统戏曲开场前那段定场锣鼓、拉开全剧序幕的前奏很适合联想到 prelude，可以说 **an operatic prelude — “The opening gongs and drums of a traditional opera can function like an operatic prelude before the main action begins.”**

quiz.question: allude __________
quiz.explanation: 暗指，间接暗指。He would allude indirectly to the scandal. 他会间接暗指这起丑闻。 | al->朝向，lud->玩，allude->向旁边玩=间接暗示（cf. illusion幻觉=玩把戏，elude逃避，prelude前奏，interlude插曲，delude欺骗） || 文化联想：古代文人写诗作文时惯用典故、拐弯抹角暗指某事的手法很适合联想到 allude，可以说 **allude to a classical tale — “A poet may allude to a classical tale with just a few words, expecting educated readers to recognize the reference.”**

quiz.question: _____ interlude
quiz.explanation: 插曲，短暂的插曲。There was a brief interlude before the final act. 最后一幕前有短暂的插曲。 | inter->之间，lud->玩，interlude->在之间玩=插曲（cf. prelude前奏，allude暗指，elude逃避，collusion勾结=共同玩耍） || 文化联想：古代戏曲两场大戏之间穿插的一段小曲杂耍表演很适合联想到 interlude，可以说 **a musical interlude — “A short instrumental passage between two dramatic scenes can serve as a musical interlude.”**

quiz.question: denude ___ ____
quiz.explanation: 剥蚀，剥蚀土地。Deforestation would denude the land. 森林砍伐会剥蚀土地。 | de->去除，nud->裸（拉丁nudus），denude->使裸露=剥蚀（cf. nude裸，nudist裸体主义者，naked裸，denudate剥蚀） || 文化联想：过度砍伐让一片青山变得光秃秃、寸草不生的荒山秃岭很适合联想到 denude，可以说 **denude the hills — “Excessive logging can denude the hills until once-green slopes become bare.”**

quiz.question: prude ________
quiz.explanation: 拘谨的人，拘谨的人的态度。Her prude attitude shocked no one. 她拘谨的人的态度没有让任何人震惊。 | prude->过分拘谨（法语prudefemme->有道德的女人），prude->过分注重礼仪的人（cf. prudish拘谨，prim一本正经，prudence谨慎） || 文化联想：传统大家闺秀那种对任何风流话题都要皱眉回避、过分正经的做派很适合联想到 prude，可以说 **an old-fashioned prude — “A person who blushes at every romantic joke may be dismissed as an old-fashioned prude.”**

quiz.question: obtrude _______
quiz.explanation: 强加，强加意见。Don't obtrude opinion on others. 不要强加意见给别人。 | ob->对抗，trud->推（拉丁trudere），obtrude->强力推向=强加（cf. intrude闯入，extrude挤出，protrude突出，unobtrusive不显眼） || 文化联想：饭桌上非要把自己那套人生道理硬塞给别人听的说教做法很适合联想到 obtrude，可以说 **obtrude one’s opinion — “A dinner guest who keeps forcing unsolicited advice on everyone may obtrude his opinion into every conversation.”**

quiz.question: extrude _______
quiz.explanation: 挤压，挤压塑料。The machine would extrude plastic into shapes. 机器会挤压塑料成型。 | ex->向外，trud->推，extrude->向外推出=挤压（cf. intrude闯入，obtrude强加，protrude突出，extrusion挤压成型） || 文化联想：传统手工艺里把面团从模具孔洞里挤压成型、做成面条的手法很适合联想到 extrude，可以说 **extrude dough into noodles — “A noodle maker can extrude dough through small holes to form long, even strands.”**

quiz.question: ____ ____ desuetude
quiz.explanation: 废弃，陷入废弃。The old law fell into desuetude. 旧法律陷入废弃。 | de->否定，suet->习惯（拉丁suescere），desuetude->不再习惯=废弃（cf. inure习惯，custom习俗，accustom使习惯，mansuetude温顺=手工驯养） || 文化联想：古代那些早已无人遵守、形同虚设的旧律法条文很适合联想到 desuetude，可以说 **fall into desuetude — “An old law that no one enforces for generations may gradually fall into desuetude.”**

quiz.question: solicitude ___
quiz.explanation: 关怀，关怀。She showed solicitude for the sick child. 她对生病的孩子表示关怀。 | sol->整体，icit->驱动（拉丁sollicitare->彻底驱动），solicitude->彻底关心的状态（cf. solicit请求，insouciance漫不经心=反义，anxious焦虑） || 文化联想：老母亲对远行子女无微不至、事事挂心的牵挂关怀很适合联想到 solicitude，可以说 **a mother’s solicitude — “A mother who constantly worries about a child traveling far from home shows deep solicitude.”**

quiz.question: ____ solitude
quiz.explanation: 独处，寻求独处。The writer would seek solitude to work. 作家会寻求独处工作。 | sol->单独（拉丁solus），solitude->单独的状态（cf. solo独奏，sole唯一，solitary孤独，solo独自，cf. sol=sun太阳） || 文化联想：古代隐士归隐山林、远离尘嚣独自清修的独处生活很适合联想到 solitude，可以说 **the hermit’s solitude — “A recluse living alone in the mountains may value the hermit’s solitude far from worldly noise.”**

quiz.question: ______ amplitude
quiz.explanation: 振幅，信号振幅。The signal amplitude was too weak. 信号振幅太弱了。 | ampl->充足（拉丁amplus），tude->状态，amplitude->充足的空间/程度=振幅（cf. amplify放大，ample充足，amplifier放大器，AM调幅） || 文化联想：古琴弹奏时琴弦振动幅度大小决定音量高低的物理原理很适合联想到 amplitude，可以说 **the amplitude of a vibrating string — “The loudness of a guqin note is affected by the amplitude of the vibrating string.”**

quiz.question: plenitude __ ____
quiz.explanation: 充足，数据的充足。There was a plenitude of data available. 有数据的充足可用。 | plen->满（拉丁plenus），tude->状态，plenitude->充满的状态（cf. plenty充裕，replenish补充，complete完整，plenary全体的） || 文化联想：江南丰收年景里粮仓堆得满满当当、物产极其充裕的景象很适合联想到 plenitude，可以说 **a plenitude of grain — “After a rich harvest, granaries filled to the roof displayed a plenitude of grain.”**

quiz.question: __________ magnitude
quiz.explanation: 震级，地震震级。The earthquake magnitude was 7.5. 地震震级为7.5级。 | magn->大（拉丁magnus），tude->状态，magnitude->大的程度=量级（cf. magnify放大，magnificent宏伟，magnanimous宽宏，magnum大号） || 文化联想：古代史书记载某次大地震震动波及数省、破坏空前的规模很适合联想到 magnitude，可以说 **the magnitude of an earthquake — “Historical records describing tremors across several provinces suggest the enormous magnitude of an earthquake.”**

quiz.question: _____ turpitude
quiz.explanation: 堕落，道德堕落。The scandal revealed his moral turpitude. 丑闻揭露了他的道德堕落。 | turpis->丑陋（拉丁），turpitude->道德上丑陋的状态（cf. moral turpitude常见法律术语，torpid迟钝，turpid浮夸=同根存疑） || 文化联想：古代律法文书里用来定性贪官污吏道德败坏、罪行卑劣的说法很适合联想到 turpitude，可以说 **moral turpitude — “A corrupt official who abused office for personal gain could be condemned for moral turpitude.”**

quiz.question: pulchritude ___ _____
quiz.explanation: 美丽，美丽和优雅。The dancer performed with pulchritude and grace. 舞者以美丽和优雅表演。 | pulcher->美丽（拉丁），tude->状态，pulchritude->美丽的状态（cf. pulchritudinous美丽的，belle美女，beauty美丽） || 文化联想：中国古诗里常用“倾国倾城”形容惊人的美貌，最适合帮助记忆 pulchritude，可以说 **pulchritude and grace — “A classical dancer may combine pulchritude and grace in every measured movement.”**

quiz.question: _____ lassitude
quiz.explanation: 倦怠，完全的倦怠。He felt utter lassitude after the long journey. 长途旅行后，他感到完全的倦怠。 | lass->疲惫（拉丁lassus），tude->状态，lassitude->疲惫的状态=倦怠（cf. alas悲叹=啊疲惫，lax松弛，relax放松，languid慵懒） || 文化联想：春运坐了一整夜火车后浑身疲惫无力最适合帮助记忆 lassitude，可以说 **utter lassitude — “After an overnight journey with almost no sleep, a traveler may feel utter lassitude.”**

quiz.question: ____ vicissitude
quiz.explanation: 变迁，生活变迁。She endured many life vicissitude over the years. 多年来她经历了许多生活变迁。 | vicis->轮换（拉丁），tude->状态，vicissitude->轮换变化=变迁（cf. vice副职=轮换的，vicious恶性循环，vicarious替代的，vice versa反之） || 文化联想：中文“人生起起落落、世事无常”最适合帮助记忆 vicissitude，可以说 **the vicissitudes of life — “An older person may look back calmly on the many vicissitudes of life, including success, loss, illness, and recovery.”**

quiz.question: ______ latitude
quiz.explanation: 纬度，旅行纬度。Ships measure travel latitude for navigation. 船只测量旅行纬度进行导航。 | lat->宽（拉丁latus），tude->状态，latitude->宽度=纬度/自由度（cf. latus宽，lateral侧面，oblate扁圆，latitude也指自由空间） || 文化联想：中国地理课最熟悉的南北纬最适合帮助记忆 latitude，可以说 **geographic latitude — “Beijing lies at a higher geographic latitude than Guangzhou, which helps explain some of their climate differences.”**

quiz.question: _____ platitude
quiz.explanation: 陈词滥调，空洞的陈词滥调。His speech was full of empty platitude. 他的演讲充满了空洞的陈词滥调。 | plat->平坦（法语，拉丁platus），tude->状态，platitude->平淡的话=陈词滥调（cf. plateau高原，plate盘，platform平台，flat平坦） || 文化联想：中文“正确但毫无新意的套话”最适合帮助记忆 platitude，可以说 **an empty platitude — “Saying ‘everything happens for a reason’ can sound like an empty platitude when someone is facing a real loss.”**

quiz.question: _______ gratitude
quiz.explanation: 感激，表达感激。She wanted to express gratitude for their help. 她想表达感激他们的帮助。 | gratus->令人愉快（拉丁），tude->状态，gratitude->令人愉快的状态=感激（cf. grace恩典，grateful感激，gratuity小费，gratuitous无偿的） || 文化联想：中文“滴水之恩，当涌泉相报”最适合帮助记忆 gratitude，可以说 **express gratitude — “A student may express gratitude to a teacher who provided years of patient guidance.”**

quiz.question: __________ exactitude
quiz.explanation: 精确，科学精确。The measurements required scientific exactitude. 测量需要科学精确。 | exact->精确（拉丁exigere->要求），tude->状态，exactitude->精确的状态（cf. exact精确，exacting苛求，exaction强征，exact sciences精确科学） || 文化联想：嫦娥探测器轨道计算需要极高精度，最适合帮助记忆 exactitude，可以说 **scientific exactitude — “Spacecraft navigation requires scientific exactitude because even a small error can grow over a long distance.”**

quiz.question: _____ rectitude
quiz.explanation: 正直，道德正直。He was known for his moral rectitude. 他以道德正直闻名。 | rect->直（拉丁rectus），tude->状态，rectitude->正直的状态（cf. correct纠正，direct指导，erect直立，rectangle长方形，rectify纠正） || 文化联想：包公式“铁面无私”最适合帮助记忆 rectitude，可以说 **moral rectitude — “A judge known for moral rectitude refuses gifts and applies the law impartially.”**

quiz.question: _____ multitude
quiz.explanation: 众多，大量众多。A large multitude gathered for the concert. 大量众多的人聚集观看音乐会。 | multi->许多（拉丁multus），tude->状态，multitude->众多的状态（cf. multiply增多，multiple多重，multilingual多语言，multimedia多媒体） || 文化联想：春节庙会里人山人海最适合帮助记忆 multitude，可以说 **a large multitude — “A large multitude may gather in a temple fair to watch performances and enjoy festival food.”**

quiz.question: plentitude __ _________
quiz.explanation: 丰富，资源的丰富。The region had a plentitude of resources. 该地区有资源的丰富。 | plen->充满（拉丁plenus），tude->状态，plentitude->充满的状态（cf. plenty充足，replenish补充，plenitude也是同义词，plenary全体的） || 文化联想：“物产丰饶、资源充足”最适合帮助记忆 plentitude，可以说 **a plentitude of resources — “A fertile region with forests, water, minerals, and farmland may possess a plentitude of resources.”**

quiz.question: __________ ineptitude
quiz.explanation: 无能，笨拙的无能。His blundering ineptitude caused many problems. 他笨拙的无能造成了许多问题。 | in->否定，apt->适合（拉丁aptus），tude->状态，ineptitude->不适合的状态=无能（cf. apt适当，aptitude才能，adapt适应，inept笨拙） || 文化联想：中文“越忙越出错、做什么都不利索”最适合帮助记忆 ineptitude，可以说 **blundering ineptitude — “Blundering ineptitude in project management can turn a simple task into a costly mess.”**

quiz.question: _____ certitude
quiz.explanation: 确信，道德确信。She spoke with moral certitude. 她以道德确信说话。 | cert->确定（拉丁certus），tude->状态，certitude->确定的状态=确信（cf. certain确定，certify证明，certificate证书，discern辨别） || 文化联想：中文“心里十分笃定”最适合帮助记忆 certitude，可以说 **moral certitude — “After reviewing overwhelming evidence, a person may speak with moral certitude about what happened.”**

quiz.question: _____ __ incertitude
quiz.explanation: 不确定，不确定状态。He lived in a state of incertitude. 他生活在不确定状态中。 | in->否定，certitude->确信，incertitude->不确定（cf. uncertain不确定，certitude确信，uncertainty不确定性，dubiety疑惑） || 文化联想：中文“心里没底、前景不明”最适合帮助记忆 incertitude，可以说 **a state of incertitude — “A family waiting for an important medical result may spend several days in a state of incertitude.”**

quiz.question: _____ fortitude
quiz.explanation: 坚韧，道德坚韧。She faced hardship with moral fortitude. 她以道德坚韧面对困难。 | fort->强壮（拉丁fortis），tude->状态，fortitude->强壮的状态=坚韧（cf. fort堡垒，fortress要塞，fortify加固，effort努力，comfort安慰） || 文化联想：“咬紧牙关撑过去”最适合帮助记忆 fortitude，可以说 **moral fortitude — “Speaking up against wrongdoing despite personal risk can require considerable moral fortitude.”**

quiz.question: exude __________
quiz.explanation: 散发，散发信心。The leader would exude confidence. 领导者会散发信心。 | ex->向外，ud->流出（拉丁sudare->出汗），exude->向外流出=散发（cf. sudorific出汗的，transude渗出，exudation渗出物） || 文化联想：中文“整个人散发出自信”最适合帮助记忆 exude，可以说 **exude confidence — “An experienced speaker can exude confidence through a steady voice, calm posture, and clear answers.”**

quiz.question: _____ perigee
quiz.explanation: 近地点，月球近地点。The lunar perigee occurs monthly. 月球近地点每月发生。 | peri->周围/近（希腊），gee->地球（希腊ge），perigee->距地球最近点（cf. perihelion近日点，apogee远地点，geography地理，geology地质） || 文化联想：中国航天课里月球或卫星最靠近地球的位置最适合帮助记忆 perigee，可以说 **lunar perigee — “The Moon is at lunar perigee when its orbit brings it closest to Earth.”**

quiz.question: apogee __ _____
quiz.explanation: 顶点，权力的顶点。The empire reached the apogee of power. 帝国达到了权力的顶点。 | apo->远离（希腊），gee->地球，apogee->距地球最远点=顶点（cf. perigee近地点，aphelion远日点，apex顶点，zenith天顶） || 文化联想：中文“事业达到巅峰”最适合帮助记忆 apogee，可以说 **the apogee of power — “A dynasty may reach the apogee of power when its territory, wealth, and influence are at their greatest.”**

quiz.question: ___ refugee
quiz.explanation: 难民，战争难民。The war refugee sought asylum. 战争难民寻求庇护。 | re->回，fug->逃跑（拉丁fugere），refugee->逃回来的人=难民（cf. fugitive逃犯，refuge避难所，subterfuge诡计=从下面逃脱） || 文化联想：中国学生学习战争与国际人道问题时最适合帮助记忆 refugee，可以说 **a war refugee — “A war refugee may cross a border seeking safety after being forced to leave home.”**

quiz.question: ____ toupee
quiz.explanation: 假发，戴假发。He chose to wear toupee to hide baldness. 他选择戴假发来掩盖秃头。 | toupee->小假发（法语toupet->发簇），toupee->覆盖秃头的小假发片（cf. wig假发，hairpiece假发，toupee只覆盖部分头顶） || 文化联想：中文“用假发片遮住秃顶”最适合帮助记忆 toupee，可以说 **wear a toupee — “A man who dislikes a visible bald spot may choose to wear a toupee.”**

quiz.question: ____________ decree
quiz.explanation: 法令，总统法令。The presidential decree was issued yesterday. 总统法令昨天发布。 | de->完全，cre->判定（拉丁cernere），decree->完全判定=法令（cf. discern辨别，certain确定，secret秘密=分开判定，crime犯罪） || 文化联想：decree 是正式法令，可用中国学生学习外国政治制度时来记忆，可以说 **a presidential decree — “In some political systems, a president may issue a presidential decree with legal effect.”**

quiz.question: ____ filigree
quiz.explanation: 金银丝细工，金金银丝细工。The jewelry featured delicate gold filigree. 珠宝以精致的金金银丝细工为特色。 | filum->线（拉丁），granum->谷粒，filigree->细线和小珠的工艺（cf. file文件/锉，filament细丝，grain谷粒，filigree精细工艺） || 文化联想：中国传统花丝镶嵌工艺最适合帮助记忆 filigree，可以说 **gold filigree — “A traditional jeweler may twist fine gold wires into delicate gold filigree patterns.”**

quiz.question: _____ jamboree
quiz.explanation: 大型集会，音乐大型集会。The music jamboree attracted thousands. 音乐大型集会吸引了数千人。 | jamboree->大集会（来源不明，可能来自法语 jaleux+bourbon），jamboree->热闹的大型聚会（cf. rally集会，festival节日，convention大会） || 文化联想：中国大型音乐节热热闹闹、几万人一起参加最适合帮助记忆 jamboree，可以说 **a music jamboree — “A summer music jamboree may draw thousands of people for concerts, food stalls, and outdoor activities.”**

quiz.question: entrée ______
quiz.explanation: 主菜，主菜菜肴。The entrée course was delicious. 主菜菜肴很美味。 | entrée->入口/进入（法语entrer->进入），entrée->进入主菜（cf. enter进入，entry入口，entrance入口，entre之间=appetizer和dessert之间的菜） || 文化联想：中国西餐厅点主菜最适合帮助记忆 entrée，可以说 **an entrée course — “At a formal Western-style dinner, the entrée course may feature fish, beef, or another main dish.”**

quiz.question: oversee __________
quiz.explanation: 监督，监督运营。The manager would oversee operations daily. 经理每天都会监督运营。 | over->在上，see->看，oversee->从上方看=监督（cf. overlook俯视/忽视，supervisor监督者，superintend监督，inspect检查） || 文化联想：中文“负责人每天盯着整个运营”最适合帮助记忆 oversee，可以说 **oversee operations — “A plant manager may oversee operations to make sure production, safety, and staffing all run properly.”**

quiz.question: _____-____ guarantee
quiz.explanation: 保证，退款保证。The product comes with a money-back guarantee. 该产品附带退款保证。 | warrant->保证（日耳曼语），guarantee->保证/担保（cf. warrant授权，warranty保修，guarantor担保人，surety担保） || 文化联想：中国网购最熟悉的“七天无理由退款”可帮助记忆 guarantee，可以说 **a money-back guarantee — “A seller may offer a money-back guarantee if the product does not perform as advertised.”**

quiz.question: devotee __ ___
quiz.explanation: 爱好者，艺术爱好者。She was a devotee of art and culture. 她是艺术和文化的爱好者。 | devot->誓言（拉丁votum），devotee->发誓献身的人=爱好者（cf. devote奉献，devotion奉献，vow誓言，vote投票，devout虔诚） || 文化联想：中文“铁杆爱好者”最适合帮助记忆 devotee，可以说 **a devotee of art — “A devotee of art may spend weekends visiting museums, galleries, and exhibitions.”**

quiz.question: _____ repartee
quiz.explanation: 机智的应答，机智的应答。They exchanged smart repartee. 他们交换机智的应答。 | repartir->再次出发/回击（法语），repartee->机智的即时回击（cf. parry格挡，retort反驳，riposte还击，wit机智） || 文化联想：相声演员一来一回接得又快又妙最适合帮助记忆 repartee，可以说 **smart repartee — “Two skilled comedians may exchange smart repartee so quickly that the audience barely has time to stop laughing.”**

quiz.question: _____ levee
quiz.explanation: 堤坝，河堤坝。The river levee protected the town from flooding. 河堤坝保护城镇免受洪水侵袭。 | lever->举起（法语，拉丁levare），levee->举起的堤坝（cf. lever杠杆，elevate提升，levy征税，relieve减轻） || 文化联想：黄河大堤最适合帮助记忆 levee，可以说 **a river levee — “A reinforced river levee can protect nearby farmland and towns during seasonal flooding.”**

quiz.question: chafe ____
quiz.explanation: 擦伤，擦伤皮肤。The rough fabric would chafe skin. 粗糙的织物会擦伤皮肤。 | chauffer->加热（法语，拉丁calefacere），chafe->摩擦生热=擦伤（cf. chauffeur司机=加热炉的人，chafing dish暖锅，gall摩擦伤） || 文化联想：新鞋磨脚最适合帮助记忆 chafe，可以说 **chafe the skin — “A stiff new shoe can chafe the skin around the heel during a long walk.”**

quiz.question: _____ carafe
quiz.explanation: 玻璃瓶，玻璃瓶。Water was served in a glass carafe. 水装在玻璃瓶里供应。 | gharrafa->水容器（阿拉伯语），carafe->玻璃水瓶（cf. carafe玻璃水壶，decanter醒酒器，pitcher大水罐，flagon大酒壶） || 文化联想：中国餐厅桌上装水或酒的玻璃瓶最适合帮助记忆 carafe，可以说 **a glass carafe — “A restaurant may place a glass carafe of water in the center of each table.”**

quiz.question: fail-safe _________
quiz.explanation: 故障保险，故障保险机制。The system had a fail-safe mechanism. 系统有故障保险机制。 | fail->失败，safe->安全，fail-safe->失败时仍然安全的=故障保险（cf. failsafe故障保险，redundant冗余，backup备用，foolproof万无一失） || 文化联想：高铁、核电等安全系统常设计成“坏了也要尽量保持安全”，最适合帮助记忆 fail-safe，可以说 **a fail-safe mechanism — “A critical control system may include a fail-safe mechanism that moves equipment into a safer state when a component fails.”**

quiz.question: __________ gaffe
quiz.explanation: 失礼，外交失礼。The politician made a diplomatic gaffe. 政客犯了外交失礼。 | gaffe->钩/鱼叉（法语，航海用语），gaffe->不得体的失言（cf. gaffe社交失误，faux pas失礼=错误的一步，blunder错误，blunder失误） || 文化联想：国际会议上官员说错一句话造成外交失礼最适合帮助记忆 gaffe，可以说 **a diplomatic gaffe — “Using the wrong title for a foreign leader at a formal event can become a diplomatic gaffe.”**

quiz.question: rife ____ ______
quiz.explanation: 充满，充满错误。The document was rife with errors. 文件充满错误。 | rife->普遍（古英语ryfe->通行），rife->充满/普遍（cf. rife with充满，prevalent普遍，rampant猖獗，widespread广泛） || 文化联想：中文“错漏百出”最适合帮助记忆 rife，可以说 **rife with errors — “A rushed report may be rife with errors if nobody checks the numbers before publication.”**

quiz.question: ___ adage
quiz.explanation: 格言，古老的格言。The old adage proved true once again. 古老的格言再次证明是正确的。 | ad->向，age->说（拉丁aio->说），adage->流传下来的古话=格言（cf. proverb谚语，maxim格言，axiom公理，saying说法） || 文化联想：“欲速则不达”这类流传已久的古话最适合帮助记忆 adage，可以说 **an old adage — “The old adage that haste makes waste still applies to careful engineering work.”**

quiz.question: ____ appendage
quiz.explanation: 附属物，肢体附属物。The limb appendage was injured. 肢体附属物受伤了。 | ap->朝向，pend->悬挂（拉丁pendere），appendage->附加悬挂在上的=附属物（cf. append附加，appendix阑尾/附录，pendant悬挂物，depend依赖） || 文化联想：手机上的摄像头是机身附加出来的一个部件，最适合帮助记忆 appendage，可以说 **a mechanical appendage — “A robotic arm can function as a mechanical appendage attached to a larger machine.”**

quiz.question: bondage ___ _______
quiz.explanation: 束缚，束缚和自由。The book explored themes of bondage and freedom. 这本书探讨了束缚和自由的主题。 | bond->绑（古英语bindan），bondage->绑缚的状态=束缚（cf. bind绑，bundle捆，band带，bond联系，bonding结合） || 文化联想：中文“被债务牢牢绑住”最适合帮助记忆 bondage，可以说 **financial bondage — “A household trapped by extremely high-interest debt may feel a form of financial bondage.”**

quiz.question: _____ lineage
quiz.explanation: 血统，皇家血统。She claimed royal lineage. 她声称有皇家血统。 | ligne->线（法语，拉丁linea），lineage->血脉线=血统（cf. line线，linear线性，linen亚麻布，lineal直系的，align对齐） || 文化联想：中国族谱记录一代代家族血脉最适合帮助记忆 lineage，可以说 **a family lineage — “An old genealogy book may trace a family lineage across many generations.”**

quiz.question: mortgage ____
quiz.explanation: 抵押贷款，抵押贷款。They applied for a mortgage loan. 他们申请了抵押贷款。 | mort->死亡（拉丁mors），gage->抵押（法语），mortgage->死亡的承诺=抵押贷款（cf. mortal死亡，immortal不死，mortuary太平间，dead pledge=mortgage） || 文化联想：中国买房最熟悉的住房抵押贷款最适合帮助记忆 mortgage，可以说 **a mortgage loan — “A buyer may use a mortgage loan to finance most of the purchase price of a home.”**

quiz.question: _______ hemorrhage
quiz.explanation: 出血，大出血。The patient suffered a massive hemorrhage. 患者遭受了大出血。 | hemo->血（希腊haima），rrhage->流出，hemorrhage->血液大量流出=出血（cf. hemoglobin血红蛋白，hemorrhoid痔疮，anemia贫血） || 文化联想：中国急诊室遇到大出血病人最适合帮助记忆 hemorrhage，可以说 **a massive hemorrhage — “A massive hemorrhage can cause dangerous blood loss and requires urgent medical treatment.”**

quiz.question: _____ verbiage
quiz.explanation: 冗词，空洞的冗词。The contract was full of empty verbiage. 合同充满了空洞的冗词。 | verb->词（拉丁verbum），age->大量，verbiage->大量无用的词=冗词（cf. verbal口头的，verbose冗长，verbatim逐字地，adverb副词） || 文化联想：中文“说了一大堆废话却没给关键数字”最适合帮助记忆 verbiage，可以说 **empty verbiage — “A proposal filled with empty verbiage may sound impressive while saying almost nothing concrete.”**

quiz.question: ______ foliage
quiz.explanation: 树叶，秋天树叶。The autumn foliage was spectacular. 秋天树叶非常壮观。 | folium->叶子（拉丁），age->集合，foliage->树叶的集合（cf. folio对折/页面，folder文件夹，portfolio作品集=携带叶子，portfolio投资组合） || 文化联想：北京香山秋天满山红叶最适合帮助记忆 foliage，可以说 **autumn foliage — “Visitors often go to Fragrant Hills to enjoy the brilliant autumn foliage.”**

quiz.question: _____ leakage
quiz.explanation: 泄漏，水泄漏。The plumber fixed the water leakage. 水管工修好了水泄漏。 | leak->漏（古挪威leka），age->过程，leakage->漏的过程（cf. leak漏，leaky漏水的，seepage渗漏，drainage排水） || 文化联想：中国新房验收时最怕卫生间或屋顶漏水，最适合帮助记忆 leakage，可以说 **water leakage — “A homeowner may discover water leakage after noticing a damp stain spreading across the ceiling.”**

quiz.question: ________ blockage
quiz.explanation: 阻塞，动脉阻塞。The arterial blockage required surgery. 动脉阻塞需要手术。 | block->阻塞，age->结果，blockage->阻塞的结果（cf. block阻塞，blockade封锁，roadblock路障，obstacle障碍） || 文化联想：中国医院里冠状动脉堵塞最适合帮助记忆 blockage，可以说 **an arterial blockage — “An arterial blockage can reduce blood flow and may require urgent medical treatment.”**

quiz.question: _____ tutelage
quiz.explanation: 监护，在监护下。She studied under tutelage of a master. 她在大师的监护下学习。 | tutel->守护（拉丁tutela->保护），age->状态，tutelage->守护的状态=监护（cf. tutor导师，tutorial辅导，intuition直觉=内部守护，tutelary守护的） || 文化联想：中文“名师带徒、在师傅指导下学习”最适合帮助记忆 tutelage，可以说 **under expert tutelage — “A young calligrapher may improve quickly under expert tutelage from an experienced master.”**

quiz.question: _____ persiflage
quiz.explanation: 戏谑，轻松的戏谑。They engaged in light persiflage. 他们进行轻松的戏谑。 | persifler->口哨嘲弄（法语），persiflage->轻松戏谑的玩笑（cf. banter打趣，badinage戏谑，raillery打趣，repartee机智应答） || 文化联想：朋友饭桌上轻松互相打趣最适合帮助记忆 persiflage，可以说 **light persiflage — “Close friends may exchange light persiflage over dinner without anyone taking offense.”**

quiz.question: pillage _ ____
quiz.explanation: 掠夺，掠夺城镇。The invaders would pillage a town. 入侵者会掠夺城镇。 | piller->掠夺（法语，拉丁pilare->剥皮），pillage->有组织的掠夺（cf. plunder掠夺，loot抢劫，sack洗劫，pillager掠夺者） || 文化联想：古代战争中攻破城池后大肆抢掠最适合帮助记忆 pillage，可以说 **pillage a town — “An invading army that pillages a town steals goods and destroys property after taking control.”**

quiz.question: _____ collage
quiz.explanation: 拼贴画，照片拼贴画。She created a beautiful photo collage. 她创作了一幅美丽的照片拼贴画。 | coller->粘贴（法语，拉丁glutinare），collage->粘贴在一起的艺术=拼贴画（cf. glue胶，collage拼贴，decoupage剪贴，montage蒙太奇） || 文化联想：中国学生把旅行照片拼成一张纪念图最适合帮助记忆 collage，可以说 **a photo collage — “A student may create a photo collage from pictures taken during a class trip.”**

quiz.question: ___ homage
quiz.explanation: 敬意，表示敬意。They came to pay homage to the hero. 他们来表示敬意英雄。 | homme->男人（法语，拉丁homo），homage->臣子向领主效忠的誓言=敬意（cf. homo人类，human人，homicide杀人，hombre男人） || 文化联想：清明纪念英雄、向先烈表达敬意最适合帮助记忆 homage，可以说 **pay homage — “Visitors may pay homage to people remembered for courage and sacrifice at a memorial site.”**

quiz.question: ____ drainage
quiz.explanation: 排水，城市排水。The city drainage system needed repair. 城市排水系统需要修理。 | drain->排水（古英语dragan->拉），age->过程，drainage->排水的过程（cf. drain排水，brain大脑，strain拉紧，drain vs irrigate） || 文化联想：中国城市暴雨后最考验地下排水系统，最适合帮助记忆 drainage，可以说 **city drainage — “Good city drainage helps streets clear heavy rain before water accumulates into serious flooding.”**

quiz.question: _____ badinage
quiz.explanation: 打趣，轻松的打趣。They exchanged light badinage. 他们交换轻松的打趣。 | badiner->开玩笑（法语），badinage->轻松愉快的戏谑（cf. banter打趣，raillery打趣，persiflage戏谑，jest笑话） || 文化联想：中文“你一句我一句地轻松打趣”最适合帮助记忆 badinage，可以说 **light badinage — “Two colleagues may exchange light badinage while waiting for a meeting to begin.”**

quiz.question: __________ espionage
quiz.explanation: 间谍活动，工业间谍活动。The company was accused of industrial espionage. 该公司被指控工业间谍活动。 | espio->监视（法语，意大利语spia->间谍），espionage->间谍活动（cf. spy间谍，espion间谍，intelligence情报，covert秘密） || 文化联想：中文“偷商业机密”最适合帮助记忆 espionage，可以说 **industrial espionage — “Stealing a competitor’s confidential designs can amount to industrial espionage.”**

quiz.question: _________ patronage
quiz.explanation: 赞助，政治赞助。The artist relied on political patronage. 艺术家依赖政治赞助。 | pater->父亲（拉丁），patron->父亲般的保护者，patronage->赞助支持（cf. patron赞助人，patrician贵族，patriarch族长，paternal父亲的） || 文化联想：中国历史上权贵扶植门客、现代政治里利益关系网络，都能帮助记忆 patronage，可以说 **political patronage — “Political patronage occurs when jobs, contracts, or favors are distributed partly because of political connections.”**

quiz.question: _________ personage
quiz.explanation: 名人，杰出的名人。A prominent personage attended the event. 杰出的名人出席了活动。 | person->人（拉丁persona->面具），personage->重要的人（cf. person人，personality个性，persona角色，impersonate模仿） || 文化联想：中文“有头有脸的重要人物”最适合帮助记忆 personage，可以说 **a prominent personage — “A prominent personage may arrive at a state event surrounded by aides and security.”**

quiz.question: _____ slippage
quiz.explanation: 下滑，价格下滑。The market experienced price slippage. 市场经历了价格下滑。 | slip->滑落，age->过程，slippage->滑落的过程=下滑（cf. slip滑倒，slippery滑溜，slide滑动，erosion侵蚀） || 文化联想：软件项目一再延期最适合帮助记忆 slippage，可以说 **schedule slippage — “Repeated design changes can cause schedule slippage and push a product launch back by several months.”**

quiz.question: ____ umbrage
quiz.explanation: 不快，感到不快。He would take umbrage at the criticism. 他会对批评感到不快。 | umbra->阴影（拉丁），umbrage->被阴影笼罩=不快（cf. umbrella雨伞=小阴影，penumbra半影，adumbrate概述，cf. somber阴暗） || 文化联想：中文“别人一句话就觉得被冒犯”最适合帮助记忆 umbrage，可以说 **take umbrage — “A proud official may take umbrage at criticism that was intended as a reasonable question.”**

quiz.question: ___ beverage
quiz.explanation: 饮料，热饮料。They served hot beverage to warm the guests. 他们供应热饮料让客人暖和。 | bever->饮（法语，拉丁bibere->喝），age->行为，beverage->饮品（cf. imbibe饮/吸收，bibulous爱饮酒，beer啤酒，beverage饮料） || 文化联想：冬天喝一杯热茶最适合帮助记忆 beverage，可以说 **a hot beverage — “A cup of tea is a familiar hot beverage on a cold winter morning.”**

quiz.question: _____'_ suffrage
quiz.explanation: 选举权，妇女选举权。The movement fought for women's suffrage. 该运动为妇女选举权而斗争。 | suffr->支持（拉丁suffragium->选票），age->权利，suffrage->投票支持的权利=选举权（cf. suffragette妇女参政论者，vote投票，franchise选举权） || 文化联想：中国学生学习妇女参政史时最适合帮助记忆 suffrage，可以说 **women’s suffrage — “The women’s suffrage movement fought for women to have the legal right to vote.”**

quiz.question: ______ mirage
quiz.explanation: 海市蜃楼，沙漠海市蜃楼。Travelers saw a desert mirage in the distance. 旅行者在远处看到了沙漠海市蜃楼。 | mirer->看/反射（法语，拉丁mirare），mirage->光线反射的幻象=海市蜃楼（cf. mirror镜子，admire欣赏，miracle奇迹，marvel奇迹） || 文化联想：敦煌或新疆沙漠公路上远处出现海市蜃楼最适合帮助记忆 mirage，可以说 **a desert mirage — “A traveler crossing a hot desert may see a desert mirage that looks like water in the distance.”**

quiz.question: barrage __ _________
quiz.explanation: 连续，连续的问题。The speaker faced a barrage of questions. 演讲者面临连续的问题。 | barre->阻拦（法语），barrage->像拦河坝一样连续的=连续炮击（cf. barrier屏障，embargo禁运，bar阻拦，barricade路障） || 文化联想：记者会上连续不断的问题像炮火一样袭来最适合帮助记忆 barrage，可以说 **a barrage of questions — “After a controversial announcement, an official may face a barrage of questions from reporters.”**

quiz.question: ____________ entourage
quiz.explanation: 随行人员，总统随行人员。The presidential entourage arrived at the hotel. 总统随行人员抵达了酒店。 | entourer->围绕（法语），entourage->围绕在旁的人=随行人员（cf. tour旅行，contour轮廓，detour绕道，surroundings周围环境） || 文化联想：重要外宾到访时前呼后拥的一群随行人员最适合帮助记忆 entourage，可以说 **a presidential entourage — “A presidential entourage may include advisers, security officers, aides, and journalists.”**

quiz.question: ____ sage
quiz.explanation: 圣人，智慧的圣人。The wise sage offered advice. 智慧的圣人提供建议。 | sapiens->智慧（拉丁，sapere->品味/知道），sage->智慧的人（cf. sapient智慧，savant学者，savvy精明，insipid无味=无智慧） || 文化联想：孔子在传统文化中常被视为睿智先哲，最适合帮助记忆 sage，可以说 **a wise sage — “A wise sage in an old story may offer a few simple words that change how a ruler sees a problem.”**

quiz.question: ____ presage
quiz.explanation: 预兆，黑暗的预兆。The dark presage worried everyone. 黑暗的预兆让每个人都担心。 | pre->之前，sag->感知（拉丁sagire->预感），presage->提前感知=预兆（cf. sage智者，sagacious睿智，presage预示，augury预兆） || 文化联想：中文“山雨欲来、似乎预示坏事将发生”最适合帮助记忆 presage，可以说 **a dark presage — “A sudden collapse in orders may be a dark presage for a factory already under financial pressure.”**

quiz.question: envisage _ ______
quiz.explanation: 设想，设想未来。They tried to envisage a future together. 他们试图设想未来在一起。 | en->使，visage->面容（拉丁visus->看），envisage->在心中看到=设想（cf. visage面容，vision视觉，envision设想，imagine想象） || 文化联想：中国家庭做退休规划时会设想十年后的生活最适合帮助记忆 envisage，可以说 **envisage a future — “A couple may envisage a future in which they retire near their children and travel several times a year.”**

quiz.question: vantage _____
quiz.explanation: 有利位置，有利位置点。From this vantage point, the view was perfect. 从这个有利位置点，景色完美。 | avant->之前（法语，拉丁ab+ante），vantage->处于前面的优势（cf. advantage优势，avant-garde前卫，advance前进，van先锋） || 文化联想：黄山山顶观景台视野极佳最适合帮助记忆 vantage，可以说 **a vantage point — “From a high vantage point on Huangshan, visitors can see ridges and clouds stretching far into the distance.”**

quiz.question: ____ montage
quiz.explanation: 蒙太奇，电影蒙太奇。The film montage showed time passing. 电影蒙太奇显示时间流逝。 | monter->装配（法语），montage->装配在一起的影像=蒙太奇（cf. mount安装，mountain山=高地，collage拼贴，assemblage组合） || 文化联想：中国影视剧用一连串短镜头表现多年时间流逝最适合帮助记忆 montage，可以说 **a film montage — “A film montage can show a child growing into adulthood through a rapid sequence of short scenes.”**

quiz.question: __ ___'_ dotage
quiz.explanation: 老年昏聩，在老年昏聩中。He was in one's dotage and forgetful. 他在老年昏聩中健忘。 | dote->溺爱/老糊涂（中古英语），dotage->老年的糊涂状态（cf. dote on溺爱，dotard老糊涂，senility老糊涂，dotty稍微疯狂） || 文化联想：中文“人到老年头脑开始昏聩”最适合帮助记忆 dotage，可以说 **in one’s dotage — “A historical novel may portray an aging ruler in his dotage as increasingly forgetful and dependent on advisers.”**

quiz.question: ___ reportage
quiz.explanation: 报道，战争报道。The journalist's war reportage won awards. 记者的战争报道获奖了。 | reporter->报道者（法语），reportage->新闻报道的风格（cf. report报告，reporter记者，portage搬运，deportage外来报道） || 文化联想：中国战地记者深入灾区或冲突地区采访最适合帮助记忆 reportage，可以说 **war reportage — “Careful war reportage can document events through interviews, observation, and verified evidence.”**

quiz.question: offstage _______
quiz.explanation: 幕后，幕后低语。An offstage whisper could be heard. 可以听到幕后低语。 | off->离开，stage->舞台，offstage->舞台之外=幕后（cf. backstage后台，onstage在台上，upstage舞台后方/抢镜，stage舞台） || 文化联想：舞台后台传来低声提醒最适合帮助记忆 offstage，可以说 **an offstage whisper — “During a play, an actor may hear an offstage whisper reminding him of a forgotten line.”**

quiz.question: upstage ___ ____
quiz.explanation: 抢镜头，抢明星镜头。The young actor tried to upstage the star. 年轻演员试图抢明星镜头。 | up->向上，stage->舞台后方（舞台后方较高），upstage->把人推到舞台后方=抢镜（cf. downstage台前，offstage幕后，backstage后台） || 文化联想：春晚舞台上一个配角表现太抢眼盖过主角最适合帮助记忆 upstage，可以说 **upstage the star — “A supporting performer can accidentally upstage the star by drawing more attention from the audience.”**

quiz.question: assuage _____
quiz.explanation: 缓和，缓和恐惧。The leader tried to assuage fears. 领导者试图缓和恐惧。 | as->朝向，suage->温和（拉丁suavis->甜），assuage->使向温和=缓和（cf. suave温文尔雅，sweet甜，persuade说服，dissuade劝阻） || 文化联想：中文“安抚大家的担忧”最适合帮助记忆 assuage，可以说 **assuage fears — “Publishing clear safety data can help assuage fears about a new technology.”**

quiz.question: _________ cleavage
quiz.explanation: 分裂，政治分裂。The political cleavage divided the nation. 政治分裂分裂了国家。 | cleave->劈开（古英语cleofan），age->结果，cleavage->劈开的结果=分裂（cf. cleave劈/坚守，cleft裂缝，cleaver切肉刀，bifurcation分叉） || 文化联想：中文“社会撕裂成两边”最适合帮助记忆 cleavage，可以说 **political cleavage — “A contentious issue can deepen a political cleavage between groups with sharply different views.”**

quiz.question: ___-____ ravage
quiz.explanation: 破坏，战时破坏。The war-time ravage left the city in ruins. 战时破坏让城市成为废墟。 | raver->掠夺（古法语，来自拉丁rapere），ravage->大规模破坏（cf. rape强夺，rapid迅速，rapacious掠夺，raven掠食/乌鸦） || 文化联想：战争把整座城市摧毁得满目疮痍最适合帮助记忆 ravage，可以说 **wartime ravage — “Years of fighting can leave a city scarred by wartime ravage.”**

quiz.question: savage _____
quiz.explanation: 野蛮的，野蛮的野兽。The savage beast attacked without warning. 野蛮的野兽毫无预警地攻击。 | silvaticus->树林里的（拉丁silva->树林），savage->树林中生活的=野蛮的（cf. sylvan树林的，Pennsylvania森林之州，savage野蛮，silviculture林业） || 文化联想：中国古代故事里山林猛兽突然扑出最适合帮助记忆 savage，可以说 **a savage beast — “In a folktale, a traveler may encounter a savage beast in a remote mountain forest.”**

quiz.question: salvage _________
quiz.explanation: 打捞，打捞行动。The salvage operation recovered the cargo. 打捞行动找回了货物。 | salv->拯救（拉丁salvare），age->行动，salvage->拯救财物（cf. save拯救，salvation救赎，salve药膏，salvage从危险中抢救） || 文化联想：沉船后打捞货物最适合帮助记忆 salvage，可以说 **a salvage operation — “Divers may conduct a salvage operation to recover cargo from a sunken vessel.”**

quiz.question: ______ wage
quiz.explanation: 工资，小时工资。Workers received an hourly wage. 工人按小时工资领取报酬。 | wage->工资（古北法语wagier->承诺），wage->劳动报酬（cf. wager赌注，engage订婚/约定，gage担保，minimum wage最低工资） || 文化联想：中文“按小时拿工资”最适合帮助记忆 wage，可以说 **an hourly wage — “A part-time worker may earn an hourly wage based on the number of hours worked.”**

quiz.question: hedge ____
quiz.explanation: 对冲，对冲风险。Investors hedge risk with diversification. 投资者通过多样化对冲风险。 | hedge->树篱（古英语hecg），hedge->用树篱围住/对冲（cf. hedge fund对冲基金，hedgehog刺猬=住在篱笆中的猪，hedge risk对冲风险） || 文化联想：中文“不要把鸡蛋放在一个篮子里”最适合帮助记忆 hedge，可以说 **hedge risk — “An investor may diversify across several assets to hedge risk from any single position.”**

quiz.question: pledge __________
quiz.explanation: 誓言，宣誓效忠。Citizens pledge allegiance to the flag. 公民向国旗宣誓效忠。 | pleg->保证（古法语plege），pledge->担保承诺=誓言（cf. plead恳求，plea恳求，gage担保，engage约定） || 文化联想：中文“郑重作出承诺”最适合帮助记忆 pledge，可以说 **pledge allegiance — “In some countries, citizens or students may formally pledge allegiance to a national flag.”**

quiz.question: ______ foreknowledge
quiz.explanation: 预知，神圣的预知。Some believe in divine foreknowledge. 有些人相信神圣的预知。 | fore->之前，knowledge->知识，foreknowledge->提前的知识=预知（cf. foresight预见，prescience预知，omniscience全知，clairvoyance预知） || 文化联想：foreknowledge 是“事先知道”，可用中国学生学习神学或哲学时来记忆，可以说 **divine foreknowledge — “A theology class may discuss whether divine foreknowledge is compatible with human free will.”**

quiz.question: ________ ridge
quiz.explanation: 山脊，山脊。Hikers followed the mountain ridge. 徒步旅行者沿着山脊前进。 | hrycg->脊背（古英语），ridge->长形的隆起=山脊（cf. ridge山脊，ridgeline山脊线，spine脊骨，crest山顶） || 文化联想：长城沿山脊蜿蜒最适合帮助记忆 ridge，可以说 **a mountain ridge — “Sections of the Great Wall run along a mountain ridge to take advantage of the high ground.”**

quiz.question: abridge _ ____
quiz.explanation: 删节，删节书籍。The editor would abridge a book for children. 编辑会为儿童删节书籍。 | a->到，bridge->桥（拉丁abbreviare->缩短），abridge->缩短（cf. abbreviate缩写，brief简短，brevity简洁，bridge架桥/缩短距离） || 文化联想：中国出版社把长篇名著删节成青少年版本最适合帮助记忆 abridge，可以说 **abridge a book — “An editor may abridge a book by shortening it while preserving the main story and ideas.”**

quiz.question: ___ porridge
quiz.explanation: 粥，热粥。She ate hot porridge for breakfast. 她早餐吃热粥。 | porree->韭葱汤（古法语，演变），porridge->粗粮熬成的稀饭（cf. pottage蔬菜汤，potage法式浓汤，pot锅，porridge英式燕麦粥） || 文化联想：中国人熟悉的粥可以帮助记忆 porridge，但英语 porridge 常指燕麦粥，可以说 **hot porridge — “A bowl of hot porridge can make a simple and filling breakfast on a cold morning.”**

quiz.question: ______ hodgepodge
quiz.explanation: 大杂烩，随意的大杂烩。The room was a random hodgepodge of furniture. 房间是家具的随意的大杂烩。 | hochepot->摇晃锅（法语hocher->摇），hodgepodge->把各种东西摇进锅里=大杂烩（cf. jumble混乱，medley混合，mishmash大杂烩） || 文化联想：中文“大杂烩、什么都往里塞”最适合帮助记忆 hodgepodge，可以说 **a random hodgepodge — “A storage room may become a random hodgepodge of old furniture, boxes, tools, and broken appliances.”**

quiz.question: begrudge _______
quiz.explanation: 嫉妒，嫉妒成功。Don't begrudge success to others. 不要嫉妒别人的成功。 | be->使，grudge->怨恨，begrudge->对...怨恨=嫉妒（cf. grudge怨恨，grudging勉强的，envy嫉妒，resent怨恨） || 文化联想：中文“见不得别人过得好”最适合帮助记忆 begrudge，可以说 **begrudge success — “A good friend should not begrudge success when someone else earns a well-deserved promotion.”**

quiz.question: ___ siege
quiz.explanation: 围攻，进行围攻。The army would lay siege to the castle. 军队会对城堡进行围攻。 | siege->围攻（古法语sege->座位），siege->包围使之坐以待毙（cf. besiege围攻，siege mentality围困心态，seat座位，session会议=坐下来） || 文化联想：中国古代攻城战最适合帮助记忆 siege，可以说 **lay siege — “An army may lay siege to a fortified city by surrounding it and cutting off supplies.”**

quiz.question: besiege ____
quiz.explanation: 围攻，围攻城市。The enemy would besiege city for months. 敌人会围攻城市数月。 | be->使，siege->围攻，besiege->对...进行围攻（cf. siege围攻，obsess困扰=坐在上面，preside主持=坐在前面，sediment沉积） || 文化联想：古代大军把城池团团围住数月最适合帮助记忆 besiege，可以说 **besiege a city — “An invading army may besiege a city for months in an attempt to force surrender.”**

quiz.question: ___ __ sacrilege
quiz.explanation: 亵渎，亵渎行为。Destroying the temple was an act of sacrilege. 摧毁寺庙是亵渎行为。 | sacri->神圣（拉丁sacer），lege->拿走（拉丁legere），sacrilege->把神圣之物拿走=亵渎（cf. sacred神圣，sacrifice牺牲，consecrate奉献，desecrate亵渎） || 文化联想：sacrilege 是宗教中的“亵渎神圣”，可用中国学生学习世界宗教时来记忆，可以说 **an act of sacrilege — “Deliberately destroying an object regarded as sacred may be condemned as an act of sacrilege.”**

quiz.question: _______ privilege
quiz.explanation: 特权，特殊特权。The elite enjoyed special privilege. 精英享有特殊特权。 | privi->私人（拉丁privus），leg->法律，privilege->私人的法律=特权（cf. private私人，privacy隐私，privation剥夺，deprive剥夺） || 文化联想：中文“只有少数人才能享有的特殊待遇”最适合帮助记忆 privilege，可以说 **a special privilege — “Access reserved only for a favored group can become a special privilege rather than an ordinary right.”**

quiz.question: renege __ _______
quiz.explanation: 违背，违背承诺。He would renege on promise. 他会违背承诺。 | re->再次，neg->否认（拉丁negare），renege->再次否认=违背承诺（cf. negate否定，deny否认，abrogate废除，renegade叛徒=否认回去） || 文化联想：中文“答应了又反悔”最适合帮助记忆 renege，可以说 **renege on a promise — “A company that promises full refunds and later refuses them may renege on a promise.”**

quiz.question: ______ prestige
quiz.explanation: 威望，社会威望。The position brought social prestige. 该职位带来了社会威望。 | praestigiae->魔术师把戏（拉丁），prestige->最初指幻觉，后演变为令人印象深刻的威望（cf. prestigious有声望，illusion幻觉，prestige令人印象深刻） || 文化联想：清华、北大这样的名校品牌会带来很高社会声望，最适合帮助记忆 prestige，可以说 **social prestige — “Admission to a famous institution can carry considerable social prestige in some communities.”**

quiz.question: indulge _______
quiz.explanation: 放纵，放纵自己。He would indulge oneself with dessert. 他会放纵自己吃甜点。 | in->使，dulg->允许（拉丁indulgere->纵容），indulge->允许自己=放纵（cf. indulgent放纵的，indulgence放纵，self-indulgent自我放纵） || 文化联想：中文“偶尔放纵自己吃顿好的”最适合帮助记忆 indulge，可以说 **indulge oneself — “After finishing a difficult project, someone may indulge oneself with a favorite dessert or a short vacation.”**

quiz.question: ____ flange
quiz.explanation: 法兰，管道法兰。The pipe flange connected two sections. 管道法兰连接两段。 | flange->突出边缘（法语flanchir->弯曲），flange->连接管道的凸缘（cf. flank侧翼，flange凸缘，coupling连接，fitting配件） || 文化联想：中国水暖工程里两段管子通过法兰连接最适合帮助记忆 flange，可以说 **a pipe flange — “A pipe flange allows two sections of industrial piping to be bolted together securely.”**

quiz.question: estrange _______
quiz.explanation: 疏远，疏远朋友。The argument would estrange friends. 争吵会疏远朋友。 | estrange->使陌生（拉丁extraneare），estrange->使变得陌生=疏远（cf. strange陌生，stranger陌生人，alienate疏远，ostracize排斥） || 文化联想：中文“因为长期争吵把朋友都疏远了”最适合帮助记忆 estrange，可以说 **estrange friends — “Years of unresolved arguments can estrange friends who were once very close.”**

quiz.question: ____ revenge
quiz.explanation: 报复，寻求报复。He swore to seek revenge. 他发誓要寻求报复。 | re->回，venge->复仇（拉丁vindicare），revenge->向回复仇（cf. avenge复仇，vengeance复仇，vindictive报复性，vendetta世仇） || 文化联想：中文“君子报仇十年不晚”最适合帮助记忆 revenge，可以说 **seek revenge — “A character consumed by anger may spend years trying to seek revenge for an old injury.”**

quiz.question: ____ hinge
quiz.explanation: 铰链，门铰链。The door hinge needed oiling. 门铰链需要上油。 | hinge->铰链（来源不明，可能来自hang->悬挂），hinge->门的旋转轴（cf. hang悬挂，pivot轴心，hinge on取决于，keystone关键石） || 文化联想：中国家里门轴吱呀响时给铰链上油最适合帮助记忆 hinge，可以说 **a door hinge — “A squeaking door hinge usually becomes quieter after a small amount of lubricant is applied.”**

quiz.question: impinge __ ______
quiz.explanation: 侵犯，侵犯权利。The new law would impinge on rights. 新法律会侵犯权利。 | im->使，ping->打击（拉丁pangere），impinge->打击到=侵犯（cf. impact冲击，impinging侵犯，infringe侵犯，compact紧密） || 文化联想：中文“新规定开始挤压、影响既有权利”最适合帮助记忆 impinge，可以说 **impinge on rights — “A new restriction may impinge on rights even if it does not eliminate them completely.”**

quiz.question: fringe ________
quiz.explanation: 附加，附加福利。The job offered fringe benefits. 这份工作提供附加福利。 | fimbria->穗（拉丁），fringe->边缘流苏=附加的（cf. fringe边缘，fringed有流苏的，peripheral边缘的，marginal边缘的） || 文化联想：中国公司工资之外的保险、补贴等最适合帮助记忆 fringe，可以说 **fringe benefits — “A job may offer fringe benefits such as health insurance, meal subsidies, or transportation support.”**

quiz.question: infringe ______
quiz.explanation: 侵犯，侵犯权利。The policy would infringe rights. 该政策会侵犯权利。 | in->使，fring->破碎（拉丁frangere），infringe->打破=侵犯（cf. fracture骨折，fragile脆，infraction违规，fragment碎片） || 文化联想：中文“直接侵犯合法权利”最适合帮助记忆 infringe，可以说 **infringe rights — “A policy that unlawfully blocks protected expression may infringe rights guaranteed by law.”**

quiz.question: constringe _______
quiz.explanation: 收缩，收缩血管。Cold temperatures constringe vessels. 寒冷的温度会收缩血管。 | con->共同，string->紧缩（拉丁stringere），constringe->使收缩（cf. constrict收缩，strict严格，stringent严格，restrict限制） || 文化联想：医学里“使血管收缩”最适合帮助记忆 constringe，可以说 **constringe vessels — “Cold exposure can constringe vessels near the skin and reduce blood flow to the surface.”**

quiz.question: _______ syringe
quiz.explanation: 注射器，胰岛素注射器。The diabetic used an insulin syringe. 糖尿病患者使用胰岛素注射器。 | syrinx->管子（希腊，牧神潘的芦笛），syringe->注射用的管子（cf. syrinx芦笛，Pan牧神，panpipe排箫，syringe注射器） || 文化联想：中国糖尿病患者使用胰岛素注射器最适合帮助记忆 syringe，可以说 **an insulin syringe — “A patient may use an insulin syringe to inject a carefully measured dose.”**

quiz.question: plunge ____
quiz.explanation: 投入，投入。He would plunge into the cold water. 他会投入冷水中。 | plumb->铅锤（拉丁plumbum->铅），plunge->像铅锤一样直落（cf. plumb垂直，plumber水管工，plummet骤降，aplomb沉着=铅锤般稳定） || 文化联想：冬泳者一头扎进冰冷水里最适合帮助记忆 plunge，可以说 **plunge into cold water — “A winter swimmer may plunge into cold water and immediately begin moving to stay warm.”**

quiz.question: _____ lounge
quiz.explanation: 休息室，酒店休息室。Guests gathered in the hotel lounge. 客人们聚集在酒店休息室。 | lounge->懒散躺（来源不明，可能来自French longis->懒汉），lounge->休息/休息室（cf. lounge about闲逛，lounge chair躺椅，lobby大厅） || 文化联想：老上海大饭店里供客人喝茶、聊天、等人的公共休息区最适合联想到 lounge，可以说 **a hotel lounge — “Guests at a grand Shanghai hotel might gather in the hotel lounge for tea and conversation.”**

quiz.question: expunge ___ ______
quiz.explanation: 删除，删除记录。The court agreed to expunge the record. 法院同意删除记录。 | ex->向外，pung->刺（拉丁pungere），expunge->刺出去=删除（cf. pungent刺激性的，puncture刺穿，punctuation标点，compunction懊悔） || 文化联想：传统宗族里把犯下大错的人从族谱中除名，最适合帮助记忆 expunge，可以说 **expunge a name from the clan register — “In a traditional clan, a disgraced member might have his name expunged from the clan register.”**

quiz.question: ____ surcharge
quiz.explanation: 附加费，燃油附加费。Airlines added a fuel surcharge to tickets. 航空公司在机票上增加了燃油附加费。 | sur->超过，charge->负担（法语charger），surcharge->超出的负担=附加费（cf. charge费用，discharge解除，overcharge多收费） || 文化联想：中国旅客很熟悉机票票价之外另列的一笔燃油附加费，可以说 **a fuel surcharge — “A fuel surcharge is an extra fee added on top of the basic airfare.”**

quiz.question: _________ discharge
quiz.explanation: 解雇，光荣退伍。The soldier received an honorable discharge. 士兵获得了光荣退伍。 | dis->去除，charge->负担/责任，discharge->去除责任=免职/退伍（cf. charge负担，recharge充电，surcharge附加费，charger充电器） || 文化联想：军人服役期满、表现良好后光荣退伍的场景很适合联想到 discharge，可以说 **an honorable discharge — “After completing his military service with a good record, the soldier received an honorable discharge.”**

quiz.question: _____ diverge

quiz.question: forge _ _________

quiz.question: splurge ________
quiz.explanation: 挥霍，挥霍购物。She decided to splurge shopping during the sale. 她决定在促销期间挥霍购物。 | splurge->挥霍（来源不明，可能是splash+surge的混合），splurge->大肆花钱（cf. surge涌浪，splash飞溅，spend花钱，extravagant奢侈） || 文化联想：过年前置办年货时一口气买许多平时舍不得买的好东西，可以说 **splurge on New Year goods — “A family may splurge on New Year goods before the Spring Festival, buying extra delicacies and decorations.”**

quiz.question: scourge __ ___

quiz.question: purge _______

quiz.question: resurge __ __________

quiz.question: ____ gauge
quiz.explanation: 仪表，燃油仪表。Check the fuel gauge before driving. 驾驶前检查燃油仪表。 | gauge->测量工具（古北法语gauger->测量桶容量），gauge->测量仪器（cf. standard gauge标准轨距，rain gauge雨量计，gauge压力表） || 文化联想：古代农业要观测雨量，现代则用仪器精确测量，最适合联想到 gauge，可以说 **a rain gauge — “A modern rain gauge measures rainfall precisely for farming and weather records.”**

quiz.question: ____ __ subterfuge
quiz.explanation: 诡计，诡计的策略。His claim was just a ploy of subterfuge. 他的声明只是诡计的策略。 | subter->在下面（拉丁），fuge->逃（拉丁fugere），subterfuge->从下面逃脱=诡计（cf. fugitive逃犯，refugee难民，centrifuge离心机，refuge避难所） || 文化联想：《三十六计》里的“瞒天过海”最适合帮助记忆 subterfuge，可以说 **a clever subterfuge — “In the Thirty-Six Stratagems, ‘cross the sea without the emperor’s knowledge’ is remembered as a classic subterfuge.”**

quiz.question: ______ cache
quiz.explanation: 藏匿处，秘密藏匿处。They discovered a secret cache of weapons. 他们发现了秘密藏匿处武器。 | cacher->隐藏（法语），cache->隐藏的储存处（cf. cache缓存，stash藏匿，cache memory缓存，conceal隐藏） || 文化联想：乱世里大户人家把银元埋在院子地下秘密保存的场景很适合联想到 cache，可以说 **a hidden cache — “A wealthy household in troubled times might bury a hidden cache of silver beneath the courtyard.”**

quiz.question: ___ _ _____ __ panache
quiz.explanation: 神气，增添一丝神气。She would add a touch of panache to every outfit. 她会为每套服装增添一丝神气。 | pennacchio->羽毛（意大利语，拉丁penna->羽毛），panache->头盔羽饰=风度/神气（cf. pen钢笔=羽毛管，pinnacle顶峰，panache风采） || 文化联想：京剧武生一亮相便身段利落、气势十足，这种风采最适合联想到 panache，可以说 **perform with panache — “A Peking-opera warrior who enters with a crisp pose and sweeping sleeves performs with unmistakable panache.”**

quiz.explanation: 陈词滥调，陈腐的陈词滥调。The speech was full of stale cliché. 演讲充满了陈腐的陈词滥调。 | clicher->铸造铅版（法语印刷术语），cliché->被过度印刷的文字=陈词滥调（cf. stereotype铅版印刷/刻板印象，platitude陈词，hackneyed陈腐） || 文化联想：中文“老生常谈”正好对应被说烂了的陈词滥调，可以说 **a stale cliché — “An idea dismissed as ‘老生常谈’ is essentially a stale cliché that everyone has heard before.”**

quiz.question: ______ niche

quiz.question: ________ pastiche
quiz.explanation: 模仿作品，艺术模仿作品。The film was an artistic pastiche of noir classics. 这部电影是黑色经典的艺术模仿作品。 | pasticcio->馅饼（意大利语，混杂物），pastiche->混合多种风格的艺术作品（cf. paste粘贴，pastry糕点，pasta意面，hodgepodge大杂烩） || 文化联想：一些仿古景区把唐、宋、明、清各种建筑元素混在一起，很适合联想到 pastiche，可以说 **an architectural pastiche — “A tourist complex that mixes Tang roofs, Ming walls, and Qing decoration may look like an architectural pastiche.”**

quiz.question: ____ avalanche
quiz.explanation: 雪崩，雪崩。The snow avalanche buried the village. 雪崩掩埋了村庄。 | avaler->吞咽（法语，拉丁ad+vallem->向山谷），avalanche->山谷向下吞咽=雪崩（cf. valley山谷，vale山谷，avalanche effect雪崩效应） || 文化联想：喜马拉雅或天山陡坡上大块积雪突然倾泻而下的景象就是 avalanche，可以说 **a snow avalanche — “On a steep Himalayan slope, a sudden snow avalanche can sweep downward with terrifying force.”**

quiz.question: wreathe __ ______

quiz.question: lithe ______
quiz.explanation: 柔软的，柔软的身材。The dancer had a lithe figure. 舞者有柔软的身材。 | lithe->柔软（古英语lithe->温和），lithe->柔韧优美的（cf. lissome柔软，supple柔韧，lithe and lissome柔软灵活，agile敏捷） || 文化联想：敦煌壁画中的飞天身姿轻盈柔韧，很适合联想到 lithe，可以说 **a lithe figure — “The flying apsaras in Dunhuang murals are painted with lithe figures that seem to float through the air.”**

quiz.question: blithe ______

quiz.question: bonhomie ___ ______

quiz.question: magpie __________

quiz.question: ______ gaucherie

quiz.question: _____ coterie

quiz.question: calorie ______
quiz.explanation: 卡路里，卡路里摄入量。Monitor your calorie intake for health. 监控你的卡路里摄入量以保持健康。 | calor->热（拉丁），calorie->热量单位（cf. caloric热量的，calorific产热的，scald烫伤，caldron大锅，nonchalance漠不关心=不热） || 文化联想：现在吃米饭、饺子、月饼时很多人都会顺手计算热量，可以说 **count calories — “Someone trying to eat lightly may count calories even when choosing familiar foods such as rice, dumplings, or mooncakes.”**

quiz.question: vie ___ ________

quiz.question: slake ___'_ ______

quiz.question: stake _ _____
